fact_tl: May mga taong allergic sa natural na latex rubber dahil sa mga protina sa sap ng rubber tree! Kaya naman, gumagamit ang ilang ospital ng synthetic rubber o vinyl gloves.
fact_en: Some people are allergic to natural latex rubber because of proteins in the rubber tree sap! That is why some hospitals use synthetic rubber or vinyl gloves instead.

title: Asin Osmosis Bacteria Preserve
fact_tl:
Paano pinapanatili ng asin ang pagkain na hindi mapanis?

Sa pamamagitan ng osmosis! Kinukuha ng mataas na konsentrasyon ng asin ang tubig mula sa bacteria at food cells, kaya hirap silang mabuhay at lumaki.
fact_en:
How does salt keep food from spoiling?

Through osmosis! Salt's high concentration draws water out of bacteria and food cells, making it really hard for bacteria to survive and grow.

title: Iodized Salt at ASIN Law
fact_tl: Ang iodized salt ay may iodine na idinagdag ng batas para iwasan ang mga sakit tulad ng goiter. Sa Pilipinas, sapwat ito sa ilalim ng ASIN Law!
fact_en: Iodized salt has iodine added by law to prevent iodine deficiency disorders like goiter. In the Philippines, salt iodization is required under the ASIN Law!

title: Parts Per Million ng Polusyon
fact_tl:
Paano sinusukat ng mga scientist ang napakaliit na halaga ng polusyon sa tubig at hangin?

Gumagamit sila ng parts per million (ppm)! Ang isang ppm ay katumbas ng isang drop ng sangkap sa isang milyong drop ng tubig — napakaliit niyan!
fact_en:
How do scientists measure tiny amounts of pollution in water and air?

They use parts per million (ppm)! One ppm equals one drop of substance in one million drops of water — that's super tiny!

title: Epektibong Hand Sanitizer
fact_tl:
Bakit kaya epektibo ang hand sanitizer sa pagpatay ng germs?

Ito ay solusyon ng tubig at alcohol (karaniwang 70% ethanol). Ang tamang konsentrasyon ng alcohol ang epektibong pumapatay sa mga bacteria at virus!
fact_en:
Why does hand sanitizer kill germs so well?

It's a solution of water and alcohol (usually 70% ethanol). That exact alcohol concentration is what makes it great at killing bacteria and viruses!

title: Food Coloring na Safety Test
fact_tl: Ang mga artipisyal na food coloring ay maingat na sinusuri ng food safety authorities tulad ng FDA! Pinapayagan lang sila sa tiyak na dami para siguradong ligtas kainin.
fact_en: Artificial food colorings are carefully tested by food safety authorities like the FDA! They are only allowed in specific amounts to make sure they are totally safe to eat.

title: Activated Carbon sa Water Filter
fact_tl: Ang activated carbon ay puno ng maliliit na pores na kumukuha ng unwanted chemicals sa pamamagitan ng adsorption! Kaya ginagamit ito sa water filters para tanggalin ang masamang lasa at amoy.
fact_en: Activated carbon is packed with tiny pores that trap unwanted chemicals through adsorption! That's why it's used in home water filters to remove bad tastes and odors.

title: Taba Solid Mantika Likido
fact_tl:
Bakit solid ang mantikilya pero likido ang cooking oil?

Nasa fatty acids ito! Ang fats ay may saturated fatty acids na nagpapanatili sa kanila na solid sa room temperature, habang ang oils ay may ibang fatty acids na likido.
fact_en:
Why is butter solid but cooking oil is liquid?

It's all about fatty acids! Fats have saturated fatty acids that keep them solid at room temperature, while oils have different fatty acids that make them liquid.

title: Uling mula sa Sinaunang Halaman
fact_tl:
Paano nabuo ang coal?

Ang coal ay isang hindi mapanibaguhing fossil fuel na nabuo mula sa sinaunang halaman! Nalubog ito sa matinding init at presyon nang milyun-milyong taon.
fact_en:
How is coal formed?

Coal is a non-renewable fossil fuel formed from ancient plant matter! It was buried under intense heat and pressure for millions of years.

title: Embudo
fact_tl:
Anong kagamitan ang tumutulong magbuhos ng likido nang hindi tumatapon?

Ang embudo! Malapad ito sa itaas at makitid sa ibaba, kaya madali ibuhos ang likido o buhangin sa maliit na butas.
fact_en:
What tool helps you pour liquids without spilling?

A funnel! It is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom, guiding liquids or sand into small openings.

title: Car Lead-Acid Battery Alternator
fact_tl:
Ano ang nagpapatibay at nagpaparecharge sa baterya ng sasakyan?

Ang mga baterya ng sasakyan ay lead-acid batteries na may lead plates at sulfuric acid electrolyte! Ang alternator ay nagko-convert ng engine energy pabalik sa chemical energy para mag-recharge.
fact_en:
What makes a car battery special and rechargeable?

Car batteries are lead-acid batteries with lead plates and sulfuric acid electrolyte! The alternator converts engine energy back into stored chemical energy to recharge them.

title: Graphite Lapis Carbon Kuryente
fact_tl: Ang graphite, ang carbon material sa lapis, ay isang nonmetal na nagko-conduct ng kuryente! Ang electrons ay malayang gumagalaw sa pagitan ng layers ng carbon atoms nito.
fact_en: Graphite, the carbon material in pencils, is a nonmetal that conducts electricity! Electrons move freely between its layers of carbon atoms, unlike most nonmetals.

title: Buckyball na Hugis Soccer Ball
fact_tl:
Gusto mo bang makita ang isang molecule na hugis soccer ball?

Ang buckminsterfullerene (C60) ay isang molecule na may 60 carbon atoms na nakaayos tulad ng soccer ball! Ito ay isa sa unang nanomaterial na ginagamit sa materials science research.
fact_en:
Ever wonder what a molecule looks like as a soccer ball?

Buckminsterfullerene (C60) is a molecule of 60 carbon atoms shaped exactly like a soccer ball! It's an early nanomaterial used in materials science research.

title: Nitinol na Shape Memory Alloy
fact_tl: Ang nitinol ay isang smart na nickel-titanium shape memory alloy na bumabalik sa orihinal nitong hugis kapag pinainit! Ginagamit ito sa medical stents, dental braces wire, at iba pa.
fact_en: Nitinol is a smart nickel-titanium shape memory alloy that returns to its original shape when heated! It's used in medical stents, dental braces wire, and more.

title: Reverse Osmosis Desalination
fact_tl: Ang reverse osmosis desalination ay pumipilit ng seawater sa isang semi-permeable membrane para harangan ang salt ions at gumawa ng fresh water para sa mga isla at barko sa Pilipinas!
fact_en: Reverse osmosis desalination forces seawater through a semi-permeable membrane to block salt ions and make fresh water for Philippine islands and ships!

title: Smoke Point ng Iba't Ibang Oil
fact_tl:
Bakit iba-iba ang langis na ginagamit sa pagluluto?

May iba't ibang smoke point ang mga langis! Ang langis ng niyog (177°C) maganda sa high-heat frying, habang ang olive oil (160°C) mas maganda sa lower-heat cooking para iwas harmful breakdown products.
fact_en:
Why use different oils for cooking?

Oils have different smoke points! Coconut oil (177°C) is great for high-heat frying, while olive oil (160°C) is better for lower-heat cooking to avoid harmful breakdown products.

title: Washing Soda sa Hard Water
fact_tl: Ang washing soda (sodium carbonate, Na2CO3) ay isang base na nagpapalambot ng hard water sa paglalaba! Tinatanggal nito ang calcium at magnesium ions para mas gumana ang sabon.
fact_en: Washing soda (sodium carbonate, Na2CO3) is a base that softens hard water in laundry! It removes calcium and magnesium ions so soap and detergent work better.

title: 78% Nitrogen na Hindi Reaktibo
fact_tl: Ang nitrogen ay bumubuo ng mga 78% ng hangin! Halos hindi ito nagre-react, kaya ligtas ang ating paligid at nababawasan ang oxygen para hindi madaling masunog.
fact_en: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of air! It's almost unreactive at normal temperatures, which keeps our atmosphere safe and dilutes the oxygen so things don't burn too easily.

title: Noble Gas na Punong Shell
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi nagre-react ang mga noble gases?

Ang helium, neon, at argon ay may punong outermost electron shells! Dahil stable na sila, hindi na kailangan ng iba pang bonds.
fact_en:
Why don't noble gases react with other elements?

Helium, neon, and argon have full outermost electron shells! Since they're already stable, they don't need to form bonds with anything.

title: Suction Cup sa Air Pressure
fact_tl:
Paano nakakapit ang isang suction cup sa dingding?

Kapag pinindot mo ito, nailalabas ang hangin sa loob! Ang mas mataas na air pressure sa labas ang nagtutulak sa cup nang malakas sa dingding para makapit.
fact_en:
How does a suction cup stick firmly to a wall?

When you press it, air is pushed out from inside! The higher air pressure outside then pushes the cup firmly against the wall to hold it in place.

title: Deep-Sea Fish at Water Pressure
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa mga isda sa malalim na dagat kapag dinala sa ibabaw?

Sanay na ang mga deep-sea fish sa napakataas na water pressure sa ilalim! Kung dinala sa ibabaw, ang biglaang pagbaba ng pressure ay pwedeng makasira sa kanilang katawan.
fact_en:
What happens to deep-sea fish if they are brought to the surface?

Deep-sea fish are adapted to very high water pressure at depth! If brought to the surface, the sudden drop in pressure can damage their bodies.

title: High vs Low Pressure Weather
fact_tl: Sa meteorolohiya, ang high-pressure system ay nagdudulot ng malinaw at maayos na panahon! Ang low-pressure system naman ay nagdadala ng ulap, ulan, at pwedeng maging bagyo.
fact_en: In meteorology, a high-pressure system brings clear, calm weather! But a low-pressure system brings cloudy, rainy skies and can even grow into a typhoon.

title: Copper Sulfate Blue Crystals
fact_tl: Ang copper sulfate ay gumagawa ng magagandang asul na kristal kapag dahan-dahang pinasingaw ang solusyon nito. Ginagamit ito sa school laboratories para magturo ng crystal growing!
fact_en: Copper sulfate forms beautiful blue crystals when its solution is slowly evaporated. It's used in school laboratories to teach crystal growing!

title: Timbangang Triple Beam
fact_tl: Ang triple beam balance ay isang timbangan sa school lab na sumusukat ng mass nang tumpak hanggang daan-daang gram gamit ang tatlong sliding weights sa tatlong beams!
fact_en: A triple beam balance is a school lab scale that measures mass accurately to tenths of a gram using three sliding weights on three beams!

title: Batas Boyle Syringe
fact_tl:
Paano nagpapakita ng syringe ng Batas ni Boyle?

Kapag hinawakan mo ang dulo ng syringe at tinulak ang plunger, ang hangin ay naco-compress at tumataas ang pressure! Bitawan ito, at itutulak ito pabalik ng mas mataas na pressure, na nagpapakita ng Batas ni Boyle.
fact_en:
How does a syringe show Boyle's Law?

If you block a syringe tip and push the plunger, trapped air compresses and pressure increases! Release it, and the higher pressure pushes it back out, demonstrating Boyle's Law.

title: Gas Walang Fixed Hugis
fact_tl: Walang fixed shape o volume ang mga gas! Pwede silang i-compress, pinupuno ang anumang container, at napakababa ng density kumpara sa solids at liquids.
fact_en: Gases have no fixed shape or volume! They can be compressed, fill any container, and have very low density compared to solids and liquids.

title: Tatlong Estado Tubig
fact_tl:
Makikita mo ba ang lahat ng tatlong estado ng tubig dito sa Pilipinas?

Oo! Yelo (solid) sa mga freezer at tuktok ng Benguet, likidong tubig sa mga ilog at dagat, at singaw ng tubig (gas) sa hangin bilang halumigmig at ulap!
fact_en:
Can you find all three states of water right here in the Philippines?

Yes! Ice (solid) in freezers and Benguet peaks, liquid water in rivers and seas, and water vapour (gas) in the air as humidity and clouds!

title: Suction Cup at Air Pressure
fact_tl: Gumagana ang suction cup ng phone holder dahil sa air pressure! Kapag pinindot sa salamin, lumalabas ang hangin, at atmospheric pressure sa labas ang humahawak nito.
fact_en: Suction cups for phone holders work because of air pressure! Pressing it on glass squeezes air out, and atmospheric pressure outside holds it in place.

title: Mais Con Yelo
fact_tl: Sa mais con yelo, ang dinurog na yelo ay unti-unting natutunaw mula solido tungo sa likido habang sumisipsip ng init mula sa gatas at mais sa paligid.
fact_en: In mais con yelo, the shaved ice slowly melts from solid to liquid as it absorbs heat from the milk and corn around it.

title: Sunken Ship Air Bags Buoyant
fact_tl: Para itaas ang nalubog na barko mula sa ilalim ng dagat, nagkakabit ang mga salvagers ng malalaking air bags! Kapag napuno ng hangin, ang buoyant force ay nagtataas ng barko pataas.
fact_en: To raise a sunken ship from the ocean floor, salvagers attach large air bags to it! When filled with air, the resulting buoyant force easily lifts the ship upward.

title: Cu ng Copper Mula Cuprum
fact_tl:
Saan galing ang simbolong kemikal ng copper?

Ang simbolo ng copper ay Cu, mula sa Latin na 'cuprum'!
fact_en:
Where does the chemical symbol for copper come from?

The symbol for copper is Cu, from the Latin word 'cuprum'!

title: Sn ng Tin Mula Stannum
fact_tl:
Ano ang simbolong kemikal ng tin?

Ang simbolo ng tin ay Sn, mula sa Latin na 'stannum'!
fact_en:
What is the chemical symbol for tin?

The symbol for tin is Sn, which comes from the Latin word 'stannum'!

title: Hg ng Mercury Mula Hydrargyrum
fact_tl: Ang simbolong kemikal ng mercury ay Hg, mula sa Latin na 'hydrargyrum'!
fact_en: The chemical symbol for mercury is Hg, from the Latin word 'hydrargyrum'!

title: W ng Tungsten Mula Wolfram
fact_tl: Ang simbolong kemikal ng tungsten ay W! Ang cool na letrang ito ay galing sa pangalang 'wolfram'.
fact_en: The chemical symbol for tungsten is W! This cool letter comes from its other name, 'wolfram'.

title: Au ng Ginto hindi Go
fact_tl: Ang ginto ay Au, hindi 'Go'! Ang simbolo nito ay galing sa salitang Latin na 'aurum'.
fact_en: Gold is Au, not 'Go'! Its symbol comes from the Latin word 'aurum', not its English name.

title: Fe ng Iron hindi Ir
fact_tl: Ang bakal ay Fe, hindi 'Ir'! Ang simbolo nito ay galing sa salitang Latin na 'ferrum'.
fact_en: Iron is Fe, not 'Ir'! Its symbol comes from the Latin word 'ferrum', which is a fun fact.

title: K ng Potassium hindi Po
fact_tl: Ang potassium ay K, hindi 'Po'! Ang simbolo nito ay galing sa salitang Latin na 'kalium'.
fact_en: Potassium is K, not 'Po'! Its symbol comes from the Latin word 'kalium'.

title: Pb ng Lead hindi Le
fact_tl: Ang lead (tingga) ay Pb, hindi 'Le'! Ang simbolo nito ay galing sa salitang Latin na 'plumbum'.
fact_en: Lead is Pb, not 'Le'! Its symbol comes from the Latin word 'plumbum'.

title: Group 18 ng Noble Gas
fact_tl: Ang mga noble gas tulad ng helium at neon ay nasa group 18 ng periodic table!
fact_en: Noble gases like helium and neon belong to group 18 of the periodic table!

title: Deposition Mula Gas sa Solid
fact_tl:
Ano ang deposition sa science?

Ito ay kapag ang gas ay nagbabago nang direkta sa solido nang hindi nagiging likido, tulad ng pagbuo ng frost!
fact_en:
What is deposition in science?

It is when a gas changes directly into a solid without becoming a liquid first, just like frost forming!

title: John Dalton sa Atomic Theory
fact_tl: Si John Dalton ang nagpasimuno ng modernong teoryang atomiko, na nagsabing ang lahat ng bagay ay gawa sa maliliit na atomo!
fact_en: John Dalton proposed the modern atomic theory, stating that all matter is made of tiny atoms!

title: Gold Foil Experiment sa Nucleus
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Rutherford ang nucleus gamit ang gold foil experiment! Pinaputok niya ang maliliit na particle sa manipis na pirasong ginto.
fact_en: Rutherford discovered the nucleus using the gold foil experiment! He fired tiny particles at a super thin sheet of gold.

title: Purong Tubig pH 7 Neutral
fact_tl:
Ano ang pH ng purong tubig?

Alam mo ba? Ang purong tubig ay may pH na 7, kaya ito ay perfectly neutral!
fact_en:
What is the pH of pure water?

Did you know? Pure water has a pH of exactly 7, which means it is perfectly neutral!

title: Baking Soda Basic pH 9
fact_tl:
Ano ang pH ng baking soda?

Alam mo ba na ang baking soda ay basic, na may pH na mga 9?
fact_en:
What is the pH of baking soda?

Did you know that baking soda is basic, with a pH of about 9?

title: Dugo Bahagyang Base pH 7.4
fact_tl: Ang dugo mo ay bahagyang base! May pH ito na mga 7.4.
fact_en: Your blood is slightly basic! It has a pH of about 7.4.

title: Orange Juice pH 3-4
fact_tl: Ang orange juice ay asido (acidic)! Ang pH niya ay mga 3 hanggang 4.
fact_en: Orange juice is acidic! Its pH is about 3 to 4.

title: Gatas pH 6.5 Bahagya
fact_tl: Ang gatas ay bahagyang asido, may pH na mga 6.5.
fact_en: Milk is slightly acidic, with a pH of about 6.5.

title: Kape Asido pH 5
fact_tl:
Asido ba ang kape ng mga magulang mo sa umaga?

Oo! Ang kape ay asido (acidic), may pH na mga 5.
fact_en:
Is your parents' morning coffee acidic?

Yes! Coffee is acidic, with a pH of about 5.

title: Tubig-Dagat pH 8 Base
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba na ang ating mga karagatan ay bahagyang base?

Oo! Ang tubig-dagat ay bahagyang base, na may pH na mga 8.
fact_en:
Did you know our oceans are a little bit basic?

Yes! Seawater is actually slightly basic, with a pH of about 8.

title: Ammonia Base pH 11
fact_tl:
Ang ammonia ba ay asido o base?

Ito ay base (basic)! Ang ammonia ay base, na may pH na mga 11.
fact_en:
Is ammonia an acid or a base?

It is basic! Ammonia is basic, with a pH of about 11.

title: Softdrink pH 2.5-3
fact_tl:
Ano ang pH level ng paborito mong soft drinks?

Ang softdrink (soda) ay asido (acidic), na may pH na mga 2.5 hanggang 3!
fact_en:
What is the pH level of your favorite soft drinks?

Soft drinks (soda) are acidic, with a pH of about 2.5 to 3!

title: Tubig-Ulan pH 5.6
fact_tl:
Ang normal na tubig-ulan ba ay completely neutral?

Hindi! Ang normal na tubig-ulan ay bahagyang asido, na may pH na mga 5.6.
fact_en:
Is normal rainwater completely neutral?

Not quite! Normal rainwater is slightly acidic, with a pH of about 5.6.

title: Diamanteng Purong Karbon
fact_tl: Alam mo ba? Ang makintab na diamante ay gawa sa purong carbon (karbon)!
fact_en: Did you know? A shiny diamond is actually made entirely of pure carbon!

title: Gintong Hindi Kinakalawang
fact_tl: Hindi kailanman kinakalawang o nako-corrode ang ginto (gold), kaya nananatili itong makintab!
fact_en: Gold never rusts or corrodes, which is why it always stays so beautifully shiny!

title: Unang Babaeng Panalo sa Nobel
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang babaeng nanalo ng Nobel Prize?

Si Marie Curie! Nanalo siya sa Physics noong 1903.
fact_en:
Who was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize?

Marie Curie! She won in Physics in 1903.

title: Dalawang Nobel Prize
fact_tl:
Sino ang tanging tao na nanalo ng Nobel Prize sa dalawang agham?

Si Marie Curie! Nanalo siya sa Physics (1903) at Chemistry (1911).
fact_en:
Who is the only person to win Nobel Prizes in two different sciences?

Marie Curie! She won in Physics (1903) and Chemistry (1911).

title: Unang Nobel sa Physics 1901
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang nanalo ng Nobel Prize sa Physics?

Si Wilhelm Roentgen! Nanalo siya noong 1901 para sa X-rays.
fact_en:
Who won the very first Nobel Prize in Physics?

Wilhelm Roentgen! He won in 1901 for X-rays.

title: Dalawang Nobel Prize
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang tao na nanalo ng dalawang Nobel Prize?

Si Marie Curie! Nanalo siya ng dalawang Nobel Prize, isa sa Physics at isa sa Chemistry.
fact_en:
Who was the first person to win two Nobel Prizes?

Marie Curie! She won two Nobel Prizes, one in Physics and one in Chemistry.

title: Absolute Zero -273
fact_tl: Ang absolute zero ang pinakamababang posibleng temperatura! Ito ay mga -273 degrees Celsius.
fact_en: Absolute zero is the lowest possible temperature! It is about -273 degrees Celsius.

title: 0 Kelvin na Absolute Zero
fact_tl: Sa Kelvin scale, ang absolute zero ay 0 Kelvin (0 K)! Ito ay katumbas ng mga -273°C.
fact_en: On the Kelvin scale, absolute zero is 0 Kelvin (0 K)! This equals about -273°C.

title: 212 Degrees Fahrenheit
fact_tl: Sa Fahrenheit scale, ang tubig ay kumukulo sa 212 degrees Fahrenheit (212°F)! Ito ay katumbas ng 100°C.
fact_en: On the Fahrenheit scale, water boils at 212 degrees Fahrenheit (212°F)! This is equal to 100°C.

title: Nitrogen, Pinakamaraming Gas
fact_tl: Ang pinakamaraming gas sa hangin ay nitrogen! Bumubuo ito ng halos 78% ng hangin na ating hinihinga.
fact_en: The most abundant gas in the air is nitrogen! It makes up about 78% of the air we breathe.

title: Mercury, Likidong Metal
fact_tl: Ang mercury (asoge) ang tanging metal na likido sa karaniwang temperatura, na may symbol na Hg!
fact_en: Mercury is the only metal that is liquid at room temperature, with the symbol Hg!

title: Yelong Mas Magaan sa Tubig
fact_tl: Lumulutang ang yelo sa tubig dahil mas magaan (mas mababa ang density) ito kaysa sa likidong tubig. Kaya lumulutang ang yelo sa iyong baso!
fact_en: Ice floats on water because it is less dense (lighter) than liquid water. That is why ice cubes bob around in your glass!

title: Joseph Aspdin sa Portland Cement
fact_tl:
Sino ang nag-imbento ng modernong Portland cement?

Si Joseph Aspdin ang nag-imbento niito noong 1824!
fact_en:
Who invented modern Portland cement?

Joseph Aspdin invented it in 1824!

title: John Walker Match 1826
fact_tl: Ang unang friction match na kinukuskos para sumindi ay imben-to ni John Walker noong 1826!
fact_en: The very first friction match you strike to light was invented by John Walker way back in 1826!

title: Hydrogen Atomic Number 1
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng hydrogen (H) ay 1, ibig sabihin ay may 1 proton ito!
fact_en: The atomic number of hydrogen (H) is 1, which means it has exactly 1 proton!

title: Helium Atomic Number 2
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng helium (He) ay 2, kaya may 2 proton ito!
fact_en: The atomic number of helium (He) is 2, so it has exactly 2 protons!

title: Lithium Atomic Number 3
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng lithium (Li) ay 3, kaya may 3 proton ito!
fact_en: The atomic number of lithium (Li) is 3, so it has exactly 3 protons!

title: Carbon Atomic Number 6
fact_tl: Ang atomic number ng carbon (C) ay 6, kaya may 6 proton ito!
fact_en: The atomic number of carbon (C) is 6, so it has exactly 6 protons!

title: Nitrogen Atomic Number 7
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na ang atomic number ng nitrogen (N) ay 7? Ibig sabihin, may 7 proton ang bawat nitrogen atom!
fact_en: Did you know nitrogen (N) has an atomic number of 7? That means every nitrogen atom is packed with exactly 7 protons!

title: Oxygen Atomic Number 8
fact_tl: Ang oxygen (O) ay may atomic number na 8! Dahil dito, ang bawat oxygen atom ay may 8 proton.
fact_en: Oxygen (O) has an atomic number of 8! Because of this, every single oxygen atom contains exactly 8 protons.

title: Fluorine Atomic Number 9
fact_tl: Ang fluorine (F) ay may atomic number na 9. Ibig sabihin, ito ay binubuo ng exactly 9 na proton!
fact_en: Fluorine (F) has an atomic number of 9. This means it is made up of exactly 9 protons!

title: Neon Atomic Number 10
fact_tl:
Ilan ang proton ng neon (Ne)?

Ang atomic number ng neon (Ne) ay 10, kaya may 10 proton ito!
fact_en:
How many protons does neon (Ne) have?

Neon (Ne) has an atomic number of 10, which means it has exactly 10 protons!

title: Sodium Atomic Number 11
fact_tl: Ang sodium (Na) ay may atomic number na 11! Ibig sabihin, ang bawat sodium atom ay may 11 proton.
fact_en: Sodium (Na) has an atomic number of 11! That means every sodium atom is packed with 11 protons.

title: Magnesium Atomic Number 12
fact_tl:
Ano ang atomic number ng magnesium (Mg)?

Ang atomic number ng magnesium (Mg) ay 12, kaya may 12 proton ito!
fact_en:
What is the atomic number of magnesium (Mg)?

Magnesium (Mg) has an atomic number of 12, meaning it has exactly 12 protons!

title: Friedrich Mohs sa Hardness Scale
fact_tl: Kilalanin si Friedrich Mohs! Siyang German na siyentipiko na gumawa ng Mohs hardness scale noong taong 1812.
fact_en: Meet Friedrich Mohs! This German scientist created the Mohs hardness scale way back in the year 1812.

title: 0.2 Gramo sa Isang Carat
fact_tl: Ang isang carat ay panukat ng bigat ng hiyas, at ito ay katumbas ng 0.2 gramo o 200 milligrams!
fact_en: One carat is the unit for a gem's weight, and it equals exactly 0.2 grams or 200 milligrams!

title: 10 Antas ng Mohs Scale
fact_tl:
Ilan ang baytang sa Mohs hardness scale?

Ang Mohs hardness scale ay may 10 baytang, mula sa talc (1) hanggang sa diamante (10)!
fact_en:
How many levels are on the Mohs hardness scale?

The Mohs hardness scale has 10 levels, from talc at number 1 all the way to diamond at number 10!

title: Helium na Hindi Nagiging Solid
fact_tl: Ang helium ang tanging elemento na hindi nagiging solid sa normal na presyon, gaano man kalamig!
fact_en: Helium is the only element that does not freeze into a solid at normal pressure, no matter how cold!

title: Lutang o Lubog sa Densidad
fact_tl: Lumulutang sa tubig ang bagay kung mas mababa ang densidad nito sa 1 g/mL, at lumulubog kung mas mataas!
fact_en: An object floats in water if its density is less than 1 g/mL, and sinks if it is more!

title: Robert Boyle 1662
fact_tl: Kilalanin natin ang siyentipiko! Ang Batas ni Boyle ay tinuklas ng Irish na siyentipikong si Robert Boyle noong 1662.
fact_en: Meet the mind behind the science! Boyle's law was discovered by the Irish scientist Robert Boyle in 1662.

title: Jacques Charles 1787
fact_tl: Ang Batas ni Charles ay ipinangalan kay French scientist Jacques Charles, na nagtuklas nito noong 1787!
fact_en: Charles's law is named after French scientist Jacques Charles, who discovered it around 1787!

title: Joseph Gay-Lussac 1800s
fact_tl: Ang Batas ni Gay-Lussac ay ipinangalan kay French chemist Joseph Louis Gay-Lussac, na naglarawan nito noong early 1800s!
fact_en: Gay-Lussac's law is named after French chemist Joseph Louis Gay-Lussac, who described it in the early 1800s!

title: Amedeo Avogadro 1811
fact_tl: Ang Batas ni Avogadro ay iminungkahi ng Italian scientist na si Amedeo Avogadro noong 1811!
fact_en: Avogadro's law was proposed by Italian scientist Amedeo Avogadro way back in 1811!

title: PV = nRT na Ideal Gas
fact_tl: Ang Batas ng Ideal na Gas ay nasa ekwasyong PV = nRT! Pinagsasama nito ang presyon, volume, dami ng mole, at temperatura.
fact_en: The ideal gas law uses the equation PV = nRT! It combines pressure, volume, number of moles, and temperature together.

title: PV/T ng Combined Gas Law
fact_tl:
Ano ang ginagawa ng combined gas law?

Pinagsasama nito ang mga batas nina Boyle, Charles, at Gay-Lussac sa isang relasyon: PV/T = constant!
fact_en:
What does the combined gas law do?

It merges the laws of Boyle, Charles, and Gay-Lussac into one single relationship: PV/T = constant!

title: Boyle Law P1V1 = P2V2
fact_tl:
Paano isinusulat ang Batas ni Boyle?

Isinusulat ito bilang P₁V₁ = P₂V₂! Ibig sabihin, pare-pareho ang produkto ng presyon at volume.
fact_en:
How is Boyle's law written?

It is written as P₁V₁ = P₂V₂! This means the product of pressure and volume stays constant.

title: Charles Law V1/T1 = V2/T2
fact_tl: Ang Batas ni Charles ay isinusulat bilang V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂! Dito, pare-pareho ang ratio ng volume sa temperatura sa Kelvin.
fact_en: Charles's law is written as V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂! Here, the ratio of volume to temperature in Kelvin stays constant.

title: Gay-Lussac P1/T1 = P2/T2
fact_tl:
Ano ang ekwasyon para sa Batas ni Gay-Lussac?

Isinusulat ito bilang P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂! Pare-pareho ang ratio ng presyon sa temperatura sa Kelvin.
fact_en:
What is the equation for Gay-Lussac's law?

It is written as P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂! The ratio of pressure to temperature in Kelvin stays constant.

title: PV = nRT
fact_tl: Sa ideal gas equation na PV = nRT, ang letter n ay tumutukoy sa number of moles ng gas.
fact_en: In the ideal gas equation PV = nRT, the letter n stands for the number of moles of gas.

title: Avogadro Italyanong Siyentista
fact_tl: Si Amedeo Avogadro, ang siyentipiko sa likod ng Batas ni Avogadro, ay isang Italyanong siyentipiko — ang galing, 'di ba?
fact_en: Amedeo Avogadro, the man behind Avogadro's law, was an Italian scientist — how cool is that?

title: Fission noong 1938
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang nuclear fission noong 1938 nina Otto Hahn at Fritz Strassmann, at ipinaliwanag nina Lise Meitner at Otto Frisch!
fact_en: Nuclear fission was discovered in 1938 by Otto Hahn and Fritz Strassmann, and explained by Lise Meitner and Otto Frisch!

title: Dalawang Nobel Prize
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang tao na nanalo ng DALAWANG Nobel Prize?

Si Marie Curie! Siya ang unang tao, nanalo sa Physics (1903) at Chemistry (1911).
fact_en:
Who was the first person to win TWO Nobel Prizes?

Marie Curie! She was the very first person, winning in Physics (1903) and Chemistry (1911).

title: Kilogram, SI Unit ng Masa
fact_tl: Sa siyensya, ang kilogram (kg) ang batayang yunit ng masa sa sistemang SI. Ito ang pamantayan!
fact_en: In science, the kilogram (kg) is the official SI base unit of mass. It's the standard!

title: Metro, SI Unit ng Haba
fact_tl: Para sa pagsukat kung gaano kahaba, ang metro (m) ang batayang yunit ng haba sa sistemang SI.
fact_en: For measuring how long things are, the meter (m) is the SI base unit of length.

title: Metric System na Base Sampu
fact_tl:
Bakit napakadaling gamitin ng metric system?

Ang metric system ay nakabatay sa sampu, kaya ang mga yunit ay 10, 100, o 1,000 ang pagitan!
fact_en:
Why is the metric system so easy to use?

The metric system is based on tens, so units differ by 10, 100, or 1,000!

title: Clara Lim-Sylianco Chemistry
fact_tl:
Sino si Clara Lim-Sylianco?

Si Clara Lim-Sylianco ay isang Pilipinong siyentista sa larangan ng chemistry!
fact_en:
Who was Clara Lim-Sylianco?

Clara Lim-Sylianco was a Filipino scientist in the field of chemistry!

title: Lim-Sylianco, Unang Filipina
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang babaeng Pilipina na ginawarang Pambansang Siyentista?

Si Clara Lim-Sylianco ang gumawa ng kasaysayan noong 1994 bilang unang babaeng Pilipina na ginawarang Pambansang Siyentista ng Pilipinas!
fact_en:
Who was the very first Filipina to be named a National Scientist?

Clara Lim-Sylianco made history in 1994 as the first Filipina woman to be named a National Scientist of the Philippines!

title: Methyl Orange pH
fact_tl: Ang methyl orange ay nagbabago mula pula tungo sa dilaw sa pH na mga 3.1 hanggang 4.4!
fact_en: Methyl orange changes from red to yellow over about pH 3.1 to 4.4!

title: Group 18 ng Noble Gases
fact_tl: Ang mga noble gas ay nasa Group 18 ng periodic table, at halos hindi sila nakikipagreaksyon sa ibang elemento!
fact_en: The noble gases live in Group 18 of the periodic table, and they almost never react with other elements!

title: Group 1 ng Alkali Metals
fact_tl:
Aling grupo ng metal ang kilala sa pagiging super reactive?

Ang mga alkali metal! Nasa Group 1 sila ng periodic table at napakareactive nilang mga metal.
fact_en:
Which group of metals is known for being super reactive?

The alkali metals! They are in Group 1 of the periodic table and are very reactive metals.

title: Group 2 ng Alkaline Earth
fact_tl:
Saan natin makikita ang mga alkaline earth metal?

Makikita mo ang mga alkaline earth metal sa Group 2 ng periodic table!
fact_en:
Where can we find the alkaline earth metals?

You can find the alkaline earth metals in Group 2 of the periodic table!

title: Noble Gas at Electron Shell
fact_tl: Ang mga noble gas ay hindi nakikipagreaksyon dahil puno na ang kanilang panlabas na electron shell!
fact_en: Noble gases are completely unreactive because their outer electron shell is already totally full!

title: Hydrogen Hindi Alkali Metal
fact_tl: Ang hydrogen (H) ay nasa Group 1, pero hindi ito alkali metal — ito ay isang gas, hindi metal!
fact_en: Hydrogen (H) sits in Group 1, but it's not an alkali metal — it's a gas, not a metal at all!

title: Mercury, Likidong Metal
fact_tl: Ang mercury (Hg) ay isang transition metal na nananatiling likido sa karaniwang temperatura — dating ginagamit ito sa loob ng thermometer!
fact_en: Mercury (Hg) is a transition metal that stays liquid at room temperature — it was once used inside thermometers!

title: Likido hanggang Solid
fact_tl:
Paano nagiging matigas na ice drop ang matamis na tubig?

Dahil sa sobrang lamig! Sa freezing temperatures, ang likido ay nagyeyelo at nagiging solidong ice drop.
fact_en:
How does sweet liquid become a hard ice drop?

Extreme cold changes it! At freezing temperatures, the liquid freezes and turns into a solid ice drop.

title: Baking Soda NaHCO3
fact_tl: Ang siyentipikong pangalan ng baking soda ay sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3). Siyensya sa kusina mo!
fact_en: The scientific name of baking soda is sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3). Science in your kitchen!

title: Emerald, Berdeng Beryl
fact_tl:
Ano ang emerald?

Ito ay isang berdeng uri ng mineral na beryl, na berde dahil sa chromium at vanadium!
fact_en:
What is an emerald?

It is a green variety of the mineral beryl, colored green by chromium and vanadium!

title: Radium nina Curie
fact_tl: Ang kamanghang-manghang na mag-asawang siyentipiko na sina Marie at Pierre Curie ang tumuklas ng elementong radium noong 1898!
fact_en: The amazing science team of Marie and Pierre Curie discovered the element radium in 1898!

title: Unang Babaeng Nobel Marie
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang babaeng nanalo ng Nobel Prize?

Si Marie Curie! Nanalo siya sa Physics noong 1903.
fact_en:
Who was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize?

Marie Curie! She won it in Physics in 1903.

title: Walang Katapusang Decimal ng Pi
fact_tl:
Nagsasara ba balang ang mga decimal ng pi?

Ang mga decimal ng pi (3.14159...) ay walang katapusan at hindi paulit-ulit! Kaya ginagamit lang natin ang 3.14 bilang rounded value.
fact_en:
Do the decimals of pi ever stop?

The decimals of pi (3.14159...) never end and never repeat! That is why we just use 3.14 as a rounded value.

title: 90 Degrees na Right Angle
fact_tl: Ang isang right angle ay may sukat na eksaktong 90 degrees! Madali mo itong makikita sa kanto ng isang perpektong parisukat.
fact_en: A right angle measures exactly 90 degrees! You can easily spot one right in the corner of a perfect square.

title: Arabic Numerals 0-9
fact_tl:
Saan nanggaling ang mga numerong ginagamit natin araw-araw?

Ang mga numerong ginagamit natin (0 hanggang 9) ay tinatawag na Arabic numerals! Nagmula sila sa India at ipinakalat ng mga Arabo.
fact_en:
Where did our everyday numbers come from?

The numbers we use (0 to 9) are called Arabic numerals! They originally came from India and were spread around the world by the Arabs.

title: Nobel Prize ni J.J. Thomson
fact_tl:
Kailan nanalo si J.J. Thomson ng Nobel Prize sa Physics?

Nanalo siya ng Nobel Prize sa Physics noong 1906!
fact_en:
When did J.J. Thomson win the Nobel Prize in Physics?

He won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1906!

title: Oxygen Pinakamarami Katawan
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamaraming elemento sa loob ng katawan mo?

Ito ang oxygen! Dahil ang katawan natin ay karamihan tubig, ang oxygen ang pinakamaraming elemento sa loob natin!
fact_en:
What's the most common element inside your body?

It's oxygen! Since our bodies are mostly water, oxygen is the most abundant element inside all of us!

title: 118 Elemento Periodic Table
fact_tl: Ang periodic table ay parang malaking pamilya ng siyensya! Sa ngayon, may 118 na kilalang elemento dito.
fact_en: The periodic table is like a big science family! Right now, there are exactly 118 known elements in it.

title: Elemento Numero 2
fact_tl:
Aling elemento ang kumuha ng numero 2 na puwesto sa periodic table?

Ang helium (He) ang sagot! Ito ang may numero 2 na puwesto sa periodic table.
fact_en:
Which element takes the number 2 spot on the periodic table?

Helium (He) is the answer! It proudly holds the number 2 spot on the periodic table.

title: Uranium 92 Pinakamabigat Natural
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamabigat na likas na elemento na makikita sa Earth?

Ang uranium (U), elemento numero 92, ang kampeon! Ito ang pinakamabigat na likas na elemento.
fact_en:
What is the heaviest natural element found on Earth?

Uranium (U), element number 92, is the champion! It is the heaviest natural element.

title: Nobel Prize ni Marie Curie
fact_tl:
Ilang Nobel Prize ang napanalunan ni Marie Curie?

Si Marie Curie ay nanalo ng dalawang (2) Nobel Prize — sa Physics at sa Chemistry, isang napakagandang tagumpay!
fact_en:
How many Nobel Prizes did Marie Curie win?

Marie Curie won two (2) Nobel Prizes — one in Physics and one in Chemistry, a huge achievement!

title: Unang Babaeng Nobel
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang babaeng nanalo ng Nobel Prize?

Ginawa ni Marie Curie ang kasaysayan nang manalo siya ng Nobel Prize sa Physics noong 1903!
fact_en:
Who was the very first woman to win a Nobel Prize?

Marie Curie made history when she won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903!

title: Dalawang Nobel Prize ni Curie
fact_tl: Kilalanin natin si Marie Curie! Siya ang unang taong nanalo ng dalawang Nobel Prize, isa sa Physics at isa sa Chemistry!
fact_en: Meet Marie Curie! She made history as the very first person to win two Nobel Prizes, one in Physics and another in Chemistry!

title: Friedrich Mohs noong 1812
fact_tl: Ginawa ng isang German geologist na si Friedrich Mohs ang Mohs scale noong taong 1812!
fact_en: A German geologist named Friedrich Mohs created the Mohs scale way back in the year 1812!

title: Sorensen pH noong 1909
fact_tl: Ang pH scale ay ipinakilala ng Danish na siyentipiko na si Søren Sørensen noong 1909!
fact_en: The pH scale was introduced by the Danish scientist Søren Sørensen way back in 1909!

title: Asido ng Tiyan pH 1-2
fact_tl: Ang asido sa tiyan ay napakalakas! May pH na halos 1 hanggang 2, isa ito sa pinakaasido sa katawan.
fact_en: Stomach acid is very strong! With a pH of about 1 to 2, it is one of the most acidic things in the body.

title: Baking Soda na pH 9
fact_tl: Ang baking soda ay base (alkaline)! May pH ito na halos 9.
fact_en: Baking soda is basic (alkaline)! It has a pH of about 9.

title: Steel Cable ng San Juanico
fact_tl: Ang solid na steel suspension cables ng San Juanico Bridge ay may mataas na tensile strength para masuportahan nang maayos ang mga mabibigat na load!
fact_en: The solid steel suspension cables of the San Juanico Bridge have high tensile strength, which helps them support very heavy loads safely!

title: Bamboo Incubator ni del Mundo
fact_tl: Ang bamboo incubator ni Dr. Fe del Mundo ay may liquid water sa base na nag-e-evaporate into water vapor gas para mapanatiling mainit ang sanggol!
fact_en: Dr. Fe del Mundo’s bamboo incubator uses liquid water in its base to evaporate into water vapor gas, keeping the baby warm!

title: Aerogel Solid na Halos Hangin
fact_tl: Ang aerogel ay isang solid na materyal na halos puro hangin! Napakagaan nito kaya kayang tumayo sa isang bulaklak nang hindi ito napipiga.
fact_en: Aerogel is a solid material made mostly of air! It is so incredibly light that it can balance on a delicate flower without crushing it.

title: Brass Solid Solution
fact_tl: Hindi laging likido ang solutions! Ang brass ay isang solid solution na gawa sa pinaghalong melted copper at zinc metals para maging isang solid.
fact_en: Solutions aren't always liquids! Brass is a solid solution made by mixing melted copper and zinc metals to form one solid.

title: Ginto Mas Mabigat sa Tubig
fact_tl:
Gaano kabigat ang purong ginto kumpara sa tubig?

Ang solid na bloke ng purong ginto ay may 19.3 beses na mas maraming masa kaysa sa eksaktong parehas na sukat na bloke ng purong likidong tubig!
fact_en:
How heavy is pure gold compared to water?

A solid block of pure gold has 19.3 times the mass of an exact same-sized block of pure liquid water!

title: Ice Candy na Physical Change
fact_tl:
Anong uri ng change ang nangyayari kapag gumagawa ng ice candy sa freezer?

Ito ay physical change lang! Ang likidong juice ay nag-change lang ng estado para maging ice candy.
fact_en:
What kind of change happens when you make ice candy in the freezer?

It is a physical change! The liquid juice only changes state to become solid ice candy.

title: Alcohol Lamp ni Gregorio Zara
fact_tl:
Paano gumagana ang flat arc alcohol lamp ni Gregorio Zara?

Sinusunog nito ang liquid alcohol para mag-produce ng heat at light! Napakagaling ng imbensyon na ito.
fact_en:
How does Gregorio Zara's flat arc alcohol lamp work?

It burns liquid alcohol to produce heat and light! This cool invention helps us see and stay warm.

title: Oxygen Molecule 480 m/s
fact_tl: Ang mga oxygen gas molecules ay gumagalaw nang napakabilis! Sa room temperature, tumatakbo sila ng roughly 480 meters per second, mas mabilis pa sa jet!
fact_en: Wow, oxygen gas molecules move super fast! At room temperature, they zoom at roughly 480 meters per second, which is faster than a jet!

title: Roasted Pili Nuts sa Bicol
fact_tl: Ang pag-roast ng Pili nuts sa Bicol ay nagdudulot ng chemical change na permanenteng nagbabago ng kulay at lasa!
fact_en: Roasting Pili nuts in Bicol causes a chemical change that permanently alters their color and flavor!

title: 15 Grams na Aluminum Can
fact_tl: Ang karaniwang walang laman na aluminum soda can ay may timbang na 15 grams lang, kaya halos 30 times na mas magaan kaysa sa glass bottle!
fact_en: A standard empty aluminum soda can weighs only 15 grams, making it about 30 times lighter than a glass bottle!

title: Dalawang Gramo ng Gintong Sheet
fact_tl:
Gaano kamanipis ang pwedeng i-hammer sa purong ginto?

Ang purong ginto ay napakamalleable kaya kahit dalawang gramo lang ay maaaring i-hammer hanggang maging flat sheet na sumasakop sa one square meter!
fact_en:
How flat can pure gold be hammered?

Pure gold is so malleable that just two grams can be hammered into a flat sheet covering one square meter!

title: Melting Point ng Bawat Solid
fact_tl: Bawat solid ay may melting point — ang tiyak na temperatura kung saan nagiging likido ito. Ang purong yelo ay palaging natutunaw sa 0°C, pero ang bakal ay kailangan ng sobrang init para matunaw!
fact_en: Every solid has a melting point — the exact temperature where it turns to liquid. Pure ice always melts at 0°C, but iron needs super high heat to melt!

title: Coconut Oil na Nagiging Solid
fact_tl: Nagiging puting solid ang coconut oil mula sa malinaw na likido kapag bumaba ang temperatura sa ilalim ng 24°C!
fact_en: Coconut oil magically turns from a clear liquid into a white solid when the temperature drops below 24 degrees Celsius!

title: Dry Ice na Direktang Gas
fact_tl: Ang solid na dry ice sa normal na temperatura ay sumisipsip ng init at nagiging carbon dioxide gas nang hindi nagiging likido!
fact_en: Solid dry ice left at room temperature absorbs heat and changes directly into carbon dioxide gas without ever becoming a liquid!

title: Pagiging Gas ng Dry Ice
fact_tl:
Natutunaw ba ang dry ice sa likido?

Hindi! Ang solid carbon dioxide, na tinatawag na dry ice, ay direktang nagiging gas sa room temperature sa halip na matunaw.
fact_en:
Does dry ice melt into a liquid?

No! Solid carbon dioxide, called dry ice, sublimates directly into a gas at room temperature instead of melting.

title: Malamig na Baking Soda Reaction
fact_tl:
Bakit malamig ang baso kapag pinaghalo mo ang baking soda at citric acid sa tubig?

Nagkakaroon ng chemical reaction na sumisipsip ng init! Kinukuha nito ang init, kaya napakalamig ng baso.
fact_en:
Why does a cup feel cold when you mix baking soda and citric acid in water?

It causes a chemical reaction that absorbs heat! This endothermic reaction takes the heat away, making the cup feel cold.

title: Estado ng Virgin Coconut Oil
fact_tl:
Pwede bang magbago ang estado ng virgin coconut oil?

Oo! Ang virgin coconut oil ay liquid sa mainit na room temperature pero nagkakaroon ng physical change para maging solid kapag pinalamig.
fact_en:
Can virgin coconut oil change its state?

Yes! Virgin coconut oil is a liquid at warm room temperatures but undergoes a physical change to become a solid when chilled.

title: Tradisyonal na Milk Ice Candy
fact_tl:
Paano natin ginagawa ang tradisyonal na milk ice candy?

Pinagyeyelo natin ang liquid mixture ng carabao milk at asukal hanggang maging solid!
fact_en:
How do we make traditional milk ice candy?

We freeze a liquid mixture of carabao milk and sugar until it becomes a solid treat!

title: Electron Shell ng Noble Gas
fact_tl:
Bakit halos hindi nagbi-bond ang mga noble gases gaya ng helium at neon?

Puno na ang kanilang panlabas na shell ng electrons! Dahil puno na, stable na sila at hindi na kailangang mag-bond.
fact_en:
Why do noble gases like helium and neon hardly ever bond?

Their outer shell is already full of electrons! Because they are full, they are already stable and do not need to bond.

title: Quartz kaysa Calcite sa Beach
fact_tl: Ang quartz crystals sa mga dalampasigan ng Pilipinas ay mas matigas kaysa sa calcite shells, kaya mas matagal silang nananatiling butil ng buhangin!
fact_en: Quartz crystals on Philippine beaches are harder than calcite shells, which is why quartz survives longer as sand grains!

title: Laguna de Bay na Solusyon
fact_tl: Ang Laguna de Bay ay may aqueous solution kung saan ang dissolved solid salts at liquid water ay nag-mix uniformly sa molecular level!
fact_en: Laguna de Bay contains an aqueous solution where dissolved solid salts and liquid water mix uniformly at the molecular level!

title: Hamog mula sa Water Vapor
fact_tl:
Napapaisip ka ba kung saan galing ang hamog sa umaga?

Ito ay likidong tubig na nag-condense mula sa hindi nakikitang water vapor sa malamig na gabi!
fact_en:
Ever wonder where morning dew comes from?

It's liquid water that condensed from invisible water vapor in the cool night air!

title: Kalawang na Tatlong Beses Lawak
fact_tl: Kapag nag-rust ang bakal, maaari itong lumaki hanggang tatlong beses ng orihinal nitong volume at maghiwa-hiwalay!
fact_en: When iron undergoes a chemical change to form rust, it can expand up to three times its original volume and crumble!

title: Virgin Coconut Oil sa 24 Degrees
fact_tl: Ang purong virgin coconut oil ay nagiging likido mula sa solid kapag umabot sa halos 24 degrees Celsius!
fact_en: Pure virgin coconut oil melts from a solid into a clear liquid at about 24 degrees Celsius!

title: Double Bond ng Carbon Dioxide
fact_tl: Sa carbon dioxide (CO₂), ang carbon at bawat oxygen ay naghahati ng dalawang pares ng elektron, kaya may double bond sa pagitan nila!
fact_en: In carbon dioxide (CO₂), carbon and each oxygen share two pairs of electrons, creating a double bond between them!

title: Delikadong Gasolina Vapor
fact_tl:
Bakit delikado ang usok ng gasolina malapit sa bukas na apoy?

Mabilis na nag-e-evaporate ang gasolina sa room temperature at nagiging highly flammable na gas! Kaya ang usok nito ay madaling masunog malapit sa kahit anong bukas na apoy.
fact_en:
Why are gasoline vapors so dangerous near open flames?

Gasoline evaporates super fast at room temperature into a highly flammable gas! That's why its vapors can easily catch fire near any open flame.

title: Pintura Kontra Kalawang
fact_tl:
Paano pinipigilan ng pintura ang iron gates na kalawangin?

Ang pintura ay humaharang sa oxygen at water na makadikit sa metal, kaya napipigilan ang chemical change na nagdudulot ng rust!
fact_en:
How does painting stop iron gates from rusting?

Paint prevents oxygen and water from touching the metal, stopping the chemical change that causes rust!

title: Kalawang Mas Mabigat kaysa Bakal
fact_tl: Kapag nag-react ang bakal sa oxygen at tubig para maging rust, mas mabigat ang nabuong compound kaysa sa orihinal na piraso ng bakal!
fact_en: When iron reacts with oxygen and water to form rust, the resulting chemical compound actually weighs more than the original solid piece of iron!

title: Liquid Nitrogen Minus 196 C
fact_tl:
Gaano kalalamig ang liquid nitrogen?

Ang liquid nitrogen ay napakalamig, minus one hundred ninety-six degrees Celsius, at agad na nagyeyelo ng basang espongha na nagiging matigas sa pag-touch!
fact_en:
How cold is liquid nitrogen?

Liquid nitrogen is incredibly cold at minus one hundred ninety-six degrees Celsius, instantly freezing a wet sponge rock-hard upon contact!

title: Hindi Lahat ng Metal Solid
fact_tl:
Lahat ba ng metal ay solid?

Ang Mercury ay isang metal na likido kahit nasa room temperature, kaya hindi lahat ng metal ay solid!
fact_en:
Are all metals solid?

Mercury is a metallic element that exists as a liquid at room temperature, showing that not all metals are solid!

title: Bowling Ball Lutang sa Mercury
fact_tl:
Lilutang ba ang mabigat na steel bowling ball?

Oo! Ang liquid mercury ay isang metal na napaka-dense sa room temperature kaya lilutang ang mabigat na steel bowling ball sa ibabaw nito!
fact_en:
Can a heavy steel bowling ball float?

Yes! Liquid mercury is a metal so incredibly dense at room temperature that a heavy steel bowling ball will actually float on it!

title: Evaporation Hindi 100
fact_tl:
Kailangan ba mag-100 degrees Celsius para mag-evaporation ang tubig?

Hindi! Nangyayari ang evaporation kahit anong temperatura kapag ang surface water molecules ay nakakakuha ng enerhiya para maging gas.
fact_en:
Does water only evaporate when it boils at 100 degrees Celsius?

Nope! Evaporation happens at any temperature when surface water molecules gain energy to become gas, unlike boiling.

title: Ionic o Covalent
fact_tl: Karaniwang nagiging ionic bond kapag nagsama ang metal at di-metal, samantalang covalent bond naman kapag dalawang di-metal ang nagsama!
fact_en: A bond between a metal and a nonmetal is usually ionic, while a bond between two nonmetals is usually covalent!

title: Pag-init ng Metal Jar Lid
fact_tl: Kapag pinainit ang hugot na metal jar lid, mabilis na gumagalaw at lumalayo ang mga metal atoms, kaya lumalawak at lumaluwag ito!
fact_en: Heating a tightly closed metal jar lid makes its metal atoms move faster and spread apart, causing the lid to expand and loosen!

title: Iron Gall Ink ni Rizal
fact_tl:
Paano tumagal nang matagal ang sulat ni Jose Rizal sa Noli Me Tangere nang hindi kumukupas?

Ang iron gall ink na ginamit niya ay nag-chemical change, kaya permanente itong tumatak sa papel at hindi kailanman kumupas!
fact_en:
How did Jose Rizal's writing in Noli Me Tangere last so long without fading?

The iron gall ink he used underwent a chemical change, permanently staining the paper so it never faded!

title: Lemon pH 2 vs 7
fact_tl:
Bakit mas maasim ang lemon juice kaysa purong tubig?

Ang purong tubig ay may neutral na pH na eksaktong pito, habang ang maasim na lemon juice ay may napakababang pH na mga dalawa!
fact_en:
Why is lemon juice more acidic than pure water?

Pure water has a neutral pH of exactly seven, while acidic lemon juice has a much lower pH of about two!

title: Binasag na Tisa Physical Change
fact_tl: Kapag binasag ang solid na tisa sa pulbos, nagbabago lang ang physical size at shape nito, hindi ang chemical composition!
fact_en: Breaking solid chalk into dust only changes its physical size and shape, not its chemical composition or fundamental properties!

title: Tuba na Fermented Palm Wine
fact_tl:
Ano ang nagpapabula sa tuba?

Ang bumubula na likido ng tuba, isang palm wine galing sa Quezon, ay may alkohol na nabuo dahil sa chemical change ng fermentation!
fact_en:
What makes tuba bubble?

The bubbling liquid of tuba, a palm wine from Quezon Province, contains alcohol produced by the chemical change of fermentation!

title: Lutong Manok Laban sa Salmonella
fact_tl: Ang pagluluto ng hilaw na manok sa mataas na temperatura ay nagdudulot ng chemical changes sa meat proteins na pumapatay sa harmful bacteria tulad ng Salmonella para maiwasan ang food poisoning!
fact_en: Cooking raw chicken to a high temperature causes chemical changes in the meat proteins that destroy harmful bacteria like Salmonella to prevent food poisoning!

title: Coconut Coir Thermal Insulator
fact_tl:
Bakit ang dried coconut coir mula sa buko ay gumagana bilang thermal insulator?

Ang dried coconut coir mula sa buko ay kumikilos bilang thermal insulator dahil ang fibrous structure nito ay humahawak ng hangin at hindi masyadong nagdadala ng init!
fact_en:
Why does dried coconut coir from buko work as a thermal insulator?

Dried coconut coir from buko acts as a thermal insulator because its fibrous structure traps air and poorly conducts heat!

title: Coconut Oil na Physical Extract
fact_tl:
Paano kinukuha ang virgin coconut oil mula sa niyog?

Ang pagkuha nito ay isang pisikal na pagbabago kung saan ang likidong langis ay hinahati mula sa matigas na laman ng niyog!
fact_en:
How is virgin coconut oil extracted from the coconut?

Extracting virgin coconut oil involves a physical change where liquid oil is mechanically separated from the solid coconut meat!

title: Steam na Mas Malalang Burn
fact_tl:
Bakit nakakadulot ng matinding paso ang steam?

Kapag pinakuluan ang tubig, nagiging steam ito—isang gas na mabilis lumawak at maaaring magdulot ng matinding paso kung tatama sa balat!
fact_en:
Why can steam cause severe burns on your skin?

Boiling water turns liquid into steam, a gas that expands rapidly and can cause severe burns if it touches your skin!

title: Acid Rain sa Limestone Masungi
fact_tl: Ang maasim na ulan sa Masungi Georeserve ng Rizal ay nagdudulot ng chemical change sa pamamagitan ng pag-react sa solidong limestone rock formations para dahan-dahang tunawin ito sa mga kuweba!
fact_en: Acidic rainwater in Rizal's Masungi Georeserve causes a chemical change by reacting with solid limestone rock formations to slowly dissolve them into caves!

title: Espongha na Solid pa rin
fact_tl: Ang malalambot na materyales tulad ng espongha o bulak ay solid pa rin — may tiyak na hugis at volume sila, hindi tulad ng likido o gas!
fact_en: Soft materials like sponges or cotton are still solids — they keep a definite shape and volume, unlike liquids or gases!

title: Boiling Point ng Pressure Cooker
fact_tl: Ang pressure cooker ay nagkakulong ng steam para tumaas ang internal pressure, kaya tumataas ang boiling point ng tubig para maluto ang pagkain sa mas mataas na temperatura!
fact_en: A pressure cooker traps steam to increase internal pressure, raising the boiling point of water to cook food at higher temperatures!

title: Copper Wire Conductivity
fact_tl:
Bakit copper wires ang ginagamit ng mga electrician para sa kuryente?

Dahil ang copper ay solid metal na may mataas na electrical conductivity! Pinapadala nito ang kuryente nang madali sa mga wire para sa ating mga bahay.
fact_en:
Why do electricians use copper wires for electricity?

Because copper is a solid metal with high electrical conductivity! It lets electricity flow easily through the wires to power our homes.

title: Pagsubok ng Acidic o Basic
fact_tl:
Paano natin malalaman kung ang isang likido ay acidic o basic?

Gumagamit tayo ng litmus paper! Ito ay isang materyal na ginagamit bilang indicator para subukan kung ang isang likido ay acidic o basic.
fact_en:
How do we know if a liquid is acidic or basic?

We use litmus paper! It is a special material used as an indicator to test if a liquid solution is acidic or basic.

title: Photosynthesis CO2 Glucose
fact_tl: Sa photosynthesis, ginagamit ng mga halaman ang sikat ng araw para magsimula ng chemical change! Pinagsasama ang carbon dioxide at tubig para makagawa ng glucose.
fact_en: During photosynthesis, plants use sunlight to trigger a chemical change! They combine carbon dioxide gas and water to make glucose.

title: Bamboo Raft na Mababang Density
fact_tl: Ang kawayan sa mga bangkang kawayan ay may mababang density kaysa tubig. Kaya lumulutang ito at kayang suportahan ang bigat!
fact_en: Bamboo used in Filipino bamboo rafts has low density compared to water. That's why it floats and can support heavy weight!

title: Salad Spinner Force
fact_tl:
Paano pinapatuyo ng salad spinner ang nalabhan na lettuce?

Gumagamit ang salad spinner ng centrifugal force para paalisin ang tubig sa mga dahon ng lettuce. Ipinapakita nito kung paano nahihiwalay ang liquid mula sa solid!
fact_en:
How does a salad spinner dry washed lettuce?

A salad spinner uses centrifugal force to spin water away from lettuce leaves. It shows how we can physically separate a liquid from a solid!

title: Carbon Monoxide Detector
fact_tl:
Bakit kailangan ng mga tahanan ng carbon monoxide detectors?

Ang carbon monoxide ay mapanganib at walang amoy na gas mula sa pagsunog ng fuel! Tumatagil ito para maiwasan ang tahimik na pagkalason.
fact_en:
Why do homes need carbon monoxide detectors?

Carbon monoxide is a dangerous, odorless gas from burning fuels! Detectors help prevent silent poisoning.

title: Mud Pot ng Tiwi Albay
fact_tl:
Ano ang nasa loob ng mga putik na kawali sa Tiwi, Albay?

Sila ay mga heterogeneous mixtures na gawa sa liquid water, dissolved gases, at solid clay particles!
fact_en:
What is inside the bubbling mud pots of Tiwi, Albay?

They are actually heterogeneous mixtures made of liquid water, dissolved gases, and solid clay particles!

title: Noble Gas sa Group 18
fact_tl: Ang mga noble gas gaya ng helium, neon, at argon ay nasa Group 18. Halos hindi sila nakikipagreaksyon dahil puno na ang panlabas na shell nila!
fact_en: Noble gases like helium, neon, and argon are in Group 18. They almost never react because their outer electron shell is already full!

title: Alkali Metals sa Group 1
fact_tl:
Bakit napakareaktibo ng mga alkali metal gaya ng sodium at potassium sa Group 1?

Napakareaktibo nila dahil may isang valence electron lamang sila!
fact_en:
Why are alkali metals like sodium and potassium so reactive in Group 1?

They are very reactive because they have just one valence electron!

title: Hot Air Balloon sa Clark
fact_tl:
Bakit lumalawak ang mga hot air balloon sa Clark International Balloon Festival?

Lumalawak sila dahil ang pinainit na hangin sa loob ay lumalaki ang volume, kaya nagiging mas malaki!
fact_en:
Why do hot air balloons at the Clark International Balloon Festival expand?

They expand because the heated air inside increases in volume, making the balloon bigger!

title: Tooth Enamel Hydroxyapatite
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamalupit na solid na bahagi ng katawan mo?

Ang enamel ng ngipin mo! Ito ang pinakamalupit na solid na bagay sa katawan ng tao, gawa karamihan sa mineral na tinatawag na hydroxyapatite.
fact_en:
What's the hardest solid part of your body?

Your tooth enamel! It's the hardest solid substance in the human body, made mostly of a mineral called hydroxyapatite.

title: Frost Deposition sa Mount Apo
fact_tl: Minsan sa tuktok ng Mount Apo sa Davao, bumababa ang temperatura hanggang nagyeyelo! Kaya ang water vapor sa hangin ay nagde-deposit at nagiging solid frost.
fact_en: The summit of Mount Apo in Davao occasionally experiences freezing temperatures! This causes water vapor in the air to undergo deposition into solid frost.

title: Tubig 100 vs Ethanol 78 Kumulo
fact_tl:
Lahat ba ng likido ay kumukulo sa parehong temperatura?

Hindi! Ang purong tubig ay kumukulo sa 100 degrees Celsius, samantalang ang ethanol ay kumukulo sa mas mababang 78 degrees Celsius!
fact_en:
Do all liquids boil at the same temperature?

Nope! Pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius, but ethanol boils at a much lower 78 degrees Celsius!

title: Sea Salt mula sa Zambales
fact_tl: Natutunaw sa tubig ang sea salt mula Zambales, pero kung sobra ang ilagay, may natitirang hindi natutunaw na solid salt!
fact_en: Sea salt from Zambales dissolves in water, but add too much and you'll see undissolved solid salt left in the mixture!

title: Evaporation sa Laguna de Bay
fact_tl: Ang tubig mula sa Laguna de Bay ay nagkakaroon ng pisikal na pagbabago kapag ang likidong tubig ay nag-evaporate at nagiging water vapor!
fact_en: Water from Laguna de Bay goes through a physical change when liquid water evaporates and turns into a gas called water vapor!

title: Konduktibong Copper Wire
fact_tl:
Bakit napakagandang electrical conductor ng copper wire?

Ang atomic structure nito ay nagpapahintulot sa mga electron na madaling dumaloy sa loob ng solid!
fact_en:
Why is copper wire such a great electrical conductor?

Its atomic structure allows electrons to flow easily through the solid, making it an excellent conductor!

title: Period Number at Electron Shell
fact_tl: Ang numero ng period ng isang elemento ay nagsasabi kung ilang electron shell o energy level mayroon ang atomo nito!
fact_en: An element's period number tells exactly how many electron shells, or energy levels, its atoms have!

title: Bunsen Burner Flame
fact_tl:
Anong kagamitan sa laboratoryo ang gumagawa ng mainit na apoy para mag-trigger ng chemical changes?

Ang Bunsen burner! Ito ay isang kagamitang pang-laboratoryo na gumagawa ng mainit na apoy para mag-trigger ng mga kemikal na pagbabago sa mga pinainit na sangkap.
fact_en:
What lab tool makes a hot flame to trigger chemical changes?

A Bunsen burner! It’s a cool laboratory tool that produces a hot flame to trigger chemical changes in heated substances.

title: Reverse Osmosis Membrane
fact_tl:
Paano natin pinaghihiwalay ang mga natunaw na asin mula sa inuming tubig?

Ang reverse osmosis system ay gumagamit ng semipermeable membrane para paghiwalayin ang mga natunaw na asin mula sa inuming tubig!
fact_en:
How do we separate dissolved salts from our drinking water?

A reverse osmosis system uses a semipermeable membrane to separate dissolved solid salts from liquid drinking water!

title: Plastic Handle Laban sa Init
fact_tl: Ang mga metal tulad ng copper ay napakagaling na thermal conductors, kaya ang hawakan ng kaldero ay gawa sa insulating plastic o wood!
fact_en: Metals like copper are excellent thermal conductors, which is why pot handles are made of insulating plastic or wood!

title: Nakalawang de Latang Pagkain
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi na ligtas kainin ang de-latang pagkaing nakalawang?

Kapag nag-react ang bakal sa oxygen at moisture at naging kalawang, ang chemical change ay nagpapahamak sa pagkain!
fact_en:
Why is rusted canned food unsafe to eat?

When the iron reacts with oxygen and moisture to form rust, a chemical change makes the food unsafe!

title: Taal Lake na Mas Mabigat
fact_tl:
Bakit mas makapal ang tubig sa Taal Lake kaysa sa purong tubig?

Mas makapal ito! Ang tubig ay may natunaw na mineral mula sa bulkan.
fact_en:
Why is the water in Taal Lake heavier than pure water?

It has a higher density! The liquid water contains dissolved minerals from the volcano.

title: Smoke Point ng Cooking Oil
fact_tl: Kapag pinainit ang cooking oil lampas sa smoke point nito, nagkakaroon ng chemical change na naglalabas ng mapanganib na free radicals at toxic fumes sa kusina!
fact_en: Heating cooking oil past its smoke point causes a chemical change, releasing harmful free radicals and toxic fumes into your kitchen!

title: pH Unit Sampung Asim
fact_tl:
Paano gumagana ang pH scale?

Bawat isang bahagi ay nangangahulugang sampung beses na pagbabago! Kaya ang pH 3 ay sampung beses na mas maasim kaysa pH 4.
fact_en:
How does the pH scale work?

Each one-unit step means a tenfold change in acidity! For example, pH 3 is ten times more acidic than pH 4.

title: Likidong Hindi Naghahalo
fact_tl: Ang oil spill sa Manila Bay ay nag-create ng heterogeneous mixture dahil hindi nag-dissolve ang liquid oil at liquid water sa isa’t isa!
fact_en: Oil spills in Manila Bay create a heterogeneous mixture because liquid oil and liquid water do not dissolve into each other!

title: Tubig na Neutral pH 7
fact_tl:
Bakit ang purong tubig ay neutral?

Ang purong tubig ay neutral (pH 7) dahil kaunti lang ang H+ at OH- na nabubuo — at dahil magkapareho sila, nagkakansela sila!
fact_en:
Why is pure water considered neutral?

Pure water is neutral (pH 7) because only a tiny amount of H+ and OH- forms — and since they're equal, they cancel each other out!

title: Walang Katapusang Salamin
fact_tl:
Pwede bang i-recycle ang salamin nang walang katapusan?

Oo, nang walang katapusan! Pwede itong tunawin at hubugin paulit-ulit nang hindi nababawasan ang kalidad nito.
fact_en:
Can glass be recycled forever?

Yes, endlessly! Glass can be melted and reshaped over and over again without ever losing its amazing quality.

title: Plastik di Nabubulok
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi nabubulok ang plastik tulad ng dahon o pagkain?

Dahil gawa ito ng tao at bago sa kalikasan! Hindi pa alam ng karamihan sa bakterya at amag kung paano ito kainin.
fact_en:
Why doesn't plastic rot like food or leaves?

Because plastic is human-made and new to nature! Most bacteria and molds don't know how to eat it yet.

title: Pulot Hindi Nasisira
fact_tl:
Bakit halos hindi nabubulok ang pulot-pukyutan?

Sobrang dami ng asukal at napakakaunting tubig sa pulot-pukyutan, kaya hindi mabuhay ang bakterya sa loob nito!
fact_en:
Why does honey almost never spoil?

Honey has so much sugar and so little water that bacteria simply cannot survive inside it!

title: Net Force na Vector Sum
fact_tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag parehong lakas ang hilahin ng dalawang tao sa isang lubid?

Ang net force ay pinagsama-samang lakas at direksyon ng lahat ng puwersa. Kapag nagkansela ang magkasalungat na puwersa, zero ang net force at hindi nagbabago ang galaw!
fact_en:
What happens when two people pull a rope with the exact same strength?

The net force combines all forces' strength and direction. When opposite forces cancel out, the net force is zero, and the object's motion does not change!

title: Momentum Mass Times Velocity
fact_tl:
Paano natin kinakalkula ang momentum ng isang bagay?

Ang momentum ay katumbas ng mass na pinarami sa velocity (p = mv)! At tulad ng velocity, may direction din ang momentum!
fact_en:
How do we calculate an object's momentum?

Momentum equals mass multiplied by velocity (p = mv)! And just like velocity, momentum also has a direction!

title: Impulse Force Times Time
fact_tl: Ang impulse ay ang force na pinarami sa haba ng panahon na ito ay umiiral! Ito ang nagdudulot ng pagbabago sa momentum ng isang bagay.
fact_en: Impulse is force multiplied by the time it acts! This is exactly what causes a change in an object's momentum.

title: Zero Displacement Round Trip
fact_tl:
Maaari bang maging zero ang displacement mo kahit na malaki ang kabuuang distansyang nilakbay mo?

Oo! Kung ang isang bagay ay bumalik sa eksaktong pinanggalingan nito, ang displacement nito ay zero kahit malaki ang kabuuang distansyang nilakbay.
fact_en:
Is it possible for your displacement to be zero even if you traveled a really long distance?

Yes! If an object returns to its exact starting point, its displacement is zero, even if the total distance traveled is large.

title: Frequency Hertz kada Segundo
fact_tl:
Ano ang frequency (dalas)?

Ang frequency (dalas) ay kung ilang alon ang dumadaan sa isang punto sa isang segundo, sinusukat sa hertz!
fact_en:
What is frequency?

Frequency is exactly how many waves pass a point in one second, measured in hertz!

title: Bilis Wavelength beses Frequency
fact_tl:
Paano natin kinakalkula ang bilis ng alon?

Ang bilis ng alon ay katumbas ng wavelength nito na minultiply sa frequency nito (bilis = wavelength × frequency)!
fact_en:
How do we calculate wave speed?

A wave's speed equals its wavelength multiplied by its frequency (speed = wavelength × frequency)!

title: EM Wave Walang Medium
fact_tl: Ang electromagnetic wave tulad ng liwanag at radyo ay gawa sa nagbabagong electric at magnetic field. Kaya silang dumaan sa walang laman na espasyo nang walang medium!
fact_en: Electromagnetic waves like light and radio are made of changing electric and magnetic fields. They can travel through empty space without needing any medium!

title: EM Spectrum Radio hanggang Gamma
fact_tl: Ang electromagnetic spectrum ay puno ng waves na nakaayos ayon sa wavelength! Ang radio waves ang pinakamahaba, gamma rays ang pinakamaikli, at visible light ay maliit na bahagi lang.
fact_en: The electromagnetic spectrum has many waves arranged by wavelength! Radio waves are the longest, gamma rays are the shortest, and visible light is just a tiny part.

title: Joule Yunit ng Work Energy
fact_tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang work at energy?

Sinusukat natin ito sa joules (J)! Isang joule ang nagagawa kapag isang newton na force ang nagpagalaw ng bagay ng isang metro.
fact_en:
How do we measure work and energy?

They are measured in joules (J)! One joule happens when a force of one newton moves an object one meter in the force's direction.

title: Watt Isang Joule kada Segundo
fact_tl:
Paano sinusukat ang power?

Ang power ay sinusukat sa watts (W)! Isang watt ang katumbas ng isang joule ng energy na ginagamit o ginagawa bawat segundo.
fact_en:
How is power measured?

Power is measured in watts (W)! One watt equals one joule of energy used or produced every single second.

title: Puting Ilaw na Maraming Kulay
fact_tl: Ang puting white light mula sa araw ay actually gawa sa maraming kulay na pinagsama-sama!
fact_en: The bright white light from the sun is actually made of many different colors mixed together!

title: Electromagnet Ikot Kuryente
fact_tl: Gusto mo ng mas malakas na electromagnet? Dagdagan lang ang ikot ng alambre o damihan ang kuryenteng dumadaloy para lumakas ito!
fact_en: Want a stronger electromagnet? Just add more turns of wire or send more current flowing through it to boost its power!

title: Static Malakas sa Tuyong Hangin
fact_tl:
Bakit mas malakas at madalas ang static electricity kapag tuyo ang hangin?

Kapag tuyo o kulang sa halumigmig ang hangin, mas malakas ang static electricity! Sa basa o mahalumigmig na hangin, mabilis nawawala ang charge kaya bihira ang spark.
fact_en:
Why is static electricity stronger and more common in dry air?

In dry, cold, or low-humidity air, static electricity is stronger! In damp or humid air, the charge leaks away easily, making sparks rarer.

title: Induction Hindi Hinihipo
fact_tl:
Pwede bang magpakita ng static effect ang neutral na bagay kahit hindi nahawakan?

Oo, sa induction! Kapag inilapit ang charged na bagay sa neutral, nahahati ang charge sa loob nito. Kaya ang isang panig ay naaakit sa charged na bagay.
fact_en:
Can a neutral object show a static effect without being touched?

Yes, through induction! When a charged object is brought near a neutral object, the charge inside separates. This makes one side of the neutral object become attracted to the charged object.

title: Bentahe ng Mahabang Lever Arm
fact_tl:
Paano mas madadali ang pag-angat ng mabigat na load?

Ilayo ang effort mula sa fulcrum! Kapag mas malayo, mas madaling i-angat ang load.
fact_en:
How can you make lifting a heavy load easier?

Move the effort farther from the fulcrum! The longer the arm, the easier it is to lift.

title: Wheelbarrow Second-Class Lever
fact_tl: Ang wheelbarrow ay isang matalinong palanca! Ang gulong ang fulcrum, at ang load ay nasa gitna — kaya napakadaling buhatin ang mabigat na karga!
fact_en: A wheelbarrow is a clever lever! The wheel is the fulcrum, and the load sits right in the middle — making heavy loads super easy to lift!

title: Braso Third-Class Lever
fact_tl: Ang braso mo ay isang third-class lever! Ang siko ang fulcrum, at ang kalamnan ang nagbibigay ng effort para magbuhat.
fact_en: Your own arm is a third-class lever! The elbow is the fulcrum, and your muscles provide the effort to lift things.

title: Archimedes Lever Quote
fact_tl:
Ano ang sinabi ng sinaunang siyentistang si Archimedes tungkol sa mga palanca?

Sinabi ni Archimedes na kung may sapat na haba ng palanca at tuntungan, kaya niyang iangat ang buong mundo!
fact_en:
What did the ancient scientist Archimedes say about levers?

Archimedes said that with a long enough lever and a place to stand, he could lift the whole world!

title: Nutcracker Second-Class Lever
fact_tl: Ang nutcracker ay isang second-class lever! Ang fulcrum ay nasa isang dulo, at pinipiga mo ang mga hawakan para mabasag ang mani.
fact_en: A nutcracker is a second-class lever! The fulcrum is at one end, and you squeeze the handles to crack the nut.

title: Wedge na Dalawang Inclined Plane
fact_tl: Ang wedge ay isang payak na makina na gawa sa dalawang dahilig na pinagsama para mabuo ang matalas na dulo!
fact_en: A wedge is a simple machine made of two inclined planes joined to form a sharp edge!

title: Idler Gear sa Parehong Direksyon
fact_tl: Maglagay ka ng pangatlong gear, o idler gear, sa pagitan ng dalawa! Ang una at huling gear ay iikot na sa parehong direksyon.
fact_en: Place a third gear, called an idler gear, between two gears! The first and last gears will then turn in the same direction.

title: Solar Enerhiya Mula sa Araw
fact_tl:
Saan nagmula ang solar energy at ano ang magagawa nito?

Nagmula ito sa sikat ng araw! Pwede nating gamitin para magpainit ng tubig o gawing kuryente gamit ang mga solar panel.
fact_en:
Where does solar energy come from and what can it do?

It comes from the sun's light! We can use it to heat water or turn it into electricity using solar panels.

title: Hindi Nakikitang Grabidad
fact_tl:
Nakikita ba natin ang grabidad?

Hindi natin ito nakikita, ngunit nararamdaman natin ito tuwing may humihila sa mga bagay pababa!
fact_en:
Can we see gravity?

We cannot see it, but we feel it whenever something is pulled downward!

title: Zero Net Force
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag balanse ang mga pwersa?

Ang net force ay nagiging zero! Ibig sabihin, walang magiging pagbabago sa galaw ng bagay.
fact_en:
What happens when forces are perfectly balanced?

The net force becomes zero! This means there is absolutely no change in the object's motion.

title: Unang Batas Newton
fact_tl: Ayon sa unang batas ni Newton, ang bagay na nakatigil ay mananatiling nakatigil, at ang gumagalaw ay patuloy na gagalaw, hangga't walang di-balanseng pwersa!
fact_en: Newton's first law says an object at rest stays at rest, and a moving object keeps moving, unless an unbalanced force acts on it!

title: Kalawakang Walang Hangin
fact_tl: Halos walang hangin sa kalawakan, kaya walang air resistance na magpapabagal. Kaya patuloy na lumulutang ang spacecraft kahit walang umaandar na makina!
fact_en: Space has almost no air, so there is no air resistance to slow things down. A spacecraft keeps gliding even without its engine running!

title: Bombilyang Ayaw Sumindi
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi sumisindag ang bombilya kahit mukhang kumpleto ang circuit?

Ang maluwag, marumi, o kinakalawang na koneksyon ay naaabala ang daloy ng kuryente sa metal! Kahit mukhang kumpleto ang circuit, mapuputol ang daanan kaya hindi mag-iilaw ang bombilya.
fact_en:
Why won't the bulb light up even if the circuit looks complete?

A loose, dirty, or corroded connection interrupts the current flow through the metal contacts! Even if the circuit looks complete, that broken path means the bulb won't light.

title: Contact Non-Contact Force
fact_tl: Karamihan sa puwersa ay kailangang dumikit, pero ang gravity, magnetism, at static electricity ay pwedeng humila o magtulak nang walang hawak!
fact_en: Most forces need to touch an object, but gravity, magnetism, and static electricity can push or pull without touching at all!

title: Soft Iron Core
fact_tl:
Bakit malambot na bakal ang ginagamit bilang ubod ng elektromagnet?

Mabilis itong nagiging magnet kapag may kuryente, at mabilis ding mawalan nito kapag pinatay!
fact_en:
Why do electromagnets use soft iron for their core?

Soft iron becomes a magnet super fast when current flows, but loses its magnetism just as quickly when you switch it off!

title: 30 Minuto Pagkatapos ng Kulog
fact_tl:
Gaano katagal dapat maghintay pagkatapos ng huling kulog bago lumabas?

Maghintay nang halos 30 minuto pagkatapos ng huling kulog! Maaari pang tumama ang kidlat kahit tila tapos na ang bagyo.
fact_en:
How long should you wait after the last thunder before going outside?

Wait about 30 minutes after the last thunder! Lightning can still strike even after the storm seems to pass.

title: Perpetual Motion Machine
fact_tl: Imposible ang makinang gagalaw nang walang hanggan nang walang dagdag na enerhiya! Laging may nawawalang enerhiya bilang init dahil sa friction.
fact_en: A machine running forever without added energy is impossible! Some energy is always lost as heat through friction.

title: Itim Tshirt Mainit Puti Reflect
fact_tl:
Bakit mas mainit pakiramdam kapag nagsuot ka ng itim na damit kaysa puti?

Ang puting bagay ay tumatalbog ng mas maraming liwanag, habang ang itim na bagay ay sumisipsip ng liwanag — kaya mas umiinit ito!
fact_en:
Why does wearing a black shirt feel hotter than wearing a white one?

White objects reflect more light, while black objects absorb light — and that's why black gets warmer!

title: Sukat ng Init o Lamig
fact_tl: Walang sariling kulay ang anino! Ito ay isang madilim na lugar kung saan hindi nakakarating ang liwanag.
fact_en: A shadow has no color of its own! It is just a dark area where light cannot reach.

title: Air Column sa Wind Instrument
fact_tl:
Gumagawa ba ng lamig ang mga cooler?

Hindi! Ang insulasyon ay hindi gumagawa ng init o lamig. Pinapabagal lamang nito ang paglabas o pagpasok ng init.
fact_en:
Do coolers create cold air?

No! Insulation does not make heat or cold. It only slows heat from leaving or entering to keep things cool.

title: Paniki Ultrasound Dili Naririnig
fact_tl: Karamihan ng tunog na ginagamit ng paniki ay napakataas na ultrasound, kaya hindi ito naririnig ng tainga ng tao!
fact_en: Most sounds bats use are super high-pitched ultrasound, which means our human ears cannot hear them at all!

title: Buwan Gravity 1/6 Earth
fact_tl: Ang gravity sa Buwan ay mga 1/6 lang ng sa Earth! Magiging anim na beses kang mas magaan doon at makakatalon ka nang napakataas.
fact_en: The Moon's gravity is only about 1/6 of Earth's! You would weigh six times less there and could jump super high into the sky.

title: Tunog sa Tubig kaysa Hangin
fact_tl: Mas mabilis maglakbay ang tunog sa tubig kaysa hangin! Kaya gumagana nang maayos ang echolocation para sa mga lumba-lumba sa dagat.
fact_en: Sound zooms faster through water than air! That's why echolocation works so well for dolphins swimming in the sea.

title: Infrared Mahaba kaysa Pula
fact_tl: Ang infrared ay liwanag na may haba ng alon na mas mahaba kaysa pula, at madalas natin itong nararamdaman bilang init!
fact_en: Infrared is a type of light with a wavelength longer than red, and we often feel it as cozy heat!

title: EM Wave na Parehong Bilis
fact_tl:
Sino ang mananalo sa pinakamabilis na karera ng liwanag sa space?

Pantay sila! Lahat ng electromagnetic wave, pati ultraviolet at infrared, ay naglalakbay sa parehong bilis ng liwanag sa kawalan.
fact_en:
Who wins the ultimate light race in space?

It's a tie! All electromagnetic waves, including ultraviolet and infrared, travel at the exact same speed of light in empty space.

title: Projector Lens sa Malaking Image
fact_tl: Ang proyektor ay gumagamit ng lente para palakihin at itapat ang isang larawan sa malayong tabil o pader!
fact_en: A projector uses a lens to enlarge an image and cast it onto a distant screen or wall!

title: Lens sa Real o Virtual Image
fact_tl: Ang umbok na lente ay makakabuo ng tunay na larawang puwedeng itapat sa screen, o ng larawang nakikita lang sa loob ng lente gaya sa magnifying glass!
fact_en: A convex lens can make a real image that can fall on a screen, or one seen only through the lens like in a magnifying glass!

title: Langit na Asul hindi Violet
fact_tl:
Kung mas nagkakalat ang lila kaysa asul, bakit asul pa rin ang nakikita natin sa langit?

Asul pa rin ang nakikita natin dahil mas sensitibo ang ating mga mata sa asul na liwanag kaysa sa lila!
fact_en:
If violet light scatters more than blue, why does the sky look blue to us?

The sky still looks blue because our human eyes are simply much more sensitive to blue light than violet!

title: Walang Air Itim na Langit
fact_tl: Sa kalawakan, walang hangin, kaya itim ang langit dahil walang mga molekulang magkakalat ng liwanag ng araw!
