fact_en: In space, there is no air, so the sky is completely black because there are no molecules to scatter sunlight!

title: Ulap na Puti hindi Asul
fact_tl:
Bakit puti ang ulap at hindi asul?

Ang malalaking patak ng tubig dito ay nagkakalat ng lahat ng kulay nang pantay-pantay, kaya puti sila!
fact_en:
Why are clouds white instead of blue?

Their big water droplets scatter all light colors equally, making them look white!

title: Asul Mula sa Buong Langit
fact_tl:
Bakit asul ang buong langit, hindi lang sa may araw?

Ang nakalat na asul na liwanag ay nagmumula sa lahat ng direksyon, kaya asul ang buong langit!
fact_en:
Why is the whole sky blue, not just near the Sun?

The scattered blue light bounces to us from every single direction, painting the whole sky blue!

title: Trak kaysa Bisikleta
fact_tl:
Bakit mas mapanganib ang banggaan ng trak kaysa sa bisikleta kahit pareho ang bilis?

Ang isang trak ay may mas malaking momentum kaysa sa bisikleta kahit pareho ang bilis, kaya mas mapanganib kapag bumangga!
fact_en:
Why is a truck crash more dangerous than a bicycle crash at the same speed?

A truck has much more momentum than a bicycle at the same speed, making its crash much more dangerous!

title: Plantang Fossil Fuel
fact_tl: Maraming power plant ang nagsusunog ng uling o gas para pakuluan ang tubig at gumawa ng singaw na umiikot sa turbina!
fact_en: Many power plants burn coal or gas to boil water into steam, which then spins the turbine!

title: AC Generator ng Power Plant
fact_tl: Karamihan sa malalaking generator sa power plant ay gumagawa ng alternating current o AC, ang kuryenteng dumadaloy sa mga saksak ng bahay!
fact_en: Most large power-plant generators make alternating current or AC, which is the exact kind of electricity flowing in your home outlets!

title: Generator Tubig Hangin Spin
fact_tl:
Ano ang nagpapailok sa generator para makagawa ng kuryente?

Kailangan ng generator ng panlabas na puwersa, tulad ng tubig, hangin, o singaw, para paikutin ito at makagawa ng kuryente!
fact_en:
What makes a generator spin to produce electricity?

A generator needs an outside force, like water, wind, or steam, to turn it and produce electricity!

title: 100 Degrees Pirmi sa Kulob
fact_tl:
Bakit nananatiling mga 100 degrees Celsius ang kumukulong tubig?

Hindi tumataas ang temperature — napupunta ang dagdag na init sa pagbabago ng tubig na maging singaw!
fact_en:
Why does boiling water stay at 100 degrees Celsius?

The extra heat doesn't raise the temperature — it goes into turning the water into steam!

title: Bato sa Ilog Tungong Buhangin
fact_tl: Sa mahabang panahon, ang friction mula sa pagkuskos ng mga bato sa ilog ay unti-unting nagpapadurog sa kanila hanggang maging buhangin!
fact_en: Over a long time, friction from rocks rubbing together in a river slowly wears them down until they turn into tiny sand!

title: Unang Batas Newton
fact_tl: Ayon sa unang batas ni Newton, ang isang bagay ay nananatiling nakatigil o patuloy na gumagalaw sa parehong bilis at direksyon hangga't walang puwersang umaapekto rito!
fact_en: Newton's first law says an object stays at rest or keeps moving at the same speed and direction unless a force acts on it!

title: Turnilyo kaysa Pako
fact_tl: Mas matibay ang kapit ng turnilyo kaysa sa pako dahil ang mga sinulid nito ay kumakapit nang mahigpit sa loob ng kahoy!
fact_en: A screw holds much better than a nail because its special threads grip tightly deep inside the wood!

title: Di-Nakikitang Magnetic Field
fact_tl: Sa palibot ng magneto ay may di-nakikitang larangan ng puwersa na tinatawag na magnetic field!
fact_en: All around a magnet is an invisible region of force called a magnetic field!

title: Solar Cell Calculator
fact_tl: Ang maliliit na solar cell ay ginagamit sa mga kalkulator at mga solar na ilaw sa kalsada!
fact_en: Small solar cells are super handy and used in calculators and solar streetlights!

title: Wind Turbine na Walang Usok
fact_tl:
Nagpo-pollute ba ang mga turbina ng hangin sa hangin?

Hindi! Gumagawa ng kuryente ang mga turbina nang walang usok o nakakahawang gas.
fact_en:
Do wind turbines pollute the air?

Nope! Wind turbines make electricity without giving off smoke or polluting gases.

title: Windmill Pump Bigas Unang
fact_tl: Noong unang panahon, ang gilingang-hangin ay nagbo-bomba ng tubig o gumigiling ng butil — hindi kuryente!
fact_en: Long ago, windmills pumped water or ground grain — they didn't make electricity!

title: Coal Oil at Natural Gas
fact_tl:
Ano ang fossil fuels at bakit sila non-renewable?

Ang fossil fuels ay ang coal, oil, at natural gas. Sila ay non-renewable dahil hindi sila agad nabubuo ulit kapag naubos na natin!
fact_en:
What are fossil fuels and why are they non-renewable?

Fossil fuels are coal, oil, and natural gas. They are non-renewable because they don't form again quickly once we use them up!

title: Puwersa Tulak o Hila
fact_tl: Sa science, ang puwersa ay isang tulak o hila na ginagawa mo sa isang bagay para gumalaw!
fact_en: In science, a force is simply a push or a pull that acts on an object to make it move!

title: Bilis Layo sa Takdang Oras
fact_tl: Ang bilis (speed) ay kung gaano kabilis gumagalaw ang isang bagay, ibig sabihin kung gaano kalayo ito nakakarating sa loob ng isang takdang oras!
fact_en: Speed is how fast something moves, meaning how far it travels in a certain amount of time!

title: Closed Circuit na Buong Loop
fact_tl: Kapag buo at walang putol ang loop, closed circuit ito! Tuloy-tuloy ang agos ng kuryente mula sa baterya papunta sa bombilya at pabalik, kaya nagliliwanag ang ilaw.
fact_en: A whole loop with no breaks is a closed circuit! Current flows continuously from the battery to the bulb and back, making the light shine bright.

title: Ground Wire papunta sa Lupa
fact_tl: Ang ground wire ay nagbibigay ng ligtas na daanan ng kuryente papunta sa lupa, para hindi tayo makuryente kapag may sirang gamit!
fact_en: A grounding wire gives electricity a safe path into the earth, keeping us safe from shocks if an appliance breaks!

title: Tacoma Narrows Bridge
fact_tl:
Bakit gumuho ang Tacoma Narrows Bridge noong 1940?

Pinaalog ito nang husto ng hangin, kaya umalon-alon ito at gumuho!
fact_en:
Why did the Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapse in 1940?

The wind made it vibrate violently, causing it to wave up and down until it collapsed!

title: Bangui Wind Farm
fact_tl:
Paano gumagawa ng kuryente ang Bangui Wind Farm sa Ilocos Norte?

Gumagamit ito ng hanay ng malalaking windmill sa tabing-dagat para mahuli ang hangin!
fact_en:
How does the Bangui Wind Farm in Ilocos Norte make electricity?

It uses a row of giant windmills by the sea to catch the wind!

title: Self-Resetting Fuse Gadget
fact_tl: Hindi natutunaw ang modernong fuse sa mga gadget! Humihinto lang sila kapag uminit, tapos kusang bumabalik sa normal kapag lumamig na. Walang kailangang palitan!
fact_en: Modern fuses in gadgets don't melt! They just stop the current when they get too hot, then reset themselves when they cool down. No replacing needed!

title: Main Breaker vs Branch Breaker
fact_tl:
Bakit may isang malaking switch at maraming maliliit sa breaker panel?

Ang malaking 'main breaker' ay pumuputol ng kuryente sa buong bahay! Ang maliliit na 'branch breaker' ay para sa bawat kwarto. Kung may problema sa isang kwarto, iyon lang ang mamamatay!
fact_en:
Why do breaker panels have one big switch and many small ones?

The big 'main breaker' cuts power to the whole house! The small 'branch breakers' control separate rooms. If one room has a problem, only that line shuts off!

title: Inverter Aircon Compressor
fact_tl: Ang ordinaryong aircon ay buong on o off sa compressor. Ang inverter aircon naman ay nagpapabagal lang nito para pantay ang lamig at mas tipid sa kuryente!
fact_en: Ordinary aircons turn the compressor fully on or off. But inverter aircons just slow the compressor down to keep the temperature steady, saving more electricity!

title: Aircon Fan at Set Temperature
fact_tl: Napapansin mo ba na umiihip ang aircon pero hindi na malamig? Ibig sabihin, naabot na ng kwarto ang set temperature! Pinapatay ng thermostat ang lamig, pero tuloy ang fan hanggang uminit ulit.
fact_en: Notice your aircon blowing but not feeling cold? It just means the room reached your set temperature! The thermostat pauses the cooling, but the fan keeps running until the room warms up.

title: Smart Thermostat App
fact_tl: Ang mga bagong 'smart' thermostat ay kinokontrol gamit ang phone app, kahit wala ka sa bahay! Pwede mo itong i-schedule na lumamig bago ka umuwi, o tumaas ang temperatura kapag walang tao para makatipid.
fact_en: New 'smart' thermostats let you control your aircon using a phone app, even when away! You can schedule it to cool before you arrive, or raise the temperature when nobody's home to save energy.

title: Gravity o Magnet
fact_tl:
Parang magnet ba ang gravity?

Hindi! Bakal at metal lang ang hinahula ng magnet. Pero ang gravity, hinihila nito ang LAHAT—bato, tubig, kahoy, at maging ikaw!
fact_en:
Is gravity like a magnet?

Nope! A magnet only pulls iron and metal. But gravity pulls EVERYTHING—rocks, water, wood, and even you!

title: Gulong noong Mesopotamia
fact_tl:
Paano ginamit ang pinakaunang gulong?

Ginawa 5,500 years ago sa Mesopotamia, ito isa sa pinakamatandang imbensiyon! Ginamit muna ito sa paggawa ng palayok, hindi sa kareton!
fact_en:
How was the very first wheel used?

Made 5,500 years ago in Mesopotamia, it’s one of the oldest inventions! It was first used for shaping pottery, not carts!

title: Thomas Edison noong 1879
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang praktikal na electric light bulb?

Noong 1879, gumawa si Thomas Edison ng matagal tumagal! Nagbigay ito ng maaasahang ilaw sa gabi nang hindi gumagamit ng kandila o gas.
fact_en:
Who made the first practical electric light bulb?

In 1879, Thomas Edison made one that lasted a long time! It gave people reliable light at night without candles or gas.

title: Alexander Graham Bell 1876
fact_tl: Noong 1876, naimbento ni Alexander Graham Bell ang telepono! Binabago nito ang boses mo sa signal sa kawad para makausap ang malalayong tao.
fact_en: In 1876, Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone! It turns your voice into a signal through a wire to talk to people far away.

title: Light Reactions vs Calvin Cycle
fact_tl: May dalawang bahagi ang photosynthesis! Una, sa light reactions, sumasalo ang halaman ng light, gumagawa ng energy molecules, at naglalabas ng oxygen. Pangalawa, sa Calvin cycle, ginagawa nila ang sugar mula sa carbon dioxide.
fact_en: Photosynthesis happens in two stages! First, in the light reactions, plants capture light, make energy molecules, and release oxygen. Second, in the Calvin cycle, they build sugar from carbon dioxide.

title: Average Speed vs Constant Speed
fact_tl:
Laging pareho ba ang average speed sa totoong bilis mo?

Hindi laging pareho! Kung constant ang takbo mo, ang average speed ay katumbas niyon. Kung bumibilis at bumabagal ka, ang average speed ay nasa pagitan ng pinakamabilis at pinakamabagal.
fact_en:
Is average speed always the same as your actual speed?

Not always! If you move at a constant speed the whole time, average speed equals it exactly. But if you speed up and slow down, average speed falls between your fastest and slowest.

title: Bilis ng Iba't Ibang Bagay
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang iba't ibang bagay?

Napakakaiba-iba! Ang naglalakad ay 4 km/h, ang sasakyan sa highway ay 80 km/h, at ang eroplano ay umaabot ng 900 km/h. Ang average speed ay nakakatulong sa pagkumpara.
fact_en:
How fast do different things move?

Very differently! A walking person goes about 4 km/h, a highway car about 80 km/h, and a passenger plane reaches about 900 km/h. Average speed helps us compare them.

title: Tongonan Leyte Geothermal Field
fact_tl:
Saan sa Pilipinas makikita ang malaking geothermal field?

Sa Tongonan, Leyte, may malaking geothermal field na nagbibigay ng kuryente sa maraming bahay sa Visayas! Ito ay tunay na halimbawa kung paano ginagamit ng Pilipinas ang init ng lupa para sa kuryente.
fact_en:
Where in the Philippines can we find a big geothermal field?

In Tongonan, Leyte, there's a huge geothermal field that powers many homes across the Visayas! It's a real-life example of how the Philippines uses the Earth's heat for electricity.

title: Geothermal na Singaw hindi Lava
fact_tl:
Kinukuha ba ng geothermal ang lava mismo mula sa ilalim?

Hindi! Hindi gumagamit ang geothermal ng totoong lava. Sa halip, ginagamit nito ang init na ipinapasa ng lupa sa tubig, na nagiging mainit na singaw—hindi totoong lava!
fact_en:
Does geothermal energy scoop up lava from underground?

Nope! Geothermal doesn't use actual lava. Instead, it uses the heat the ground passes into water, turning it into hot steam—not actual lava!

title: Iba pang Gamit ng Geothermal
fact_tl: Bukod sa kuryente, ang init ng geothermal ay pwedeng magpainit ng tubig, magpatuyo ng pananim, o gumawa ng mainit na paliguan!
fact_en: Besides making electricity, geothermal heat can warm water, dry crops, or fill cozy warm baths! It’s not just for power.

title: Doorknob Shock sa Tuyong Panahon
fact_tl: Kapag naglalakad sa carpet na may tsinelas, nagtitipon ang charge! Hawakan ang metal doorknob, at lalaktaw ang charge para sa maliit na zap. Madalas ito kapag tuyo ang panahon.
fact_en: Walking on a carpet in slippers builds up charge! Touch a metal doorknob, and the charge jumps for a tiny zap. This happens most when the weather is dry.

title: Hindi Delikadong Static Shock
fact_tl: Akala mo delikado ang static spark sa doorknob? Hindi ito nakakasama! Napakaliit lang ng charge, kaya nakakagulat lang ito. Iba ito sa delikadong kuryente sa wall socket na hindi dapat hawakan.
fact_en: Think a doorknob static spark is dangerous? It cannot hurt you! The charge is very small, just surprising you. This differs from dangerous wall socket electricity you must never touch.

title: Gas Station sa Static Spark
fact_tl:
Bakit may babala tungkol sa static spark sa gasolinahan?

Ang singaw ng gasolina ay madaling masunog, kaya kahit maliit na spark ay pwedeng magsimula ng apoy! Kaya minsan hinihipo muna ng tao ang metal ng kotse para mawala ang charge bago humawak sa gasolina.
fact_en:
Why are there warnings about static sparks at a gas station?

Gasoline vapor catches fire easily, so a tiny spark can start a flame! That is why you should touch the car's metal first to drain your charge before handling the fuel.

title: Spark Hindi Apoy
fact_tl:
Ang ba ang static spark ay parang maliit na apoy?

Hindi! Ang static spark ay hindi nananatiling apoy. Isa lang itong mabilis na kislap ng kuryente sa hangin. Pwede itong magsindi ng apoy, pero ang spark mismo ay hindi apoy!
fact_en:
Is a static spark a tiny fire?

Nope! A static spark doesn't stay burning. It's just a fast flash of electricity in the air. It can start a fire, but the spark itself is not fire!

title: Steam Engine ni James Watt
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinapatakbo ng steam engine?

Pinaunlad ni James Watt noong 1700s, ang steam engine ay gumagamit ng singaw ng kumukulong tubig para sa makina, nagdulot ng pabrika, tren, at barko!
fact_en:
What did the steam engine power?

Improved by James Watt in the 1700s, the steam engine uses boiling water steam to power machines, leading to factories, trains, and ships!

title: Unang Motor Car ni Karl Benz
fact_tl: Ginawa ni Karl Benz ang unang motor car noong 1886! Nang gawing mura ni Henry Ford ang mga ito, nakapagbiyahe na ang tao nang walang kabayo o karwahe.
fact_en: Karl Benz built the first motor car in 1886! Later, Henry Ford made them cheap, so ordinary people could travel without horses or carriages.

title: Salad Spinner at Tuyong Gulay
fact_tl: Ang salad spinner ay isang basket na pinapaikot nang mabilis para patuyuin ang hinugasang gulay! Tumitilapon ang tubig sa mga butas, kaya natutuyo ang dahon nang hindi mo kailangang pisilin.
fact_en: A salad spinner is a basket you spin fast to dry washed vegetables! As it turns, water is flung out through the holes, drying the leaves without squeezing them.

title: Electromagnet Battery Ubos
fact_tl: Biglang hindi na kumakapit ang gawa mong electromagnet? Malamang ubos na ang baterya! Walang kuryente, walang magnet. Palitan mo lang ang baterya, at babalik ang lakas nito!
fact_en: Did your homemade electromagnet suddenly stop sticking? The battery probably ran out! No electricity means no magnet. Just replace the battery, and its strength comes back!

title: Electromagnet Relay Makina
fact_tl: Sa loob ng maraming makina, ang electromagnet ay nagsisilbing switch. Gamit ang maliit na current, ligtas nitong sinusindihan o pinapatay ang malalaking makina!
fact_en: Inside many machines, an electromagnet acts as a switch. Using just a small current, it safely turns large, dangerous machines on or off!

title: Hertz at Waves kada Segundo
fact_tl: Ang frequency ay sinusukat sa hertz (Hz). Ang isang hertz ay isang kumpletong wave kada segundo, kaya 10 Hz ay sampung wave bawat segundo!
fact_en: Frequency is measured in hertz (Hz). One hertz means one complete wave passes by each second, so 10 Hz means ten waves per second!

title: EM Spectrum Ayon sa Frequency
fact_tl: Ang electromagnetic spectrum ay isang malaking pamilya ng waves na nakaayos ayon sa frequency! Mula sa low-frequency radio waves hanggang high-frequency gamma rays, pareho silang uri ng wave, frequency lang ang pagkakaiba.
fact_en: The electromagnetic spectrum is a big family of waves arranged by frequency! From low-frequency radio waves up to high-frequency gamma rays, they are all the same kind of wave, differing only in frequency.

title: Natural Radio Waves
fact_tl:
Tao lang ba ang gumagawa ng radio waves?

Hindi! Ang mga bituin, galaksiya, at Araw ay natural na naglalabas ng radio waves. Ginagamit ng mga astronomo ang malalaking radio telescope para pakinggan at aralin ang kalawakan!
fact_en:
Do only humans make radio waves?

Nope! Stars, galaxies, and the Sun naturally give off radio waves. Astronomers use giant radio telescopes to listen to them and explore distant space!

title: GPS Signal mula Satellite
fact_tl: Ang GPS ng cellphone mo ay nakakakuha ng radio signals mula sa mga satellite! Sa pagsukat kung gaano katagal dumating ang bawat signal, naku-kwenta nito kung nasaan ka sa mapa.
fact_en: Your phone's GPS catches radio signals from satellites in the sky! By measuring how long each signal takes to arrive, it calculates exactly where you are on the map.

title: Static laban Sliding
fact_tl: Mas mahirap simulan ang paggalaw ng nakatigil na bagay kaysa padayunin! Ang unang tulak sa mabigat na aparador ang pinakamahirap — kapag gumalaw na, mas madali. Mas malakas ang friction sa nakatigil!
fact_en: It's harder to start a still object moving than to keep it going! The first push on a heavy cabinet is toughest — once sliding, it's easier. Friction is stronger on still objects!

title: Grounding Dalawang Daan
fact_tl:
Palabas lang ba ang grounding?

Hindi! Kung ang object ay positive at kulang sa electrons, ang grounding ay nagpapadaloy ng electrons PAPASOK mula sa ground. Pwede itong palabas o papasok hanggang maging neutral!
fact_en:
Does grounding only push charge out?

Nope! If an object is positive and missing electrons, grounding lets electrons flow IN from the ground. Grounding goes both ways—out or in—until the object is neutral!

title: Maria Cristina Falls
fact_tl:
Paano gumagawa ng kuryente ang Maria Cristina Falls?

Ang talon na ito sa Ilog Agus sa Iligan City ay gumagamit ng lakas ng bumabagsak na tubig para paikutin ang mga turbina at gumawa ng kuryente!
fact_en:
How does Maria Cristina Falls make electricity?

This waterfall on the Agus River in Iligan City uses the force of falling water to spin turbines and generate power!

title: Mahabang Lever Arm
fact_tl: Mas madaling magbuhat kapag mas mahaba ang lever arm sa kamay mo! Kaya may mahabang hawakan ang barreta para malayo ka sa fulcrum.
fact_en: Lifting is easier when the lever arm to your hand is longer! That's why a crowbar has a long handle to keep you far from the fulcrum.

title: Mabilis na Liwanag kaysa Tunog
fact_tl:
Bakit nakikita natin ang fireworks bago marinig?

Dahil milyon-milyong beses na mas mabilis ang liwanag kaysa tunog! Nauuna ang flash sa iyong mga mata, at saka pa lang dumating ang mas mabagal na tunog. Kaya matatantya mo kung gaano kalayo ang paputok!
fact_en:
Why do we see fireworks before hearing them?

Light is millions of times faster than sound! The flash reaches your eyes first, and the slower sound reaches your ears later, helping you guess how far away the fireworks are!

title: Kinetic Energy sa Doble Bilis
fact_tl: Doblehin mo ang bilis, at ang kinetic energy ay magiging APAT na beses mas malaki—hindi lang doble! Dahil nakadepende ito sa bilis na nakakuwadrado. Kaya delikado ang overspeeding sa kalsada!
fact_en: Double your speed, and kinetic energy becomes FOUR times bigger—not just double! That's because it depends on speed squared. This is why speeding on roads is super dangerous!

title: Kinetic Energy Zero
fact_tl:
Puwede bang maging zero ang kinetic energy?

Oo! Kapag ganap na nakatigil ang isang bagay, zero ang kinetic energy nito. Pero hindi ito kayang maging negatibo—dahil ang pormula ay gumagamit ng bilis na nakakuwadrado, na laging zero o pataas!
fact_en:
Can kinetic energy ever be zero?

Yes! When an object is completely still, its kinetic energy is zero. But it can never be negative—because the formula uses speed squared, always zero or positive!

title: Static Sliding Rolling Friction
fact_tl: May iba't ibang uri ng friction! Ang static ay humahawak sa nakatigil, sliding kapag dumudulas, rolling kapag gumugulong, at fluid kapag gumagalaw sa tubig o hangin. Lahat sumasalungat sa galaw!
fact_en: Friction has different kinds! Static holds things still, sliding happens when things slide, rolling is for rolling, and fluid is for moving through water or air. All oppose motion!

title: Lakad kaysa Takbo
fact_tl: Ang lakad ay mga 5 km/h, pero ang takbo ay 10 km/h o mas mabilis pa! Doble ang bilis ng takbo kaya mas mabilis makarating, pero mas madali ka ring mapagod!
fact_en: Walking is about 5 km/h, but jogging is 10 km/h or more! Running is twice as fast, so you arrive quicker, but you also tire out much more easily!

title: Malalaking Solar Panel
fact_tl:
Bakit malalaki ang mga solar panel at wave-catcher?

Mas maraming enerhiya ang nakukuha kapag mas malawak ang lugar na sinasalo nito sa bawat segundo! Kaya ginagawa silang malaki.
fact_en:
Why are solar panels and wave-catchers made so large?

A wider area catches more wave energy each second! Making them large helps gather much more energy for us to use.

title: Maikling String Mataas na Pitch
fact_tl: Mas mabilis mag-vibrate ang maikling kuwerdas kaysa sa mahaba! Mas mabilis ang vibration, mas mataas ang pitch. Kaya ang maikling kuwerdas ay gumagawa ng matinis na tunog.
fact_en: A short string vibrates faster than a long one! The faster it vibrates, the higher the pitch. That's why short strings make a high, sharp sound.

title: Maikling String Maliit na Wave
fact_tl:
Bakit mas mataas ang tunog ng maikling kuwerdas?

Kapag nag-vibrate ang kuwerdas, gumagawa ito ng mga alon! Sa maikling kuwerdas, mas maliit lang ang kasya, kaya mas mabilis umulit at mas mataas ang tunog.
fact_en:
Why do short strings make higher pitches?

When a string vibrates, it makes waves! On a short string, only a smaller wave fits, so it repeats faster and produces a higher pitch.

title: Tunog ng Ukulele kaysa Gitara
fact_tl: Mas maliit ang ukulele at mas maiikli ang kuwerdas nito kaysa sa gitara. Kaya mas mataas at mas matinis ang tunog nito kumpara sa malalim na tunog ng gitara!
fact_en: A ukulele is smaller and has shorter strings than a guitar. That is why it sounds higher and brighter compared to the deeper sound of a guitar!

title: Walang Constant Force sa Galaw
fact_tl:
Kailangan mo ba itulak palagi para gumalaw ang isang bagay?

Hindi! Kailangan mo lang ng force para BAGUHIN ang galaw, hindi para panatilihin ito. Sa outer space na walang friction, patuloy na gumagalaw ang mga bagay kahit walang tumutulak!
fact_en:
Do you need to keep pushing something to make it move?

Nope! You only need force to CHANGE motion, not to keep it going. In outer space with no friction, things keep moving forever without any push!

title: Malaking Bass Instrumento
fact_tl:
Bakit malalaki ang mga bass instrument?

Ginawang malalaki ang mga bass instrument tulad ng double bass at tuba! Ang mahaba at makapal na bahagi nito ay mabagal mag-vibrate para gumawa ng napakababang nota na pundasyon ng musika.
fact_en:
Why are bass instruments so big?

Bass instruments like the double bass and tuba are built large on purpose! Their long, thick parts vibrate slowly to make very low notes that give music its foundation.

title: Baseball Bat Third-Class Lever
fact_tl: Ang palo sa baseball ay ikatlong klase na lever: ang ibabang kamay mo ang fulcrum, ang itaas na kamay ang nagbibigay ng effort, at ang bola ang load!
fact_en: A baseball bat is a third-class lever: your bottom hand is the fulcrum, your top hand gives the effort, and the ball is the load!

title: Venetian Blind Cord Pulley
fact_tl: Ang window blinds na may pull cord ay gumagamit ng maliit na fixed pulley sa itaas! Ang paghatak ng cord pababa ay nagpapataas o nagpapababa ng slats.
fact_en: Window blinds with a pull cord use a small fixed pulley at the top! Pulling the cord down raises or lowers the slats.

title: Elevator Pulley Counterweight
fact_tl: Ang elevator ay gumagamit ng pulley at counterweight! Kailangan ng motor ng mas kaunting puwersa para iangat ang cab dahil hinihila pababa ng counterweight ang kabilang panig.
fact_en: An elevator uses a pulley and a counterweight! The motor needs less force to raise the cab because the counterweight pulls the other side down.

title: Pagbubukas ng Lata gamit Barya
fact_tl:
Paano makakapagbukas ng lata ang barya?

Ang pagpasok ng gilid ng barya sa ilalim ng takip ay gumagamit ng wedge principle para pabuksan ito!
fact_en:
How can a coin open a paint can?

Inserting the edge of a coin under the lid uses the wedge principle to pry it off!

title: Planetary Gear Set
fact_tl:
Naisip mo ba kung paano nagpapalit ng gear ang sasakyan sa maliit na espasyo?

Ang planetary gear set ay gumagamit ng sun gear, planet gears, at ring gear para magbigay ng maraming gear ratio sa maliit na espasyo — tulad ng sa automatic transmissions!
fact_en:
Ever wonder how cars shift gears in such a tiny space?

A planetary gear set uses a sun gear, planet gears, and a ring gear to give many gear ratios in a small package — just like in automatic transmissions!

title: Tacoma Narrows Bridge
fact_tl:
Bakit bumagsak ang Tacoma Narrows Bridge noong 1940?

Malakas na hangin ang gumawa ng resonant vibrations na nagpagalaw sa tulay hanggang masira ito!
fact_en:
Why did the Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapse in 1940?

Strong wind created resonant vibrations that shook the bridge bigger and bigger until it tore apart!

title: Plumb Line Method
fact_tl: Para malaman ang center of gravity ng irregular shape, isampay ito sa iba't ibang punto at markahan ang plumb line — kung saan nagtatagpo ang lahat ng linya, doon ang center of gravity!
fact_en: To find the center of gravity of an irregular shape, hang it from different points and mark the plumb line each time — where all lines cross is the center of gravity!

title: Hooke's Law sa Spring Force
fact_tl: Sinasabi ng batas ni Hooke na ang puwersa ng spring ay katumbas ng spring constant nito na pinarami sa distansya ng pag-unat o pagpisil nito!
fact_en: Hooke's law says a spring's force equals its spring constant multiplied by how much it's stretched or compressed!

title: Ikatlong Klase Lever
fact_tl: Ang third-class levers tulad ng tongs ay nag-sasacrifice ng force para sa speed! Mas mabilis at malayo ang galaw ng load end kaysa effort end.
fact_en: Third-class levers like tongs sacrifice force for speed! The load end moves faster and farther than the effort end with each action.

title: Compound Pulley Advantage
fact_tl:
Gusto mo bang magbuhat ng mabigat gamit ang kaunting puwersa?

Sa compound pulley system, ang mechanical advantage ay katumbas ng bilang ng rope sections na nagtataglay ng load. Mas marami = mas kaunting force!
fact_en:
Want to lift heavy loads with less force?

In a compound pulley system, the mechanical advantage equals the number of rope sections supporting the load. More sections = less force needed!

title: Cable-Stayed Bridge Tower
fact_tl: Ang cable-stayed bridge ay may mga cable na nakakabit direkta mula sa mataas na tore papuntang deck — bawat cable ay naka-tension at nagdadala ng bahagi ng bigat ng deck pataas sa tore!
fact_en: A cable-stayed bridge has cables stretching straight from a tall tower down to the deck — each cable pulls tight and carries part of the deck's weight up to the tower!

title: Jeepney Leaf Spring Suspension
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang jeepney ng leaf spring suspension! Mga nakatambak na bakal na plato na babaluktot para sumipsip ng shocks. I-store nila ang elastic potential energy para smooth ang biyahe!
fact_en: Jeepneys use leaf spring suspension! Stacked steel plates flex to absorb road shocks. When hitting a pothole, they store elastic potential energy and release it slowly for a smooth ride.

title: Misteryosong Ball Lightning
fact_tl: Ang ball lightning ay isang bihirang misteryosong kumikinang na bola na lumilitaw sa panahon o pagkatapos ng bagyo — hindi pa rin ito ganap na maipaliwanag ng agham!
fact_en: Ball lightning is a rare, mysterious glowing ball that appears during or after thunderstorms — scientists still can't fully explain it!

title: Loob ng Dry Cell Battery
fact_tl:
Ano ang nasa loob ng dry cell battery?

Isang carbon na baras sa gitna (positibong terminal), zinc na panlabas na balot (negatibong terminal), at isang pasta na electrolyte sa pagitan na nagpapahintulot ng chemical reaction!
fact_en:
What's inside a dry cell battery?

A carbon rod in the center (positive terminal), a zinc outer casing (negative terminal), and a paste electrolyte between them that allows the chemical reaction!

title: Bangui Wind Farm
fact_tl:
Nasaan ang kauna-unahang malaking wind farm sa Pilipinas?

Ang Bangui Wind Farm sa Ilocos Norte! May 20 wind turbines ito sa dalampasigan, nagbibigay ng kuryente sa buong rehiyon ng Ilocos.
fact_en:
Where is the Philippines' first big wind farm?

The Bangui Wind Farm in Ilocos Norte! It has 20 wind turbines standing along the shoreline, supplying electricity to the whole Ilocos region.

title: Magat Dam Multi-Purpose
fact_tl:
Ano ang nagpapatangi sa Magat Dam sa Isabela?

Ang Magat Dam ay multi-purpose! Nagbibigay ito ng hydroelectric power sa Luzon, irigasyon sa mga palayan sa Cagayan Valley, at tumutulong laban sa baha.
fact_en:
What makes Magat Dam so special in Isabela?

Magat Dam is multi-purpose! It generates hydroelectric power for Luzon, provides irrigation for rice fields in Cagayan Valley, and helps control flooding.

title: Renewable Energy Act
fact_tl: Ang Renewable Energy Act ng 2008 ay nagbibigay ng incentives sa mga clean energy company! Kasama rito ang feed-in tariff na nagbabayad ng mas mataas sa solar, wind, at geothermal producers.
fact_en: The Renewable Energy Act of 2008 gives incentives to clean energy companies! It includes a feed-in tariff that pays a premium price to solar, wind, and geothermal producers.

title: Solar Water Heater
fact_tl: Ang solar water heater ay gumagamit ng rooftop collectors para makuha ang init ng araw at painitin ang tubig! Nagbibigay ito ng mainit na tubig nang walang kuryente, nakakatipid sa bill.
fact_en: A solar water heater uses rooftop collectors to absorb sunlight and heat a water tank! It gives you hot water without using electricity, saving money on bills.

title: Ohm's Law V=IR
fact_tl: Ang Ohm's law (V = I × R) nag-uugnay sa voltage, current, at resistance. Sa 220V outlet, 110 ohms ng resistance ay 2 amperes ng current!
fact_en: Ohm's law (V = I × R) links voltage, current, and resistance. At a 220V outlet, 110 ohms of resistance means 2 amperes of current!

title: Charger AC papuntang DC
fact_tl: Ang charger ng cellphone ay nagco-convert ng 220-volt AC sa saksakan patungong 5-volt DC — gumagamit ng transformer para bawasan ang boltahe at diode para i-convert ang AC sa DC!
fact_en: A phone charger converts 220-volt AC from the outlet into 5-volt DC for your battery — using a transformer to lower voltage and diodes to switch AC to DC!

title: Fuse Ampere Rating
fact_tl:
Paano pinoprotektahan ng fuse ang bahay mo mula sa sunog?

Ang bawat fuse ay may ampere rating na katumbas ng kapasidad ng kawad — nagtitigil ito bago mainitan ang kawad, pinoprotektahan ang circuit at pinipigilan ang sunog!
fact_en:
How does a fuse protect your home from fires?

Every fuse has an ampere rating matching the wire's capacity — it trips before the wire overheats, protecting the circuit and preventing fires!

title: Tidal Energy sa Sibutu Strait
fact_tl: Ang makikitid na strait sa Pilipinas tulad ng Sibutu Passage at San Bernardino Strait ay may potensyal para sa tidal energy — mabilis na agos ay magpapatakbo ng underwater turbine.
fact_en: Narrow Philippine straits like Sibutu Passage and San Bernardino Strait have tidal energy potential — fast sea currents could drive underwater turbines.

title: V-I Graph ng Ohmic Conductor
fact_tl:
Ano ang itsura ng graph ng boltahe laban sa kuryente para sa isang ohmic conductor?

Ito ay isang tuwid na guhit na dumadaan sa simula! Ang slope ng guhit ay katumbas ng resistensya ng conductor — ganito gumagana ang Ohm's Law!
fact_en:
What does the graph of voltage against current look like for an ohmic conductor?

It's a straight line through the origin! The slope of that line equals the conductor's resistance — that's Ohm's Law in action!

title: Carbon Brush ng DC Motor
fact_tl: Ang mga carbon brush ng DC motor ay nagkakasuot sa pagtagal dahil sa patuloy na pagkikiskis sa commutator — ang regular na pagpapalit ng mga brush ay isa sa pangunahing maintenance!
fact_en: A DC motor's carbon brushes wear out over time from constantly rubbing against the commutator — regularly replacing these brushes is one of the main maintenance tasks!

title: Tidal Barrage Power
fact_tl: Ang tidal barrage ay isang malaking pader na itinayo sa bay o estuary. Habang tumataas at bumababa ang tubig, ang pagkakaiba sa taas ay nagpapatakbo ng mga turbine at generator para gumawa ng predictable na kuryente!
fact_en: A tidal barrage is a huge wall built across a bay or estuary. As the tide rises and falls, the height difference drives turbines and generators to make predictable electricity!

title: Kidlaw Muna bago Kulog
fact_tl:
Bakit nakikita natin ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog?

Mas mabilis ang liwanag kaysa tunog! Kaya nakikita mo muna ang kidlat bago maririnig ang malakas na kulog.
fact_en:
Why do we see lightning before we hear thunder?

Light travels much faster than sound! That's why you always spot the bright flash of lightning before the loud boom of thunder reaches your ears.

title: Infrared Pulse ng TV Remote
fact_tl:
Paano kinokontrol ng TV remote ang telebisyon?

Nagpapadala ito ng hindi nakikitang infrared light pulses! Dumadaan ang mga ito sa hangin para kontrolin ang iyong telebisyon.
fact_en:
How does a TV remote control the television?

It sends invisible infrared light pulses! These pulses travel through the air to control your television.

title: Bakit Nilalamig Nanginginig
fact_tl:
Bakit nilalamig at nanginginig tayo?

Nilalamig tayo kapag tumatakas ang init sa mas malamig na paligid! Nanginginig tayo para gumawa ng bagong init at magpainit.
fact_en:
Why do we feel cold and shiver?

We feel cold when heat escapes to a colder surrounding! We shiver to make new heat and warm up our bodies.

title: Isdang Mukhang Mababaw
fact_tl: Ang isda sa ilalim ng tubig ay mukhang mas malapit sa ibabaw kaysa sa totoong lalim nito! Ito ay dahil nagrerefract ang liwanag kapag lumabas ito sa tubig papunta sa hangin.
fact_en: A fish underwater looks closer to the surface than it really is! That's because light refracts as it exits the water and enters the air.

title: Dalawang Mata, Depth
fact_tl: Ang pagkakaroon ng dalawang forward-facing eyes ay nagbibigay sa atin ng depth perception! Inihahambing ng utak ang bahagyang magkaibang imahe mula sa bawat mata para malaman ang distansya.
fact_en: Having two forward-facing eyes gives us depth perception! Our brain compares the slightly different images from each eye to judge distance.

title: Fish Finder sa Echo Sounder
fact_tl:
Paano nakakahanap ng mga makabagong barko ng mga kawan ng isda?

Gumagamit sila ng echo sounder o fish finder! Nagpapadala ito ng sound pulses pababa, at ang mga echo mula sa isda ay lumalabas sa screen.
fact_en:
How do modern fishing boats find schools of fish?

They use an echo sounder or fish finder! It sends sound pulses downward, and the echoes from fish schools show up right on a screen.

title: Celsius papuntang Fahrenheit
fact_tl:
Paano i-convert ang Celsius sa Fahrenheit?

Gumamit ng formula: °F = (°C × 1.8) + 32. Halimbawa, ang 37°C na temperatura ng katawan ay katumbas ng 98.6°F!
fact_en:
How do you convert Celsius to Fahrenheit?

Use the formula: °F = (°C × 1.8) + 32. For example, normal body temperature 37°C equals 98.6°F!

title: Wave Speed Formula
fact_tl: Ang wave speed katumbas ng frequency na pinarami sa wavelength, formula v = f × λ! Para sa tunog sa hangin, mas mataas ang frequency, mas maikli ang wavelength para pareho ang speed.
fact_en: Wave speed equals frequency multiplied by wavelength, using the formula v = f × λ! For sound in air, higher frequency means shorter wavelength, keeping the same speed.

title: Tsunami Hindi Tidal Wave
fact_tl: Ang tsunami ay hindi tidal wave! Nagsisimula ito sa malaking underwater disturbance tulad ng earthquake o landslide, hindi sa tidal forces na galing sa Buwan.
fact_en: A tsunami is not a tidal wave! It starts from a large underwater disturbance like an earthquake or landslide, not from tidal forces caused by the Moon.

title: Thermal Strata ng Taal Lake
fact_tl:
Bakit mas mainit ang ibabaw ng Taal Lake kaysa sa ilalim?

Ang Taal Lake ay may thermal stratification! Ang ibabaw ay mas mainit dahil sa solar heating, habang mas malamig ang malalim. Iba ang density nila kaya hiwalay ang layers!
fact_en:
Why is the top of Taal Lake warmer than the bottom?

Taal Lake is thermally stratified! Solar heating warms the surface, while deeper water stays cooler. Density differences keep these layers separate.

title: Morse Telegraph noong 1844
fact_tl:
Kailan ipinadala ni Morse ang unang publikong mensahe sa telegraph?

Noong 1844, ipinadala ni Samuel Morse ang kanyang unang publikong mensahe sa telegraph mula Washington patungong Baltimore!
fact_en:
When did Morse send the first public telegraph message?

In 1844, Samuel Morse sent his first public telegraph message from Washington to Baltimore!

title: Radyo ni Marconi noong 1895
fact_tl: Ipinakita ni Guglielmo Marconi ang kanyang kahanga-hangang wireless radio noong mga 1895, sa dulo ng dekada 1890!
fact_en: Guglielmo Marconi showed off his awesome wireless radio around 1895, right at the end of the 1890s!

title: Telepono noong 1876
fact_tl: Naimbento ni Alexander Graham Bell ang telepono matagal na noong 1876!
fact_en: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone a long time ago in the year 1876!

title: 1800 Unang Baterya Taon
fact_tl: Ang unang baterya ay naimbento noong matagal na ang nakalipas, noong taong 1800 mismo!
fact_en: The very first battery was invented a long time ago, way back in the year 1800!

title: Volt Yunit kay Alessandro Volta
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang yunit na 'volt'?

Ang yunit na 'volt' ay ipinangalan kay Alessandro Volta!
fact_en:
Who is the 'volt' named after?

The unit called the 'volt' is named after Alessandro Volta!

title: Dynamo ni Faraday noong 1831
fact_tl: Si Michael Faraday ang gumawa ng unang dynamo, na kilala rin bilang generator, noong 1831!
fact_en: Michael Faraday invented the very first dynamo, which is also known as a generator, in 1831!

title: Farad Unit kay Michael Faraday
fact_tl: Ang yunit na 'farad' ay tunay na ipinangalan kay Michael Faraday mismo, alam mo!
fact_en: The unit called the 'farad' is actually named after Michael Faraday himself, you know!

title: Unang Electric Motor
fact_tl: Si Michael Faraday ang gumawa ng unang elektrikong motor noong taong 1821 mismo, alam mo!
fact_en: Michael Faraday built the very first electric motor way back in the year 1821!

title: AC Motor ni Nikola Tesla
fact_tl: Si Nikola Tesla ang gumawa ng napakagandang AC (alternating current) na motor! Nakakatulong ang cool na imbensyon na ito sa maraming bagay.
fact_en: Nikola Tesla invented the amazing AC (alternating current) motor! This cool invention helps power so many things we use every day.

title: Bombilya ni Edison noong 1879
fact_tl: Ginawa ni Thomas Edison ang kanyang astig na praktikal na bombilya noong 1879, nagdala ng liwanag sa gabi!
fact_en: Thomas Edison created his awesome practical light bulb in the year 1879, bringing light to the night!

title: Yunit ng Watt kay James Watt
fact_tl: Ang 'watt' ang sumusukat ng power, at ang unit na ito ay ipinangalan kay James Watt!
fact_en: The 'watt' measures power, and this cool unit is named after the inventor James Watt!

title: Telepono noong 1876
fact_tl: Si Alexander Graham Bell ang gumawa ng unang praktikal na telepono noong 1876!
fact_en: Alexander Graham Bell invented the very first practical telephone way back in 1876!

title: Patent ni Tesla kay Westinghouse
fact_tl: Binili ni George Westinghouse ang mga patent ng AC motor ni Tesla para gamitin sa electric power!
fact_en: George Westinghouse bought Tesla's AC motor patents so he could use them for electric power!

title: Yunit ng Watt kay James Watt
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng power ay ang watt! Ipinangalan ito sa imbentor na si James Watt.
fact_en: The unit of power is the watt! It is named after the great inventor James Watt.

title: Voltaic Pile noong 1800
fact_tl: Noong 1800, inimbento ni Alessandro Volta ang unang electric battery, na tinatawag na voltaic pile!
fact_en: Way back in 1800, Alessandro Volta invented the very first electric battery, called the voltaic pile!

title: Coulomb Mula kay Coulomb
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng electric charge ay tinatawag na coulomb. Ipinangalan ito sa siyentipikong si Charles-Augustin de Coulomb!
fact_en: The unit of electric charge is called the coulomb. It is named after the scientist Charles-Augustin de Coulomb!

title: Hertz Mula kay Hertz
fact_tl:
Ano ang tawag sa yunit ng frequency?

Ang yunit ng frequency ay ang hertz, ipinangalan sa siyentipikong si Heinrich Hertz!
fact_en:
What is the unit of frequency called?

The unit of frequency is the hertz, named after the scientist Heinrich Hertz!

title: Newton Mula kay Newton
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng puwersa (force) ay tinatawag na newton. Ipinangalan ito kay Isaac Newton!
fact_en: The unit of force is called the newton. It is named after the famous scientist Isaac Newton!

title: Kidlaw Muna bago Kulog
fact_tl:
Bakit nakikita muna natin ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog?

Dahil mas mabilis ang liwanag (300,000 km/s) kaysa tunog (343 m/s)!
fact_en:
Why do we see lightning before hearing thunder?

Because light travels at 300,000 km/s, which is much faster than sound at 343 m/s!

title: Unang Batas Newton
fact_tl: Ang unang batas ni Newton (law of inertia) ay nagsasabing ang bagay na nakapahinga ay mananatiling nakapahinga, at ang gumagalaw ay patuloy na gagalaw, maliban kung may puwersang kumilos!
fact_en: Newton's first law (law of inertia) says an object at rest stays at rest, and one in motion stays in motion, unless a force acts on it!

title: Batas Newton 2
fact_tl:
Paano natin kinakalkula ang puwersa sa ikalawang batas ni Newton?

Ang ikalawang batas ni Newton ay nagsasabing ang puwersa ay katumbas ng masa na pinarami sa acceleration, na isinusulat bilang F=ma!
fact_en:
How do we calculate force in Newton's second law?

Newton's second law says that force equals mass times acceleration, which is written as F=ma!

title: Batas Newton 3
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba na bawat aksyon ay may reaksyon?

Ang ikatlong batas ni Newton ay nagsasabing sa bawat aksyon, may katumbas at kabaligtarang reaksyon!
fact_en:
Did you know every action has a reaction?

Newton's third law says that for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction!

title: Tatlong Batas ni Isaac Newton
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng tatlong batas ng galaw?

Ang tatlong batas ng galaw ay ginawa ng English na siyentipikong si Isaac Newton!
fact_en:
Who created the three laws of motion?

The three laws of motion were made by the English scientist Isaac Newton!

title: Principia noong 1687
fact_tl:
Kailan at saan inilathala ni Isaac Newton ang kanyang mga batas ng galaw?

Inilathala niya sila noong taong 1687 sa kanyang aklat na tinatawag na Principia!
fact_en:
When and where did Isaac Newton publish his laws of motion?

He published them in the year 1687 in his book called the Principia!

title: Unang Kotse ni Karl Benz
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang modernong kotse na de-gasolina?

Si Karl Benz ng Germany ang kinikilalang gumawa ng unang modernong kotse na de-gasolina!
fact_en:
Who built the very first modern gasoline-powered car?

Karl Benz of Germany is credited with building the first modern gasoline-powered car!

title: Patent-Motorwagen noong 1886
fact_tl: Pinatentehan ni Karl Benz ang kaniyang unang kotse, ang Benz Patent-Motorwagen, noong 1886!
fact_en: Karl Benz patented his first car, the Benz Patent-Motorwagen, in 1886!

title: 1769 Watt Separate Condenser
fact_tl: Pinatentehan ni James Watt ang kaniyang separate condenser para sa steam engine noong 1769!
fact_en: James Watt patented his separate condenser for the steam engine in 1769!

title: Watt na Yunit kay James Watt
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang yunit ng kapangyarihan na watt (W)?

Ang yunit ng kapangyarihan na watt (W) ay ipinangalan kay James Watt!
fact_en:
Who is the unit of power, the watt (W), named after?

The watt (W), the unit of power, is named after James Watt!

title: Rocket Locomotive 1829
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagtayo ng sikat na lokomotibong "Rocket" noong 1829?

Itinayo ang sikat na lokomotibong "Rocket" nina Stephenson noong 1829!
fact_en:
Who built the famous "Rocket" locomotive in 1829?

The famous "Rocket" locomotive was built by the Stephensons in 1829!

title: Trevithick noong 1804
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng pinakaunang steam railway locomotive sa mundo?

Si Richard Trevithick ang gumawa ng pinakaunang steam railway locomotive sa mundo noong 1804. Ang galing niyan!
fact_en:
Who built the world's first steam railway locomotive?

Richard Trevithick built the world's first steam railway locomotive in 1804. What a cool piece of history!

title: Patent ni Whittle noong 1930
fact_tl:
Kailan unang pinatentehan ni Frank Whittle ang kaniyang turbojet engine?

Naunang pinatentehan ni Frank Whittle ang kaniyang turbojet engine noong 1930. Doon naging opisyal ang kaniyang kamanghang ideya!
fact_en:
When did Frank Whittle first patent his turbojet engine?

Frank Whittle first patented his turbojet engine in 1930. That's when his amazing idea became official!

title: Diesel Engine ni Rudolf Diesel
fact_tl:
Sino ang nag-imbento ng diesel engine?

Si Rudolf Diesel ng Germany ang gumawa ng diesel engine, na pinatentehan noong 1893. Kaya 'diesel' ang tawag niyan!
fact_en:
Who invented the diesel engine?

Rudolf Diesel of Germany invented the diesel engine, which was patented in 1893. That's why it's called 'diesel'!

title: Wright noong 1903
fact_tl:
Kailan at saan lumipad ang unang eroplano ng magkapatid na Wright?

Lumipad ang unang eroplano ng magkapatid na Wright noong Disyembre 17, 1903 sa Kitty Hawk. Isang makasaysayang araw!
fact_en:
When and where did the Wright brothers make their first airplane flight?

The Wright brothers' first airplane flight was on December 17, 1903, at Kitty Hawk. A historic day for flight!

title: Unang Lipad na 12 Segundo
fact_tl: Ang unang lipad ng magkapatid na Wright ay tumagal lamang ng 12 segundo at umabot ng 36 metro (120 talampakan) lang!
fact_en: The Wright brothers' very first flight lasted just 12 seconds and covered a short 36 meters (120 feet)!

title: Mole (SI Unit)
fact_tl: Ang mole (mol) ang SI base unit na ginagamit para sukatin ang dami ng sangkap o amount of substance!
fact_en: The mole (mol) is the official SI base unit used to measure the amount of substance!

title: Pitong SI Base Units Siyensya
fact_tl: May pito (7) na SI base units sa siyensya: metro, kilogramo, segundo, ampere, kelvin, mole, at candela!
fact_en: There are exactly seven (7) SI base units in science: meter, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, mole, and candela!

title: Celsius Scale 1742 Proposed Year
fact_tl: Iminungkahi ng matalinong Anders Celsius ang kanyang temperature scale noong taong 1742!
fact_en: The brilliant Anders Celsius proposed his famous temperature scale a long time ago, way back in the year 1742!

title: 1724 Fahrenheit Scale Taon
fact_tl:
Kailan ginawa ni Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit ang Fahrenheit scale?

Ginawa ni Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit ang kanyang Fahrenheit scale noong taong 1724!
fact_en:
When did Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit develop the Fahrenheit scale?

Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit developed his famous Fahrenheit scale a long time ago, in the year 1724!

title: Si Lord Kelvin William Thomson
fact_tl: Si William Thomson, na kilala bilang Lord Kelvin, ang gumawa ng Kelvin temperature scale!
fact_en: William Thomson, also known as Lord Kelvin, created the Kelvin temperature scale!

title: 1848 Kelvin Scale Iminungkahi
fact_tl: Iminungkahi ni Lord Kelvin (William Thomson) ang Kelvin scale noong taong 1848!
fact_en: Lord Kelvin, whose real name was William Thomson, proposed the Kelvin scale in 1848!

title: Newton, SI Yunit ng Puwersa
fact_tl: Ang SI unit ng puwersa (force) ay newton (N)! Ipinangalan ito sa sikat na siyentipikong si Isaac Newton.
fact_en: The SI unit of force is the newton (N)! It is named after the famous scientist Isaac Newton.

title: Joule, SI Yunit ng Enerhiya
fact_tl: Ang SI unit ng enerhiya at trabaho (work) ay joule (J)! Ipinangalan ito sa siyentipikong si James Joule.
fact_en: The SI unit of energy and work is the joule (J)! It is named after the scientist James Joule.

title: Volt, SI Yunit ng Boltahe
fact_tl: Ang SI unit ng boltahe (voltage) ay volt (V)! Ipinangalan ito sa siyentipikong si Alessandro Volta.
fact_en: The SI unit of voltage is the volt (V)! It is named after the scientist Alessandro Volta.

title: Pascal, SI Yunit ng Presyon
fact_tl: Ang SI unit ng presyon (pressure) ay pascal (Pa)! Ipinangalan ito sa siyentipikong si Blaise Pascal.
fact_en: The SI unit of pressure is the pascal (Pa)! It is named after the scientist Blaise Pascal.

title: Mach 1 sa 1,225 kph
fact_tl: Ang Mach 1 ay bilis ng tunog — mga 1,225 kilometro kada oras sa lebel ng dagat. Super bilis!
fact_en: Mach 1 is the speed of sound — about 1,225 kilometers per hour at sea level. Super sonic!

title: Silver Pinakamahusay Conductor
fact_tl: Sa lahat ng metal, ang makintab na pilak (silver) ang pinakamahusay na konduktor ng kuryente!
fact_en: Out of all metals, shiny silver is the absolute best conductor of electricity!

title: 1903 Unang Lipad
fact_tl: Ang magkapatid na Wright ay unang nakalipad ng eroplano noong 1903! Isang napakahalagang sandali ito sa kasaysayan.
fact_en: The Wright brothers made the first airplane flight in 1903! It was a huge moment in history.

title: James Watt sa Steam Engine
fact_tl: Pinaunlad ni James Watt ang steam engine (makinang pinapaandar ng singaw)! Ginawa niya itong mas mabisa at mas mahusay.
fact_en: James Watt greatly improved the steam engine! He made it work much better and more efficiently.

title: Ada Lovelace Unang Programmer
fact_tl: Kilalanin natin si Ada Lovelace! Siya ang itinuturing na unang computer programmer sa buong mundo. Ang galing, 'di ba?
fact_en: Meet Ada Lovelace! She is considered the very first computer programmer in the whole wide world. How cool is that?

title: @ Sign sa Unang Email
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpadala ng unang network email at gumamit ng @ sign sa unang pagkakataon?

Sinimulan ito ni Ray Tomlinson noong 1971 gamit ang unang network email at ang @ sign!
fact_en:
Who sent the very first network email and used the @ sign for the first time?

Ray Tomlinson started it all in 1971 with the first network email and the @ sign!

title: Unang Gumaganang Telebisyon
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpakita ng unang gumaganang telebisyon?

Si John Logie Baird ang nagpakita ng unang gumaganang telebisyon noong 1926!
fact_en:
Who showed the very first working television?

John Logie Baird demonstrated the first working television in 1926!

title: Makinang Pananahi ni Elias Howe
fact_tl: Si Elias Howe ang nag-patent ng lockstitch na makina sa pananahi noong 1846!
fact_en: Elias Howe patented the lockstitch sewing machine in 1846!

title: Home Sewing Machine ni Singer
fact_tl: Si Isaac Singer ang gumawa ng unang sikat na makina sa pananahi para sa bahay noong 1851!
fact_en: Isaac Singer made the first popular home sewing machine in 1851!

title: Separate Condenser ni James Watt
fact_tl: Si James Watt ang nagpaganda ng makinang de-singaw noong 1769 sa pamamagitan ng separate condenser!
fact_en: James Watt greatly improved the steam engine in 1769 with his separate condenser!

title: Unang Makinang de-Singaw
fact_tl: Si Thomas Newcomen ang gumawa ng unang kapaki-pakinabang na makinang de-singaw noong 1712, bago pa si Watt!
fact_en: Thomas Newcomen built the first useful steam engine in 1712, before Watt improved it!

title: Unang Gumaganang Refrigerator
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang gumaganang refrigerator?

Si Jacob Perkins ang gumawa ng unang gumaganang refrigerator na gumagamit ng vapor compression noong 1834!
fact_en:
Who built the very first working refrigerator?

Jacob Perkins built the first working refrigerator using vapor compression in 1834!

title: Unang Radyo Signal sa Atlantiko
fact_tl: Noong 1901, nagpadala si Marconi ng unang radyo signal na tumawid sa Karagatang Atlantiko!
fact_en: In 1901, Marconi sent the first radio signal across the Atlantic Ocean!

title: Unang Automobile ni Karl Benz
fact_tl: Ginawa ni Karl Benz ang kaniyang unang automobile noong mga taong 1885 hanggang 1886!
fact_en: Karl Benz built his very first automobile in the years 1885 to 1886!

title: Liquid Rocket ni Robert Goddard
fact_tl: Si Robert Goddard ang gumawa ng unang liquid-fuel rocket na lumipad!
fact_en: Robert Goddard built the very first liquid-fuel rocket to ever fly!

title: Maraming Kotse ni Henry Ford
fact_tl:
Paano ginawa ni Henry Ford nang marami ang mga kotse tulad ng Model T?

Ginamit niya ang assembly line para makagawa ng marami!
fact_en:
How did Henry Ford mass-produce cars like the Model T?

He used an assembly line to build them!

title: Solo Flight ni Lindbergh 1927
fact_tl: Noong 1927, gumawa ng kasaysayan si Charles Lindbergh bilang unang taong nag-solo nonstop sa Atlantic Ocean!
fact_en: In 1927, Charles Lindbergh made history by becoming the first person to fly solo nonstop across the Atlantic Ocean!

title: 3 Batas Motion ni Newton
fact_tl: Si Sir Isaac Newton ang matalinong siyentipiko na gumawa ng tatlo (3) na sikat na batas ng galaw!
fact_en: Sir Isaac Newton is the brilliant scientist who made three (3) famous laws of motion!

title: Oersted Current Magnetism
fact_tl: Nakita ni Hans Christian Oersted na ang dumadaloy na kuryente ay gumagawa ng magnetismo dahil gumalaw ang karayom ng kompas!
fact_en: Hans Christian Oersted found that an electric current makes magnetism because a compass needle moved near a wire!

title: Electromagnetism noong 1820
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Hans Christian Oersted ang kahanga-hangang ugnayan ng kuryente at magnetismo noong 1820!
fact_en: Hans Christian Oersted discovered the amazing link between electricity and magnetism way back in 1820!

title: Ohm Kay Georg Ohm
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng resistensya ng kuryente ay ohm (Ω), na ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm!
fact_en: The unit of electrical resistance is the ohm (Ω), named after Georg Ohm!

title: Watt Unit Power kay James Watt
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng power ay watt (W). Ipinangalan ito kay James Watt!
fact_en: The unit of power is the watt (W). It is named after James Watt!

title: Radio Waves ni Heinrich Hertz
fact_tl: Si Heinrich Hertz ang unang gumawa at nakakita ng radio waves. Pinatunayan niya na tama ang hula ni Maxwell!
fact_en: Heinrich Hertz was the very first person to produce and detect radio waves. He proved Maxwell's prediction was totally right!

title: Ampere SI Base Yunit
fact_tl: Sa pitong saligang yunit ng SI, ang ampere (A) ang nag-iisang yunit para sa kuryente!
fact_en: Out of the seven SI base units, the ampere (A) is the one and only electrical unit!

title: Sing Along System ni Del Rosario
fact_tl: Si Roberto del Rosario ay may patent sa 'Sing Along System' sa Pilipinas. Madalas siyang tawaging imbentor ng karaoke, pero iba ang kuwento sa ibang bansa!
fact_en: Roberto del Rosario patented a 'Sing Along System' in the Philippines. He's often called the inventor of karaoke, though the story varies worldwide!

title: Del Mundo National Scientist
fact_tl: Ginawaran si Dr. Fe del Mundo ng titulong National Scientist of the Philippines dahil sa kanyang magandang gawain para sa kalusugan ng mga bata!
fact_en: Dr. Fe del Mundo earned the title National Scientist of the Philippines for her amazing work in children's health!

title: Ibig Sabihin ng Mach 1
fact_tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin kapag ang eroplano ay lumilipad sa Mach 1?

Ang Mach 1 ay ibig sabihin gumagalaw kasimbilis ng tunog (halos 343 m/s)! Kapag mas mabilis pa rito, tinatawag itong supersonic.
fact_en:
What does it mean when a jet flies at Mach 1?

Mach 1 means moving exactly at the speed of sound, which is about 343 m/s! If it goes faster, it is called supersonic.

title: Si Daniel Fahrenheit
fact_tl: Ang Fahrenheit scale ay ipinangalan kay Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit, isang German na pisiko!
fact_en: The Fahrenheit scale is named after Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit, a German physicist!

title: Si Lord Kelvin na Pisiko
fact_tl: Ang Kelvin scale ay ipinangalan kay Lord Kelvin (William Thomson), na isang British na pisiko!
fact_en: The Kelvin scale is named after Lord Kelvin (William Thomson), who was a British physicist!

title: pH Scale 0-14
fact_tl: Ang pH scale ay mula 0 hanggang 14, at sa gitna, ang 7 ay neutral!
fact_en: The pH scale runs from 0 to 14, and right in the middle, 7 is neutral!

title: Dalisay Tubig pH 7 Neutral
fact_tl:
Ano ang pH level ng dalisay na tubig?

Ang dalisay na tubig ay may pH na 7, na ibig sabihin neutral ito!
fact_en:
What is the pH level of pure water?

Pure water has a pH of 7, which means it is perfectly neutral!

title: Beaufort 0 Kalmado 12 Hurricane
fact_tl: Sinusukat ng Beaufort scale ang hangin! Mula ito sa 0 na kalmado hanggang 12 na hurricane force.
fact_en: The Beaufort scale measures wind! It runs from 0 for calm winds up to 12 for hurricane force.

title: Si Friedrich Mohs na Geologist
fact_tl: Ang Mohs scale ay ginawa ni Friedrich Mohs! Siya ay isang German na geologist noong 1812.
fact_en: The Mohs scale was created by Friedrich Mohs! He was a German geologist who made it in 1812.

title: Si James Watt na Inhinyero
fact_tl: Ang watt ay ipinangalan kay James Watt! Siya ay isang Scottish na inhinyero.
fact_en: The watt is named after James Watt! He was a Scottish engineer.

title: Fossil Fuels mula sa Labi
fact_tl:
Ano ang fossil fuels?

Ang fossil fuels tulad ng coal, oil, at natural gas ay nabuo mula sa mga labi ng patay na halaman at hayop milyon-milyong taon na ang nakalipas!
fact_en:
What are fossil fuels?

Fossil fuels like coal, oil, and natural gas are formed from the remains of dead plants and animals from millions of years ago!

title: Tatlong Fossil Fuels
fact_tl:
Ano ang tatlong pangunahing fossil fuels?

Ang tatlong pangunahing uri ng fossil fuels na ginagamit natin ay coal, oil (petroleum), at natural gas!
fact_en:
What are the three main fossil fuels?

The three main types of fossil fuels we use are coal, oil (petroleum), and natural gas!

title: Gutenberg Bible at Movable Type
fact_tl:
Ano ang isa sa mga unang aklat na inimprenta gamit ang movable type?

Ang Gutenberg Bible ang isa sa unang mga aklat na inimprenta gamit ang movable type!
fact_en:
What was one of the very first books printed using movable type?

The Gutenberg Bible was actually one of the very first books printed using movable type!

title: ENIAC noong 1945–1946
fact_tl: Natapos at ipinakilala ang ENIAC computer noong 1945–1946!
fact_en: The ENIAC computer was completed and unveiled in 1945–1946!

title: Ama ng Kompyuter si Babbage
fact_tl: Si Charles Babbage ang tinaguriang Ama ng Kompyuter dahil sa kanyang Analytical Engine!
fact_en: Charles Babbage is called the Father of the Computer for designing the Analytical Engine!

title: Ada Lovelace Unang Programmer
fact_tl: Si Ada Lovelace ang itinuturing na unang computer programmer sa kasaysayan!
fact_en: Ada Lovelace is regarded as the first computer programmer in history!

title: 1991 Unang Website Online
fact_tl: Ang unang website sa mundo ay inilathala ni Tim Berners-Lee noong 1991!

title: X-15 Rocket Plane
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na eroplanong may piloto sa kasaysayan ay ang North American X-15, isang rocket plane na umabot ng halos 7,200 km/h, mga Mach 6.7!
fact_en: The fastest crewed aircraft ever is the North American X-15, a rocket plane that hit about 7,200 km/h, around Mach 6.7!

title: New York hanggang Paris Oras
fact_tl:
Gaano katagal ang lipad ni Lindbergh mula New York hanggang Paris?

Tumagal ng halos 33 at kalahating oras ang lipad niya mula New York hanggang Paris!
fact_en:
How long did Lindbergh's flight from New York to Paris take?

His awesome flight from New York to Paris took about 33 and a half hours!

title: Unang Babaeng Solo sa Atlantiko
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang babaeng lumipad nang nag-iisa patawid sa Karagatang Atlantiko?

Si Amelia Earhart ang unang babaeng nag-isang lumipad patawid sa Atlantiko!
fact_en:
Who was the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean?

Amelia Earhart was the very first woman to fly solo across the huge Atlantic Ocean!

title: Unang Balloon Flight
fact_tl: Ang pinakaunang lipad ng hot air balloon ay nangyari noong taong 1783! Isipin mo na lang na lumutang noon!
fact_en: The very first hot air balloon flight ever happened way back in the year 1783! Imagine floating up then!

title: Heinkel He 178
fact_tl: Ang Heinkel He 178 mula sa Alemanya ay may espesyal na titulo: ito ang pinakaunang jet aircraft na lumipad!
fact_en: The Heinkel He 178 from Germany holds a special title: it was the very first jet aircraft to ever fly!

title: Unang Lipad ng He 178
fact_tl: Ang Heinkel He 178, ang pinakaunang jet aircraft sa mundo, ay lumipad sa kalangitan noong 1939!
fact_en: The Heinkel He 178, the world's first jet aircraft, zoomed into the sky for its very first flight in 1939!

title: Newcomen Steam 1712
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang praktikal na makinang de-singaw?

Si Thomas Newcomen ang gumawa nito noong 1712! Ginamit ito para magbomba ng tubig palabas sa mga minahan.
fact_en:
Who built the first practical steam engine?

Thomas Newcomen built it in 1712! It was used to pump water out of mines.

title: Stephenson Rocket Locomotive
fact_tl: Si George Stephenson at ang anak niyang si Robert ang gumawa ng tanyag na steam locomotive na 'Rocket'!
fact_en: George Stephenson and his son Robert built the famous steam locomotive called the 'Rocket'!

title: Lokomotibong Rocket 1829
fact_tl: Ang 'Rocket' na lokomotibo ni Stephenson ay ginawa noong taong 1829!
fact_en: Stephenson's famous 'Rocket' locomotive was built in the year 1829!

title: Hargreaves Spinning Jenny
fact_tl: Noong mga 1764, si James Hargreaves ang nag-imbento ng spinning jenny, isang makina sa paghabi ng sinulid!
fact_en: Around 1764, James Hargreaves invented the spinning jenny, a cool machine for spinning thread!

title: Fulton Clermont Steamship 1807
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang matagumpay na komersyal na steamship?

Si Robert Fulton ang gumawa nito noong 1807, at pinangalanan niya itong 'Clermont'!
fact_en:
Who built the first successful commercial steamship?

Robert Fulton built it in 1807, and he named it the 'Clermont'!

title: Trevithick noong 1804
fact_tl: Si Richard Trevithick ang gumawa ng unang lokomotibong de-singaw na tumakbo sa riles noong 1804! Choo choo!
fact_en: Richard Trevithick built the very first steam locomotive to run on rails way back in 1804! Choo choo!

title: Unang Alpabetong Phoenician
fact_tl: Ang alpabetong Phoenician ang itinuturing na unang alpabeto — at ito ang pinagmulan ng maraming letra na ginagamit natin ngayon!
fact_en: The Phoenician alphabet is considered the first alphabet — and it's the source of many letters we use today!

title: Talon Maria Cristina
fact_tl: Ang Maria Cristina Falls sa Iligan ay gumagawa ng kuryente! Pinapagana nito ang Agus VI hydroelectric power plant.
fact_en: Maria Cristina Falls in Iligan makes electricity! It powers the Agus VI hydroelectric power plant.

title: Unang Kotse ni Karl Benz
fact_tl: Si Karl Benz ang gumawa ng unang praktikal na kotseng de-gasolina! Tinawag niya itong Benz Patent-Motorwagen.
fact_en: Karl Benz built the very first practical gasoline-powered automobile! He called it the Benz Patent-Motorwagen.

title: Benz 1885 Unang Kotse
fact_tl:
Kailan ginawa ang unang kotse?

Ang unang kotse, ang Benz Patent-Motorwagen, ay ginawa noong 1885-1886! Nag-patent si Benz nito noong 1886.
fact_en:
When was the first automobile built?

The first car, the Benz Patent-Motorwagen, was built in 1885-1886! Benz patented it in 1886.

title: Ford Model T na Abot-Kaya
fact_tl: Ginawa ni Henry Ford abot-kaya ang mga sasakyan sa pamamagitan ng pagbuo ng Model T sa assembly line!
fact_en: Henry Ford made cars affordable for everyone by building the Model T on an assembly line!

title: Ford Model T 1908 Unang Labas
fact_tl:
Kailan unang lumabas ang Ford Model T?

Ang kahanga-hangang Ford Model T ay unang ipinakilala sa mundo noong 1908!
fact_en:
When did the Ford Model T first appear?

The awesome Ford Model T was first introduced to the world in the year 1908!

title: Assembly Line 1913
fact_tl:
Kailan sinimulan ni Henry Ford ang moving assembly line para sa Model T?

Sinimulan ni Henry Ford ang moving assembly line para sa Model T noong taong 1913!
fact_en:
When did Henry Ford start the moving assembly line for the Model T?

Henry Ford officially started the moving assembly line for the Model T in the year 1913!

title: Dunlop Tire 1888
fact_tl: Ginawa ni John Boyd Dunlop ang praktikal na air-filled tire noong taong 1888!
fact_en: John Boyd Dunlop made the very first practical air-filled tire in the year 1888!

title: Cugnot Steam 1769
fact_tl: Si Nicolas-Joseph Cugnot mula France ang gumawa ng pinakaunang sasakyang de-singaw (steam) noong 1769!
fact_en: Nicolas-Joseph Cugnot from France built the very first steam-powered vehicle way back in 1769!

title: Unang Ilaw Trapiko
fact_tl:
Saan inilagay ang pinakaunang elektrikong ilaw-trapiko?

Sa Cleveland, Ohio noong 1914!
fact_en:
Where was the very first electric traffic light installed?

In Cleveland, Ohio, way back in 1914!

title: Kulay ng Ford Model T
fact_tl: Karamihan sa Ford Model T ay kulay itim para makamura at mapabilis ang paggawa ng mga kotse!
fact_en: Most Ford Model T cars were painted black because it kept them cheap and helped speed up production!

title: Unang Litrato sa Le Gras
fact_tl:
Kailan kinunan ang pinakaunang larawan?

Ang unang permanenteng larawan ay kinunan noong mga 1826! Tinawag itong "View from the Window at Le Gras."
fact_en:
When was the very first photograph ever taken?

The first permanent photograph was taken around 1826! It's called "View from the Window at Le Gras."

title: Daguerreotype noong 1839
fact_tl: Inihayag ang daguerreotype sa publiko noong 1839 sa France!
fact_en: The daguerreotype was announced to the public in 1839 in France!

title: James Watt at Steam Engine
fact_tl: Ang yunit na watt ay ipinangalan kay James Watt! Siya ay isang Scottish engineer na nagpaunlad ng steam engine.
fact_en: The watt unit is named after James Watt! He was a Scottish engineer who improved the steam engine.

title: Si Andre-Marie Ampere
fact_tl: Ang yunit na ampere ay ipinangalan kay Andre-Marie Ampere! Siya ay isang French scientist na nag-aral ng electricity at magnetism.
fact_en: The ampere unit is named after Andre-Marie Ampere! He was a French scientist who studied electricity and magnetism.

title: Si Alessandro Volta
fact_tl: Ang yunit na volt ay ipinangalan kay Alessandro Volta! Siya ay isang Italian scientist na gumawa ng unang battery.
fact_en: The volt unit is named after Alessandro Volta! He was an Italian scientist who made the first battery.

title: Si Georg Ohm
fact_tl: Ang yunit na ohm ay ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm! Siya ay isang German scientist na nakadiskubre ng Ohm's Law.
fact_en: The ohm unit is named after Georg Ohm! He was a German scientist who discovered Ohm's Law.

title: Si Heinrich Hertz
fact_tl: Ang yunit na hertz ay ipinangalan kay Heinrich Hertz! Siya ay isang German scientist na nagpatunay na may radio waves.
fact_en: The hertz unit is named after Heinrich Hertz! He was a German scientist who proved that radio waves exist.

title: Si Blaise Pascal
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang pascal?

Ipinangalan ito kay Blaise Pascal, isang Pranses na siyentista at matematiko na nag-aral ng presyon!
fact_en:
Who is the pascal named after?

It's named after Blaise Pascal, a French scientist and mathematician who studied pressure!

title: Si Lord Kelvin
fact_tl: Ang kelvin ay ipinangalan kay Lord Kelvin (William Thomson), isang Britanong siyentista na gumawa ng absolute temperature scale!
fact_en: The kelvin is named after Lord Kelvin (William Thomson), a British scientist who created the absolute temperature scale!

title: Si Anders Celsius
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang Celsius scale (°C)?

Ipinangalan ito kay Anders Celsius, isang Swedish na astronomo!
fact_en:
Who is the Celsius scale (°C) named after?

It's named after Anders Celsius, a Swedish astronomer!

title: Si Daniel Fahrenheit
fact_tl: Ang Fahrenheit temperature scale (°F) ay ipinangalan kay Daniel Fahrenheit, isang Alemang siyentista!
fact_en: The Fahrenheit temperature scale (°F) is named after Daniel Fahrenheit, a German scientist!

title: Tesla Unit ng Magnetic Field
fact_tl:
Anong yunit ang sumusukat ng lakas ng magnetic field?

Sinusukat ito sa teslas (T), na ipinangalan kay Nikola Tesla!
fact_en:
What unit measures the strength of a magnetic field?

It's measured in teslas (T), named after the brilliant Nikola Tesla!

title: Coulomb French Scientist
fact_tl: Ang yunit na coulomb ay ipinangalan kay Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, isang Pranses na siyentista na nag-aral ng puwersa ng kuryente!
fact_en: The coulomb unit is named after Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, a French scientist who studied electric force!

title: Si Michael Faraday
fact_tl: Ang yunit na farad ay ipinangalan kay Michael Faraday, isang Britanong siyentista na nag-aral ng kuryente at magnetismo!
fact_en: The farad unit is named after Michael Faraday, a British scientist who studied electricity and magnetism!

title: Unang Nobel Prize sa Physics
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang nanalo ng Nobel Prize sa Physics?

Si Wilhelm Roentgen ang unang nanalo ng Nobel Prize sa Physics noong 1901 dahil sa X-rays!
fact_en:
Who won the very first Nobel Prize in Physics?

Wilhelm Roentgen won the first Nobel Prize in Physics in 1901 for discovering X-rays!

title: Newton Ingles Siyentipiko
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ay isang napakatalinong siyentipikong Ingles na nagmula sa bansang England!
fact_en: Isaac Newton was a brilliant English scientist who originally came from the country of England!

title: Unang Kotse ni Karl Benz
fact_tl: Si Karl Benz ang naimbento ng unang kotse na de-gasolina noong 1886!
fact_en: Karl Benz invented the very first gasoline-powered automobile way back in 1886!

title: Metro kwadrado, Yunit ng Lawak
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng lawak (area) sa SI ay square meter o metro kwadrado, at ang simbolo nito ay m²!
fact_en: The SI unit of area is the square meter, and its symbol is m²!

title: Metrong Kubiko, Yunit ng Volume
fact_tl:
Ano ang yunit ng volume sa SI?

Ang yunit ng volume sa SI ay cubic meter o metro kubiko, at ang simbolo nito ay m³!
fact_en:
What is the SI unit of volume?

The SI unit of volume is the cubic meter, and its symbol is m³!

title: Tatlong Primary Colors
fact_tl: May eksaktong 3 na pangunahing kulay (primary colors) sa pintura: pula, dilaw, at asul!
fact_en: There are exactly 3 primary colors in paint: red, yellow, and blue!

title: Electric Power P = V x I Formula
fact_tl: Ang electric power ay P = V x I! Ibig sabihin, ang power (P) ay boltahe (V) na pinarami sa kuryente (I).
fact_en: Electric power is P = V x I! This means power (P) equals voltage (V) times current (I).

title: Mechanical = Kinetic + Potential
fact_tl: Ang mechanical energy ay ang kabuuan ng kinetic energy at potential energy ng isang bagay!
fact_en: Mechanical energy is the total sum of an object's kinetic energy and potential energy!

title: Langis o Petrolyo
fact_tl:
Anong uri ng pinagkukunan ng enerhiya ang langis o petrolyo (oil)?

Ang langis o petrolyo (oil) ay isang fossil fuel at isang nonrenewable na pinagkukunan ng enerhiya araw-araw!
fact_en:
What kind of energy source is oil or petroleum?

Oil, or petroleum, is a fossil fuel and a nonrenewable energy source that we use daily!

title: Tatlong Fossil Fuel
fact_tl: Ang tatlong pangunahing fossil fuel ay karbon (coal), langis (oil), at natural gas na nagbibigay ng enerhiya!
fact_en: The three main fossil fuels are coal, oil, and natural gas, which give us lots of energy!

title: Limang Renewable Source
fact_tl:
Ano ang limang renewable energy sources natin?

May limang renewable energy sources: ang solar (araw), wind (hangin), hydro (tubig), geothermal (init ng lupa), at biomass!
fact_en:
What are the five amazing renewable energy sources?

There are five amazing renewable energy sources: solar, wind, hydro, geothermal, and biomass!

title: W = m × g Timbang Kalkula
fact_tl:
Naisip mo na ba kung paano kinakalkula ng mga siyentipiko ang timbang mo?

Ang weight (timbang) ay katumbas ng mass na pinarami sa gravity: Weight = mass × gravity (W = m × g).
fact_en:
Ever wonder how scientists calculate your weight?

Weight equals mass multiplied by gravity: Weight = mass × gravity (W = m × g).

title: Apat Fundamental Forces
fact_tl: May apat na pangunahing puwersa sa kalikasan: gravity, electromagnetic, strong nuclear, at weak nuclear force!
fact_en: Nature has four fundamental forces: gravity, electromagnetic, strong nuclear, and weak nuclear force!

title: Newton Universal Gravitation
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ang naglarawan ng batas ng gravity (universal gravitation): lahat ng bagay na may mass ay naghihilahan sa isa't isa!
fact_en: Isaac Newton described the law of gravity (universal gravitation): every object with mass pulls on every other object!

title: Incidence = Reflection Angle
fact_tl: Kapag tumama ang liwanag sa salamin, ang anggulo ng papasok na liwanag ay katumbas ng anggulo ng pabalik na liwanag!
fact_en: When light hits a mirror, the angle of the incoming light perfectly equals the angle of the reflected light!

title: Bardeen Brattain Shockley
fact_tl: Ang transistor ay inimbento nina John Bardeen, Walter Brattain, at William Shockley sa Bell Labs! Nagtulungan sila para likhain ito.
fact_en: The transistor was invented by John Bardeen, Walter Brattain, and William Shockley at Bell Labs! They worked together to create it.

title: Transistor noong 1947
fact_tl: Ang transistor ay naimbento noong 1947 sa Bell Labs! Ito ay isang napakahalagang imbensyon para sa teknolohiya.
fact_en: The transistor was invented in the year 1947 at Bell Labs! It was a very important invention for technology.

title: Babbage Mechanical Computer
fact_tl: Si Charles Babbage ang nagdisenyo ng unang mekanikal na kompyuter at tinatawag na ama ng kompyuter! Siya ay isang mahusay na imbentor.
fact_en: Charles Babbage designed the first mechanical computer and is lovingly called the father of the computer! He was a great inventor.

title: Internet vs World Wide Web
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung ano ang pagkakaiba sa pagitan ng Internet at ng World Wide Web?

Ang Internet ay ang pandaigdigang network ng mga kompyuter, samantalang ang World Wide Web ay ang mga website na ginagamit natin dito!
fact_en:
What is the difference between the Internet and the World Wide Web?

The Internet is the global network of computers, while the World Wide Web is the system of websites we use on it!

title: Tesla AC Electrical System
fact_tl: Si Nikola Tesla ang matalinong nagpaunlad ng alternating current (AC) na sistema ng kuryente na gumagana sa maraming bagay ngayon!
fact_en: Nikola Tesla is the brilliant mind who developed the alternating current (AC) electrical system that powers so many things today!

title: Edison Phonograph Recorder
fact_tl: Si Thomas Edison ang nag-imbento ng phonograph, ang kauna-unahang makina na nakapag-record at nakapagpatugtog ng tunog!
fact_en: Thomas Edison invented the phonograph, which was the very first machine ever that could record and play back sound!

title: Marconi Atlantic Radio Signal
fact_tl: Gumawa ng kasaysayan si Guglielmo Marconi nang ipadala niya ang unang radio signal sa kabila ng Atlantic Ocean noong 1901!
fact_en: Guglielmo Marconi made history by sending the very first radio signal all the way across the Atlantic Ocean in 1901!

title: Web Libre Berners-Lee Kaloob
fact_tl:
Bakit libre ang World Wide Web para sa lahat ngayon?

Pinili ni Tim Berners-Lee na gawin itong libre! Wala siyang siningil at hindi niya ito pinatentehan, kaya lahat ay maaaring magamit ito.
fact_en:
Why is the World Wide Web free for everyone to use today?

Tim Berners-Lee chose to make it completely free! He charged nothing and did not patent it, so we can all enjoy it.

title: Third-Class Lever Fishing Rod
fact_tl: Ang third-class lever tulad ng fishing rod ay kailangan ng mas malaking puwersa kaysa sa output force! Pero napapabilis at napapalayo ang galaw ng load.
fact_en: A third-class lever like a fishing rod requires more input force than the output force! But it gains speed and distance for the load.

title: Tulak ng Dalawang North Pole
fact_tl:
Anong nangyayari kapag inilapit mo ang dalawang north pole ng bar magnet?

Magtutulak ang kanilang magnetic fields at mag-iiwasan sila!
fact_en:
What happens when you bring two north poles of a bar magnet together?

Their magnetic fields repel and push apart!

title: Tiwi Geothermal Albay Luzon Grid
fact_tl: Ang Tiwi Geothermal Power Plant sa Albay ay nagko-convert ng underground thermal heat energy papuntang electrical energy para sa mga bahay sa Luzon grid!
fact_en: The Tiwi Geothermal Power Plant in Albay converts underground thermal heat energy into electrical energy to power homes across the Luzon grid!

title: Bukidnon Solar Photovoltaic Araw
fact_tl:
Paano gumagawa ng kuryente ang Bukidnon Solar Power Plant?

Ang Bukidnon Solar Power Plant ay gumagamit ng photovoltaic cells! Kino-convert nila ang radiant energy mula sa Araw tungo sa kuryente.
fact_en:
How does the Bukidnon Solar Power Plant make electricity?
