fact_en: In 1960, Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh made history! They became the first people to reach the Challenger Deep using the submersible Trieste.

title: Mababang Cumulus 2 km
fact_tl: Ang fair-weather na cumulus ay mga mababang ulap! Kadalasan silang nabubuo sa ilalim ng mga 2,000 metro mula sa lupa.
fact_en: Fair-weather cumulus are low clouds! They usually form below about 2,000 meters from the ground.

title: Pagtuklas ni Galileo noong 1610
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Galileo ang malalaking buwan ng Jupiter noong taong 1610!
fact_en: Galileo discovered Jupiter's large moons a long time ago, in the year 1610!

title: Charon noong 1978
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang Charon, ang kamang-manghang buwan ng Pluto, noong taong 1978!
fact_en: Charon, the amazing moon of Pluto, was officially discovered in the year 1978!

title: New Horizons noong 2015
fact_tl: Lumipad ang New Horizons spacecraft malapit sa dwarf planet na Pluto noong taong 2015. Isang makasaysayang space journey ito!
fact_en: The New Horizons spacecraft flew past the dwarf planet Pluto in the year 2015. It was a historic space journey!

title: June Solstice Hunyo 20-21
fact_tl: Tandaan sa kalendaryo! Ang June solstice ay nangyayari tuwing mga Hunyo 20 o 21 bawat taon.
fact_en: Mark your calendars! The June solstice happens around June 20 or 21 every single year.

title: March Equinox Marso 20-21
fact_tl:
Kailan nangyayari ang March equinox bawat taon?

Tingnan ang kalendaryo! Ang March equinox ay nangyayari tuwing mga Marso 20 o 21 bawat taon.
fact_en:
When does the March equinox happen every year?

Look at the calendar! The March equinox happens around March 20 or 21 each year.

title: September Equinox Set 22-23
fact_tl:
Kailan nangyayari ang September equinox bawat taon?

Nangyayari ito tuwing mga Setyembre 22 o 23 bawat taon!
fact_en:
When does the September equinox happen every year?

It happens around September 22 or 23 each year!

title: June Solstice Mahabang Araw
fact_tl: Sa Northern Hemisphere, ang June solstice (mga Hunyo 21) ang may pinakamahabang araw at pinakamaikling gabi!
fact_en: In the Northern Hemisphere, the June solstice (around June 21) has the longest day and shortest night!

title: Midnight Sun sa North Pole
fact_tl: Tuwing June solstice, ang North Pole ay may 24 oras ng liwanag! Ito ang midnight Sun, kaya walang gabi talaga.
fact_en: During the June solstice, the North Pole gets 24 hours of daylight! This is the midnight Sun, so there is no night at all.

title: Richter Scale nina 1935
fact_tl: Ginawa ni Charles F. Richter ang Richter scale noong 1935 para sukatin ang magnitude ng lindol!
fact_en: Charles F. Richter created the Richter scale in 1935 to measure the magnitude of earthquakes!

title: Hanks at Kanamori noong 1979
fact_tl: Dalawang siyentipiko, sina Thomas Hanks at Hiroo Kanamori, ang gumawa ng moment magnitude scale (Mw) noong 1979 para sa malalaking lindol!
fact_en: Two scientists, Thomas Hanks and Hiroo Kanamori, created the moment magnitude scale (Mw) in 1979 to measure big earthquakes!

title: PEIS mula noong 1996
fact_tl: Ang PHIVOLCS ang gumawa ng PHIVOLCS Earthquake Intensity Scale! Ginamit ito sa Pilipinas mula 1996, kapalit ng lumang Rossi-Forel scale.
fact_en: PHIVOLCS created the PHIVOLCS Earthquake Intensity Scale! It was adopted in the Philippines in 1996, replacing the old Rossi-Forel scale.

title: Si Francis Beaufort noong 1805
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng Beaufort wind force scale noong 1805?

Si Francis Beaufort, isang opisyal ng British Royal Navy! Siya ang gumawa nito para sukatin ang hangin.
fact_en:
Who created the Beaufort wind force scale in 1805?

Francis Beaufort, a British Royal Navy officer! He created this scale to measure wind.

title: Force 12 na 118 km/h
fact_tl: Ang Beaufort Force 12 ang pinakamataas na antas! Ito ay lakas ng bagyo na may hanging 118 km/h (73 mph) o higit pa.
fact_en: Beaufort Force 12 is the highest level! It means hurricane force with winds of 118 km/h (73 mph) or more.

title: North Equatorial Current
fact_tl: Umaagos ang North Equatorial Current mula silangan pakanluran sa Karagatang Pasipiko, diretso sa Pilipinas!
fact_en: The North Equatorial Current flows from east to west across the Pacific Ocean, heading right toward the Philippines!

title: Limang Malalaking Gyre
fact_tl: May limang malalaking subtropical gyre na umiikot sa mga karagatan ng mundo, at kabilang dito ang North Pacific Gyre!
fact_en: There are exactly five major subtropical gyres swirling in the world's oceans, and the North Pacific Gyre is one of them!

title: Philippine Fault 1,200 km
fact_tl: Sobrang haba ng Philippine Fault! Kumakabig ito ng halos 1,200 kilometro mula Luzon hanggang Mindanao.
fact_en: The Philippine Fault is super long! It stretches about 1,200 kilometers all the way from Luzon down to Mindanao.

title: Strike-Slip Philippine Fault
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Fault ay isang left-lateral strike-slip fault! Ibig sabihin, gumagalaw nang patagilid ang dalawang panig nito.
fact_en: The Philippine Fault is a left-lateral strike-slip fault! This means its two sides slide sideways past each other.

title: Marikina Valley Fault
fact_tl: Ang Marikina Valley Fault System sa Luzon ay isang right-lateral strike-slip fault!
fact_en: The Marikina Valley Fault System in Luzon is a right-lateral strike-slip fault!

title: Sangay ng Marikina Valley Fault
fact_tl:
Ilang sangay ang bumubuo sa Marikina Valley Fault System?

May dalawa itong sangay: ang West Valley Fault at ang East Valley Fault!
fact_en:
How many segments make up the Marikina Valley Fault System?

It has two segments: the West Valley Fault and the East Valley Fault!

title: Lalim: Manila Trench
fact_tl: Napakalalim ng Manila Trench! Umaabot ito sa lalim na halos 5,400 metro sa ilalim ng mga alon.
fact_en: The Manila Trench goes really deep! It reaches a depth of about 5,400 meters under the ocean waves.

title: Deo Florence Onda sa Emden Deep
fact_tl: Noong 2021, si Deo Florence Onda ang naging unang Pilipinong nakarating sa napakalalim na Emden Deep!
fact_en: In 2021, Deo Florence Onda made history as the very first Filipino to reach the deep Emden Deep!

title: Bulkang Mauna Loa
fact_tl: Ang Mauna Loa sa Hawaii ay sikat na shield volcano! Kilala ito sa pagiging mababa at napakalapad.
fact_en: Mauna Loa in Hawaii is a famous shield volcano! It is known for being low and very broad.

title: Agham ni Casimiro del Rosario
fact_tl:
Anong ibang agham ang pinasimulanan ni Casimiro del Rosario sa Pilipinas bukod sa physics?

Pinasimulanan din niya ang astronomy at meteorology! Ang meteorology ay ang pag-aaral ng panahon.
fact_en:
What other sciences did Casimiro del Rosario pioneer in the Philippines besides physics?

He also pioneered astronomy and meteorology! Meteorology is the exciting study of weather.

title: Great Red Spot ng Jupiter
fact_tl:
Ano ang Great Red Spot ng Jupiter?

Ito ay isang higanteng bagyo sa Jupiter — mas malaki pa kaysa sa buong Lupa! 🌪️
fact_en:
What is Jupiter's Great Red Spot?

It's a giant storm on Jupiter — wider than the whole Earth! 🌪️

title: Mga Planeta nang Walang Buwan
fact_tl:
Aling mga planeta ang walang anumang buwan?

Mercury at Venus! Sila lang ang dalawang planeta na walang anumang buwan.
fact_en:
Which planets have no moons at all?

Mercury and Venus! They're the only two planets with zero moons.

title: Cenozoic: Panahon Natin
fact_tl: Hulaan mo? Tayo ay nabubuhay ngayon sa Cenozoic Era! Ito ang pinakabagong panahong heolohiko.
fact_en: Guess what? We are living right now in the Cenozoic Era! It is the most recent geologic era.

title: Pluto noong 1930
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na ang dwarf planet na Pluto ay natuklasan noong taong 1930? Matagal na siyang nakatago sa kalawakan!
fact_en: Did you know the dwarf planet Pluto was first discovered way back in the year 1930? It has been hiding in space for a long time!

title: Pluto noong 2006
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyari kay Pluto noong taong 2006?

Muling inuri ang Pluto bilang isang dwarf planet!
fact_en:
What happened to Pluto in the year 2006?

Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet!

title: Huling Pangunahing Planeta
fact_tl:
Anong planeta ang huling pangunahing planetang natuklasan?

Ang Neptune ang huling pangunahing planetang natuklasan! Natuklasan lang ito ng mga siyentipiko noong 1846.
fact_en:
Which planet was the last major one to be discovered?

Neptune is the last major planet to be discovered! Scientists finally found it in the year 1846.

title: Si Neil Armstrong
fact_tl: Si Neil Armstrong ang unang taong naglakad sa Buwan! Ginawa niya ang kamanghang-manghang na hakbang na ito noong 1969.
fact_en: Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon! He made this amazing step in 1969.

title: Apollo 17 noong 1972
fact_tl: Ang huling pagkakataong naglakad ang tao sa Buwan ay noong 1972! Nangyari ang kamanghang-manghang na ito sa misyong Apollo 17.
fact_en: The last time humans walked on the Moon was in 1972! This amazing event happened during the Apollo 17 mission.

title: Ikalimang Malaking Buwan
fact_tl:
Gaano kalaki ang Buwan natin kumpara sa iba?

Napakalaki talaga ng Buwan natin! Ito ang ikalima sa pinakamalalaking buwan sa buong solar system.
fact_en:
How big is our Moon compared to others?

Our Moon is actually huge! It is the fifth-largest moon in the entire solar system.

title: 4.2 Light-Years si Proxima
fact_tl: Ang Proxima Centauri ay nasa layong humigit-kumulang 4.2 light-years mula sa atin, kaya malayo pa ito!
fact_en: Proxima Centauri is our closest star neighbor, sitting about 4.2 light-years away from us!

title: 4.6 Bilyong Taong Araw
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay matanda na at matagal nang nagniningning — humigit-kumulang 4.6 bilyong taong gulang na!
fact_en: Our Sun is very old and has been shining for a long time — it is about 4.6 billion years old!

title: 300,000 km kada Segundo
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ng Araw ay naglalakbay sa bilis ng liwanag — mga 300,000 kilometro kada segundo!
fact_en: Sunlight travels super fast at the speed of light — about 300,000 kilometers per second!

title: Bagong Pitong Kababalaghan
fact_tl:
Ano ang mga Bagong Pitong Kababalaghan ng Mundo?

Sila ang Great Wall of China, Petra, Colosseum, Taj Mahal, Machu Picchu, Christ the Redeemer, at Chichen Itza!
fact_en:
What are the New Seven Wonders of the World?

They are the Great Wall of China, Petra, the Colosseum, the Taj Mahal, Machu Picchu, Christ the Redeemer, and Chichen Itza!

title: 21,196 km na Great Wall
fact_tl: Ang kabuuang haba ng lahat ng bahagi ng Great Wall of China ay humigit-kumulang 21,196 kilometro!
fact_en: The total length of all sections of the Great Wall of China is about 21,196 kilometers!

title: Alaala kay Mumtaz Mahal
fact_tl: Ipinagawa ang Taj Mahal ni Emperador Shah Jahan bilang alaala sa kaniyang asawang si Mumtaz Mahal!
fact_en: The Taj Mahal was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal!

title: Christ sa Rio de Janeiro
fact_tl: Ang estatwa ng Christ the Redeemer ay matatagpuan sa Rio de Janeiro sa bansang Brazil!
fact_en: The Christ the Redeemer statue is located in Rio de Janeiro in the country of Brazil!

title: 30 Metro si Christ
fact_tl: Ang estatwa ng Christ the Redeemer ay may taas na 30 metro, hindi pa kasama ang pedestal!
fact_en: The Christ the Redeemer statue is 30 meters tall, not even counting its pedestal!

title: 828 Metro si Burj Khalifa
fact_tl: Ang Burj Khalifa ay mga 828 metro (828 m) ang taas, halos kumakapit sa mga ulap!
fact_en: The Burj Khalifa is about 828 meters (828 m) tall, touching the clouds!

title: Pagbukas noong 2010
fact_tl: Ang Burj Khalifa ay opisyal na binuksan noong 2010!
fact_en: The Burj Khalifa officially opened in 2010!

title: 634 Metro si Skytree
fact_tl: Ang Tokyo Skytree ay 634 metro (634 m) ang taas — napakataas!
fact_en: The Tokyo Skytree is 634 meters (634 m) tall — super high!

title: Eiffel noong 1889
fact_tl: Ang Eiffel Tower ay natapos itayo noong 1889!
fact_en: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889!

title: Pangalan mula kay Eiffel
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na ang Eiffel Tower ay ipinangalan kay Gustave Eiffel? Siya ang inhinyero na nagpatayo ng sikat na torre!
fact_en: Did you know the Eiffel Tower is named after Gustave Eiffel? He was the engineer whose company built this famous tower!

title: Three Gorges Dam
fact_tl: Ang napakalaking Three Gorges Dam ay itinayo mismo sa Yangtze River sa bansang China!
fact_en: The massive Three Gorges Dam was built right on the Yangtze River in China!

title: Great Wall 21,000 km
fact_tl: Ang Great Wall of China ay napakahaba! Umaabot ito ng mga 21,000 kilometro sa kabuuan.
fact_en: The Great Wall of China is super long! It stretches about 21,000 kilometers in total.

title: Beaufort Scale Tool
fact_tl: Ang Beaufort scale ay isang magandang tool na sumusukat sa lakas o bilis ng hangin!
fact_en: The Beaufort scale is a cool tool that measures the strength or speed of the wind!

title: Force 0 hanggang 12
fact_tl: Ang Beaufort scale ay nagsisimula sa Force 0 na kalmado, hanggang Force 12 na isang bagyo!
fact_en: The Beaufort scale runs from Force 0, which is calm, all the way to Force 12, a hurricane!

title: Francis Beaufort 1805
fact_tl: Ang matalinong si Francis Beaufort ang gumawa ng Beaufort scale noong taong 1805!
fact_en: A smart man named Francis Beaufort devised the Beaufort scale a long time ago in 1805!

title: Richter Scale Magnitude
fact_tl: Ang Richter scale ay sukatan ng lakas o magnitude ng isang lindol!
fact_en: The Richter scale is used to measure the strength or magnitude of an earthquake!

title: Moment Magnitude Scale
fact_tl: Ang moment magnitude scale (Mw) ay sukatan ng kabuuang enerhiyang inilalabas ng isang malaking lindol!
fact_en: The moment magnitude scale (Mw) measures the total energy a big earthquake releases!

title: Si Ted Fujita noong 1971
fact_tl: Ang Fujita scale ay ginawa ni Ted Fujita (Tetsuya Fujita) noong 1971!
fact_en: The Fujita scale was created by Ted Fujita (Tetsuya Fujita) in 1971!

title: F0 hanggang F5
fact_tl: Ang orihinal na Fujita scale ay sumusukat mula F0 na mahina, hanggang sa F5 na pinakamalakas!
fact_en: The original Fujita scale measures tornado strength from F0, which is weak, all the way to F5, the strongest!

title: Enhanced Fujita EF0-EF5
fact_tl: Ngayon, ginagamit natin ang pinabuting Enhanced Fujita (EF) scale! Sinusukat nito ang mga tornado mula EF0 hanggang EF5.
fact_en: Today, we use the updated Enhanced Fujita (EF) scale! It measures tornadoes from EF0 all the way to EF5.

title: Si Laika sa Sputnik 2
fact_tl: Ang unang hayop na umikot sa Earth ay ang matapang na asong si Laika, sakay ng Sputnik 2!
fact_en: The first animal to orbit Earth was a brave dog named Laika, riding aboard Sputnik 2!

title: Si Valentina Tereshkova
fact_tl: Ang kauna-unahang babaeng naglakbay sa kalawakan ay ang kamanghang si Valentina Tereshkova!
fact_en: The very first woman to travel to space was the amazing Valentina Tereshkova!

title: Unang Spacewalk noong 1965
fact_tl: Ang unang spacewalk ay ginawa noong Marso 18, 1965! Isipin mo na lang na lumulutang sa labas ng spaceship!
fact_en: The very first spacewalk took place on March 18, 1965! Imagine floating outside a spaceship in space!

title: Unang Babaeng Spacewalk
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang babaeng gumawa ng spacewalk?

Si Svetlana Savitskaya ang pinakauna! Gumawa siya ng spacewalk noong 1984.
fact_en:
Who was the first woman to do a spacewalk?

Svetlana Savitskaya was the first! She did a spacewalk in 1984.

title: Space Race ng Dalawang Bansa
fact_tl: Ang Soviet Union at ang United States ang dalawang bansang nanguna sa space race!
fact_en: The Soviet Union and the United States were the two main rivals leading the space race!

title: Unang Space Station
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakaunang space station na ginawa?

Ang Salyut 1 ang pinakauna! Pinalipad ito ng Soviet Union noong 1971.
fact_en:
What was the very first space station ever built?

Salyut 1 was the first! The Soviet Union launched it in 1971.

title: 4 na Buwan nina Galileo
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Galileo ang apat (4) na pinakamalaking buwan ng Jupiter!
fact_en: Galileo discovered the four (4) largest moons of Jupiter!

title: Bilis ng Parker Solar Probe
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na bagay na ginawa ng tao ay ang Parker Solar Probe ng NASA, na umabot ng mga 690,000 km/h malapit sa Araw!
fact_en: The fastest human-made object is NASA's Parker Solar Probe, which reached about 690,000 km/h near the Sun!

title: 8 Minuto mula sa Araw
fact_tl: Mga 8 minuto ang inaabot ng liwanag mula sa Araw bago makarating sa Lupa!
fact_en: Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth!

title: 1.3 Segundo mula sa Buwan
fact_tl: Mga 1.3 segundo lamang ang inaabot ng liwanag mula sa Buwan bago makarating sa Lupa!
fact_en: Light from the Moon takes only about 1.3 seconds to reach Earth!

title: Araw sa Venus: 243 Araw
fact_tl: Tumatagal ang isang araw sa Venus (isang pag-ikot nito) ng halos 243 araw ng Earth!
fact_en: One day on Venus, which is one rotation, lasts about 243 Earth days!

title: Taon sa Venus: 225 Araw
fact_tl: Tumatagal ang isang taon sa Venus ng halos 225 araw ng Earth!
fact_en: One full year on Venus lasts for about 225 Earth days!

title: Tatlong Astronaut ng Apollo 11
fact_tl: Tatlong astronaut ang lumipad sa Apollo 11: sina Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, at Michael Collins!
fact_en: Three astronauts flew on Apollo 11: Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins!

title: Yuri Gagarin 1961
fact_tl: Ang Soviet Union (Rusya) ang unang bansang nakapagpadala ng tao sa kalawakan! Si Yuri Gagarin ang pinadala noong 1961.
fact_en: The Soviet Union (Russia) was the first country to send a human into space! They sent Yuri Gagarin in 1961.

title: Unang Amerikanong Spacewalk
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang Amerikanong gumawa ng spacewalk?

Ang unang Amerikanong gumawa ng spacewalk ay si Ed White, at ginawa niya ito noong 1965!
fact_en:
Who was the first American to do a spacewalk?

The first American to walk in space was Ed White, and he did it in 1965!

title: Diyametro ng Earth: 12,742 km
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na ang diyametro ng Earth ay halos 12,742 kilometro? Ganito kalawak ang ating planeta!
fact_en: Did you know Earth's diameter is about 12,742 kilometers? That's how wide our planet is!

title: Diyametro ng Araw: 1.39M km
fact_tl:
Gaano kalawak ang Araw?

Napakalaki ng Araw! Ang diyametro nito ay halos 1.39 milyong kilometro (1,390,000 km).
fact_en:
How wide is the Sun?

The Sun is huge! Its diameter is about 1.39 million kilometers (1,390,000 km).

title: Diyametro ng Buwan: 3,474 km
fact_tl: Ang diyametro ng Buwan ay halos 3,474 kilometro ang lapad! Ganito kalaki ang Buwan natin.
fact_en: The Moon's diameter is about 3,474 kilometers across! That's how wide our Moon is.

title: Edad ng Earth: 4.5 Bilyon
fact_tl: Ang Earth ay halos 4.5 bilyong taong gulang na! Napakatagal na siyang umiiral.
fact_en: Our Earth is about 4.5 billion years old! That is a really, really long time.

title: 1.3 Milyong Earth sa Araw
fact_tl: Halos 1.3 milyong Earth ang kasya sa loob ng Araw! Napakalaki talaga ng Araw!
fact_en: About 1.3 million Earths could fit inside the Sun! That is a giant space!

title: Sinaunang Planetang Earth
fact_tl: Napakatanda na ng ating planeta! Ang Earth ay halos 4.5 bilyong taong gulang na ngayon.
fact_en: Our home planet is incredibly ancient! The Earth is about 4.5 billion years old today.

title: Edad ng Uniberso: 13.8 Bilyon
fact_tl: Ang uniberso ay halos 13.8 bilyong taong gulang, simula pa nang mangyari ang Big Bang!
fact_en: The universe is about 13.8 billion years old, starting right from the Big Bang!

title: Unang Buhay 3.5 Bilyon
fact_tl: Ang unang buhay sa Earth ay lumitaw noong super una, mga 3.5 bilyong taon na ang nakalipas!
fact_en: The very first life on Earth appeared a super long time ago, about 3.5 billion years ago!

title: Homo sapiens noong 300,000
fact_tl: Ang mga modernong tao o Homo sapiens ay unang lumitaw sa Earth mga 300,000 taon na ang nakalipas!
fact_en: Modern humans, also called Homo sapiens, first appeared on Earth about 300,000 years ago!

title: Geologic Time Scale
fact_tl:
Paano hinahati ang mahabang kasaysayan ng Earth?

Sa geologic time scale, hinahati ito sa mga eon, era, period, at epoch!
fact_en:
How is Earth's long history divided?

In the geologic time scale, it is divided into eons, eras, periods, and epochs!

title: Holocene Epoch Natin
fact_tl: Nakatira tayo ngayon sa Holocene epoch, na nagsimula mga 11,700 taon na ang nakalipas pagkatapos ng huling Ice Age!
fact_en: We currently live in the Holocene epoch, which started about 11,700 years ago right after the last Ice Age!

title: Kola Superdeep Borehole
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamalalim na butas na nabarena ng tao?

Ito ang Kola Superdeep Borehole sa Russia! Mga 12 km ang lalim nito papasok sa lupa.
fact_en:
What is the deepest hole ever drilled by humans?

It's the Kola Superdeep Borehole in Russia! It goes about 12 km deep into the ground.

title: 6,371 km Radius ng Earth
fact_tl: Ang layo mula sa ibabaw hanggang sa gitna ng Earth ay mga 6,371 km. Ito ang radius ng Earth!
fact_en: The distance from the surface to the center of the Earth is about 6,371 km. This is the Earth's radius!

title: Inge Lehmann noong 1936
fact_tl:
Sino ang nakatuklas na ang inner core ng Earth ay solido?

Isang Danish na siyentista na si Inge Lehmann ang nakatuklas nito noong 1936! Nalaman niyang solido ang inner core.
fact_en:
Who discovered that the Earth's inner core is solid?

A Danish scientist named Inge Lehmann discovered it in 1936! She found out the inner core is solid.

title: Magnitude 7.7 sa Luzon 1990
fact_tl: Ang lindol sa Luzon noong 1990 ay may lakas na magnitude 7.7, na ginagawa itong isa sa pinakamalakas sa Pilipinas!
fact_en: The 1990 Luzon earthquake had a massive magnitude of 7.7, making it one of the strongest earthquakes in the Philippines!

title: Hulyo 16, 1990 sa Luzon
fact_tl:
Kailan nangyari ang malakas na lindol sa Luzon?

Nangyari ang malakas na lindol na ito sa Luzon noong Hulyo 16, 1990!
fact_en:
When did the powerful Luzon earthquake happen?

This powerful earthquake shook Luzon on July 16, 1990!

title: Baguio noong Lindol 1990
fact_tl: Ang Lungsod ng Baguio ang pinakatinamaan ng lindol sa Luzon noong 1990, at gumuho ang ilang gusali!
fact_en: Baguio City was hit the worst by the 1990 Luzon earthquake, and several buildings collapsed!

title: Ikalawang Malaki sa Ika-20 Siglo
fact_tl: Ang pagsabog ng Pinatubo noong 1991 ang ikalawang pinakamalaki sa buong ika-20 siglo!
fact_en: The 1991 Mount Pinatubo eruption was the second-largest eruption of the entire 20th century!

title: 365 Araw sa Isang Taon
fact_tl:
Ilang araw ang mayroon sa isang buong taon?

May 365 araw sa isang taon! Napakaraming kaarawan at mga pista iyan!
fact_en:
How many days do we have in one full year?

There are 365 days in one year! That is a lot of birthdays and holidays!

title: 366 Araw sa Leap Year
fact_tl: May 366 araw sa isang leap year (taong bisiyesto)! Ito ay espesyal!
fact_en: There are 366 days in a leap year! It is extra special!

title: Leap Year tuwing 4 Taon
fact_tl:
Gaano kadalas nangyayari ang isang leap year?

Nangyayari ang leap year (taong bisiyesto) tuwing 4 na taon! Parang apat na kaarawan ang hinihintay!
fact_en:
How often does a leap year happen?

A leap year happens every 4 years! Just like waiting for four birthdays!

title: 7 Araw sa Isang Linggo
fact_tl:
Ilan ang araw sa isang buong linggo?

May 7 araw sa isang linggo! Sapat na iyan para mag-aral, maglaro, at magpahinga ng maayos.
fact_en:
How many days make up one whole week?

One week has exactly 7 days! That's plenty of time to learn, play, and rest.

title: 12 Buwan sa Isang Taon
fact_tl: Alam mo ba? May 12 buwan sa isang taon! Mabilis maglipas ang oras kapag nag-eenjoy ka.
fact_en: Did you know? There are exactly 12 months in one whole year! Time flies when you're having fun.

title: 52 Linggo sa Isang Taon
fact_tl:
Ilang linggo ang meron sa isang taon?

May humigit-kumulang 52 linggo sa isang taon! Ibig sabihin, 52 beses na makakadiskubre ka ng bago.
fact_en:
How many weeks are there in a single year?

There are about 52 weeks in one year! That means 52 chances to discover something new.

title: 168 Oras sa Isang Linggo
fact_tl:
Ilang oras ang meron sa isang buong linggo?

May 168 oras sa isang linggo! 'Yan ay 24 oras na pinarami sa 7 araw. Gamitin nang mabuti ang bawat oras!
fact_en:
How many hours are in one whole week?

There are 168 hours in one week! That's 24 hours multiplied by 7 days. Make the most of every hour!

title: 3,600 Segundo kada Oras
fact_tl: Tik-tok! May 3,600 segundo sa isang oras. 'Yan ay 60 segundo na pinarami sa 60 minuto!
fact_en: Tick-tock! There are 3,600 seconds in one hour. That's 60 seconds multiplied by 60 minutes!

title: Pitong Buwan na 31 Araw
fact_tl:
Ilang buwan ang may 31 araw?

May pitong buwan na may 31 araw: Enero, Marso, Mayo, Hulyo, Agosto, Oktubre, at Disyembre!
fact_en:
How many months have 31 days?

Seven months have 31 days: January, March, May, July, August, October, and December!

title: 30 o 31 Araw kada Buwan
fact_tl: Karaniwang may 30 o 31 araw ang isang buwan, maliban sa Pebrero na may 28 o 29!
fact_en: A month usually has 30 or 31 days, except for February which has 28 or 29!

title: 8,760 Oras kada Taon
fact_tl: May 8,760 oras sa isang taon (365 araw x 24 oras)!
fact_en: There are 8,760 hours in one year (365 days x 24 hours)!

title: ISS 28,000 km/h
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis lumipad ang International Space Station?

Ang ISS ay umiikot sa Mundo sa bilis na humigit-kumulang 28,000 kilometro kada oras — napakabilis!
fact_en:
How fast does the International Space Station fly?

The ISS travels around Earth at about 28,000 kilometers per hour — incredibly fast!

title: Voyager 1 61,000 km/h
fact_tl: Ang Voyager 1 space probe ay naglalakbay sa kalawakan sa bilis na humigit-kumulang 61,000 kilometro kada oras!
fact_en: The Voyager 1 space probe zooms through space at about 61,000 kilometers per hour!

title: Mars: Ika-4 Planeta
fact_tl:
Aling planeta ang kilala bilang 'Red Planet'?

Ang Mars ang ikaapat na planeta mula sa Araw, at sikat itong tinatawag na 'Red Planet'!
fact_en:
Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?

Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun, and it is famously called the 'Red Planet'!

title: Mars: Bulkan Olympus
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na ang Mars ang may pinakamalaking bulkan sa buong Solar System? Ito ay isang higanteng bundok na tinatawag na Olympus Mons!
fact_en: Did you know Mars has the largest volcano in the entire Solar System? It's a giant mountain called Olympus Mons!

title: Great Red Spot
fact_tl:
Ano ang Great Red Spot sa Jupiter?

Ito ang pinakamalaking bagyo sa buong Solar System! Ang higanteng pulang udyaw na ito ay mas malaki pa sa Earth!
fact_en:
What is the Great Red Spot on Jupiter?

It's the biggest storm in the entire Solar System! This giant red swirl is actually larger than planet Earth!

title: Leap Year na 366 Araw
fact_tl:
Bakit may leap year?

Ang isang taong bisiyesto ay may 366 araw! Nadaragdagan ng isang araw, Pebrero 29, tuwing apat na taon!
fact_en:
Why do we have leap years?

A leap year has 366 days! One extra day, February 29, is added every four years!

title: Europa: Yelong Buwan
fact_tl: Ang Europa, isang buwan ng Jupiter, ay pinaniniwalaang may malawak na karagatan ng tubig sa ilalim ng makapal na yelo nito!
fact_en: Europa, a moon of Jupiter, is believed to have a vast ocean of water beneath its thick crust of ice!

title: Leap Year kada Apat na Taon
fact_tl:
Napansin mo ba na may mga taon na may dagdag na araw?

Bawat apat na taon, may leap year na 366 araw dahil dinadagdagan ang Pebrero 29!
fact_en:
Ever wonder why some years have an extra day?

Every four years, a leap year adds February 29, giving us 366 days!

title: Kometa noong 1986
fact_tl: Ang huling beses na nakita ang Halley's Comet mula sa Earth ay noong 1986!
fact_en: The last time Halley's Comet was seen from Earth was way back in 1986!

title: Nakatagong New Moon
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi natin nakikita ang Buwan sa new moon?

Sa new moon, nasa pagitan ng Earth at Araw ang Buwan, kaya nakatago ang naliliwanagang bahagi nito!
fact_en:
Why can't we see the Moon during a new moon?

During a new moon, the Moon is between the Earth and the Sun, hiding its lit side from us!

title: Galileo noong 1609
fact_tl: Noong 1609, si Galileo Galilei ang naging unang tao na gumamit ng teleskopyo para pag-aralan ang kalangitan!
fact_en: In 1609, Galileo Galilei became the very first person to use a telescope to study the sky!

title: Sinaunang si Aristarchus
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang nagsabi na ang Araw ang nasa sentro?

Si Aristarchus ng Samos, isang sinaunang Griyego, ang unang nagmungkahi na ang Araw ang nasa sentro, libong taon bago si Copernicus!
fact_en:
Who first said the Sun is at the center?

Aristarchus of Samos, an ancient Greek, first suggested the Sun is at the center, long before Copernicus!

title: Tereshkova noong 1963
fact_tl: Gumawa ng kasaysayan si Valentina Tereshkova bilang unang babae sa kalawakan noong taong 1963!
fact_en: Valentina Tereshkova made history by becoming the first woman in space in the year 1963!

title: Unang Lumakad: Armstrong
fact_tl: Ang pinaka-unang tao na lumakad sa buwan ay si Neil Armstrong ng Estados Unidos!
fact_en: The very first person to walk on the Moon was Neil Armstrong of the United States!

title: Pangalawang Lumakad: Aldrin
fact_tl: Ang ikalawang tao na lumakad sa buwan ay si Buzz Aldrin ng Apollo 11!
fact_en: The second person to walk on the Moon was Buzz Aldrin of Apollo 11!

title: Voyager 1, Pinakamalayo
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalayong bagay na gawa ng tao sa kalawakan ay ang space probe na Voyager 1!
fact_en: The most distant human-made object in space right now is the space probe Voyager 1!

title: Voyager 1 noong 1977
fact_tl: Ang space probe na Voyager 1 ay inilunsad sa kalawakan noong taong 1977!
fact_en: The space probe Voyager 1 was launched into space in the year 1977!

title: John Glenn noong 1962
fact_tl: Ang unang Amerikanong umikot sa Earth ay si John Glenn, at noong 1962!
fact_en: The first American to orbit the Earth was John Glenn, and it was in 1962!

title: Unang Babaeng Spacewalk
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang babaeng gumawa ng spacewalk?

Si Svetlana Savitskaya ang unang babaeng gumawa ng spacewalk noong 1984!
fact_en:
Who was the very first woman to do a spacewalk?

Svetlana Savitskaya made history as the first woman to do a spacewalk in 1984!

title: Dennis Tito noong 2001
fact_tl: Si Dennis Tito ang naging unang space tourist na nagbayad para makapunta sa kalawakan noong 2001!
fact_en: Dennis Tito became the very first space tourist who paid to travel into space in 2001!

title: Tatlong Astronaut ng Apollo 11
fact_tl:
Sino ang 3 astronaut sa misyon ng Apollo 11?

Ang misyon ng Apollo 11 ay may 3 astronaut: sina Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, at Michael Collins!
fact_en:
Who were the 3 astronauts on the Apollo 11 mission?

The Apollo 11 mission had 3 astronauts: Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins!

title: Mariner 4 noong 1965
fact_tl: Ang Mariner 4 ang unang spacecraft na nakalipad malapit sa Mars at nagpadala ng litrato noong 1965!
fact_en: Mariner 4 was the first spacecraft to fly past Mars and send back photos in 1965!

title: Voyager 1 sa Interstellar Space
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang spacecraft na nakalabas sa ating solar system?

Ang Voyager 1 ang unang spacecraft na nakalabas sa ating solar system at pumasok sa interstellar space noong 2012!
fact_en:
What was the first spacecraft to leave our solar system?

Voyager 1 was the first spacecraft to leave our solar system and enter interstellar space, and it did this in 2012!

title: Charles Richter 1935
fact_tl: Isang Amerikanong siyentipiko na nagngangalang Charles Richter ang gumawa ng sikat na Richter scale noong 1935!
fact_en: An American scientist named Charles Richter created the famous Richter scale to measure earthquakes way back in 1935!

title: Magnitude 8 Great Quake
fact_tl:
Gaano kalakas ang 'great earthquake'?

Magnitude 8 o higit pa sa Richter scale! Iyon ang 'great earthquake' — napakapinsala!
fact_en:
How strong is a 'great earthquake'?

Magnitude 8 or higher on the Richter scale! That's a 'great earthquake' — very destructive!

title: 24 Time Zones ng Mundo
fact_tl: May humigit-kumulang 24 na time zone sa mundo — isa kada oras ng pag-ikot ng Earth!
fact_en: There are about 24 time zones around the world — one for each hour of Earth's rotation!

title: Diwata-1 noong 2016
fact_tl: Noong Abril 27, 2016, inilabas sa orbit ang Diwata-1! Lumabas ito mula sa International Space Station para mag-explore sa kalawakan.
fact_en: On April 27, 2016, Diwata-1 was released into orbit! It zoomed out from the International Space Station to explore space.

title: Maya-1 CubeSat 2018
fact_tl: Ang Maya-1 ang unang CubeSat na ginawa ng mga Pilipino! Ang maliit na kahong satelayt na ito ay inilabas sa orbit noong 2018.
fact_en: Maya-1 was the first CubeSat built by Filipinos! This small, box-shaped satellite was released into orbit in 2018.

title: PhilSA mula noong 2019
fact_tl:
Ano ang ahensiya ng Pilipinas para sa kalawakan?

Ito ay ang PhilSA, o Philippine Space Agency! Itinatag ang ahensyang ito noong 2019.
fact_en:
What is the space agency of the Philippines?

It is PhilSA, short for Philippine Space Agency! This space agency was created in 2019.

title: PAGASA noong 1972
fact_tl:
Aling ahensiya ang nagbabantay sa ating panahon at bagyo?

PAGASA! Ito ang ahensiya ng Pilipinas para sa panahon at bagyo, at itinatag ito noong 1972.
fact_en:
Which agency watches over our weather and typhoons?

PAGASA! It is the Philippine agency for weather and typhoons, and it was created in 1972.

title: DOST noong 1987
fact_tl:
Ano ang kagawaran ng pamahalaan para sa agham at teknolohiya sa Pilipinas?

Ito ang DOST, o Department of Science and Technology! Naging kagawaran ito noong 1987.
fact_en:
What is the government department for science and technology in the Philippines?

It is the DOST, or Department of Science and Technology! It became a cabinet department in 1987.

title: Delikadong Partial Eclipse
fact_tl:
Bakit pinakadelikado ang partial eclipse para tumingin?

Dahil sa mas madilim na langit, lumalaki ang pupil mo kaya mas maraming nakakasamang liwanag ng araw ang pumapasok!
fact_en:
Why is a partial eclipse the most dangerous time to look?

The darker sky makes your pupils open wider, letting in way more harmful sunlight!

title: Indian Ocean Tsunami 2004
fact_tl: Ang 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami ay isa sa pinakamapanganib na natural disasters sa nakatalang kasaysayan.
fact_en: The 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami was one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history.

title: Nickel sa Surigao del Norte
fact_tl:
Saan natin kinukuha ang nickel para sa stainless steel?

May napakalaking nickel laterite deposits sa Surigao del Norte na mina-mina para gawing stainless steel!
fact_en:
Where do we get nickel for stainless steel?

Surigao del Norte has massive nickel laterite deposits that are mined to make stainless steel!

title: Philippine Fault System
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Fault System ay isang 1,250-kilometrong tectonic fault line na pwedeng magdulot ng malalakas na lindol sa buong kapuluan!
fact_en: The Philippine Fault System is a huge 1,250-kilometer tectonic fault line that can cause major earthquakes across our archipelago!

title: 30 Segundong Babala
fact_tl: Kung naririnig mo ang kulog sa loob ng 30 seconds matapos makita ang lightning, malapit ka na at dapat mag-shelter sa loob ng bahay!
fact_en: If you hear thunder within 30 seconds of seeing lightning, you are close enough to be struck and must seek indoor shelter!

title: Malaking UY Scuti
fact_tl: Ang Sun ay isang medium-sized star lang! Ang pulang supergiant na UY Scuti ay may radius na halos 1,700 beses na mas malaki kaysa sa Sun.
fact_en: The Sun is just a medium-sized star! The red supergiant UY Scuti has a radius roughly 1,700 times larger than our Sun.

title: El Nino at Rainwater Catcher
fact_tl: Ang El Niño ay nagdudulot ng matinding tagtuyot sa Pilipinas, kaya kailangang magtayo ng mga rainwater catcher para mag-imbak ng inuming tubig.
fact_en: El Nino causes severe dry seasons in the Philippines, so communities must build rainwater catchers to store drinking water.

title: Araw: Isang Bituin
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba na ang Araw ay isang bituin?

Oo! Ito ay isang napakalaking bolang mainit na gas at ang pinakamalapit na bituin sa Earth na nagbibigay ng liwanag at init para sa buhay.
fact_en:
Did you know the Sun is actually a star?

Yes! It's a giant ball of hot gas and Earth's closest star, giving us the light and heat life needs.

title: Valdivia noong 1960
fact_tl: Ang 1960 Valdivia earthquake sa Chile ang pinakamalakas na na-record, na naglabas ng energy equivalent to thousands of atomic bombs!
fact_en: The 1960 Valdivia earthquake in Chile was the most powerful ever recorded, releasing energy equivalent to thousands of atomic bombs!

title: Zinc Oxide Sunscreen
fact_tl:
Paano pinoprotektahan ng mga sunscreen na may zinc oxide ang ating balat mula sa araw?

Ang mga sunscreen na may mineral na zinc oxide ay pisikal na humaharang sa mapanganib na ultraviolet rays para hindi masira ang skin cells!
fact_en:
How do sunscreens with zinc oxide protect our skin from the sun?

Sunscreens containing the mineral zinc oxide physically block harmful ultraviolet rays from damaging your skin cells!

title: Angat Dam sa Sierra Madre
fact_tl:
Saan kinukuha ng Metro Manila ang suplay ng tubig nito?

Kinukuha ng Angat Dam sa Bulacan ang tubig-ulan mula sa bundok ng Sierra Madre para magbigay ng tubig sa Metro Manila!
fact_en:
Where does Metro Manila get its water supply from?

The Angat Dam in Bulacan collects rainwater from the Sierra Madre mountains to supply water to Metro Manila!

title: Sunscreen UV Protection
fact_tl:
Paano pinoprotektahan ng sunscreen ang balat mo?

Ang mga mineral tulad ng zinc oxide sa loob nito ay nagre-reflect ng harmful ultraviolet rays mula sa araw para protektahan ang balat mo!
fact_en:
How does sunscreen protect your skin from the sun?

Minerals like zinc oxide in it reflect harmful ultraviolet rays from the sun to keep your skin safe!

title: Valley Fault System sa Luzon
fact_tl: Ang Valley Fault System sa Luzon ay isang malaking geological fracture. Dito nagkikiskisan ang mga tectonic plates!
fact_en: The Valley Fault System in Luzon is a huge geological fracture. This is where massive tectonic plates slowly grind past each other!

title: Layered Clothing laban sa Lamig
fact_tl: Ang pagsusuot ng layered clothing ay nakakapigil ng init ng katawan! Ito ay pumipigil sa hypothermia kapag bumababa ang temperatura.
fact_en: Wearing layered clothing traps your body heat! This prevents hypothermia when temperatures drop during the cold dry season.

title: Yolanda mula sa Warm Pacific
fact_tl: Ang Super Typhoon Yolanda ay nabuo sa warm Pacific waters dahil ang heat ay nagdulot ng rapid evaporation, na nagbibigay ng energy para paikutin ang napakalaking bagyo!
fact_en: Super Typhoon Yolanda formed over warm Pacific waters because the heat caused rapid evaporation, providing energy to spin the massive storm!

title: 8 Minuto at 20 Segundo
fact_tl: Ang liwanag mula sa Sun ay tumatagal ng walong minuto at 20 segundo para makarating sa Earth na 150 milyong kilometro ang layo!
fact_en: Sunlight travels 150 million kilometers to reach Earth, taking about eight minutes and 20 seconds!

title: Bagyong Rolly 2020
fact_tl: Ang Bagyong Rolly (internationally Goni) ay tumama sa Pilipinas noong 2020 bilang isa sa pinakamalakas na tropical cyclones na naitala!
fact_en: Typhoon Rolly (internationally Goni) hit the Philippines in 2020 as one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded!

title: SPF 30 Protection
fact_tl:
Gaano karaming sunblock ang kailangan?

Ang paglagay ng sunscreen na may SPF 30 ay humaharang ng halos 97 percent ng UVB rays para protektahan ang balat mo mula sa sunburn!
fact_en:
How much sunblock do you need?

Applying sunscreen with SPF 30 blocks about 97 percent of UVB rays to protect your skin from sunburn!

title: Isang Minutong Pagpapakulo
fact_tl: Pakuluan ang tubig baha ng hindi bababa sa isang minuto! Nakapatay ito ng mapanganib na waterborne bacteria tulad ng Vibrio cholerae bago inumin.
fact_en: Boil floodwater for at least one minute! This kills harmful waterborne bacteria like Vibrio cholerae before you drink it.

title: Philippine Sea Thunderstorms
fact_tl: Ang matinding solar radiation ay nagpapainit sa mainit na tubig ng Philippine Sea! Nagdudulot ito ng mataas na evaporation na nagpapasigla ng afternoon thunderstorms.
fact_en: Intense solar radiation heats the warm waters of the Philippine Sea! This causes high evaporation rates that fuel afternoon thunderstorms.

title: Babala sa Dagat tuwing Full Moon
fact_tl:
Bakit dapat tingnan ang local tide warnings bago lumangoy sa beach tuwing full moon?

Dahil mas malakas ang gravitational pull na nagdudulot ng mas mataas na spring tides tuwing full moon!
fact_en:
Why should you check local tide warnings before swimming at the beach during a full moon?

Because a stronger gravitational pull causes higher spring tides during a full moon!

title: Acid Rain mula sa Gas
fact_tl: Nagiging asido ang ulan kapag ang mga gas tulad ng sulfur dioxide at nitrogen oxides mula sa pagsunog ng gasolina at karbon ay nahahalo sa tubig sa hangin, bumubuo ng mahinang acid!
fact_en: Rain becomes acidic when gases like sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides from burning fuel and coal mix with air water to form weak acids!

title: Banaue Rice Terraces
fact_tl:
Paano ginawa ang Banaue Rice Terraces?

Mga magsasaka ang nag-ukit ng Banaue Rice Terraces direkta sa matarik na metamorphic rock mountains ng Cordilleras higit dalawang libong taon na ang nakalilipas!
fact_en:
How were the Banaue Rice Terraces made?

Farmers carved the Banaue Rice Terraces directly into the steep metamorphic rock mountains of the Cordilleras over two thousand years ago!

title: Marikina Valley Fault
fact_tl: Ang Marikina Valley Fault System ay isang malaking geological fracture sa Pilipinas na kayang magdulot ng malalakas at mapaminsalang lindol!
fact_en: The Marikina Valley Fault System is a major geological fracture in the Philippines capable of generating strong, damaging earthquakes!

title: Heat Record ng Death Valley
fact_tl:
Saan naitala ang pinakamataas na temperatura ng hangin sa buong mundo?

Ang Death Valley ang may rekord sa pinakamataas na temperatura ng hangin na naitala sa mundo na 56.7 degrees Celsius!
fact_en:
Where is the hottest air temperature ever recorded on Earth?

Death Valley holds the record for the highest air temperature ever recorded on Earth at a scorching 56.7 degrees Celsius!

title: Kidlat Bawat Segundo
fact_tl: Tumatama ang kidlat sa ibabaw ng Earth mga isang daang beses bawat segundo, araw-araw! Ang bilis, 'di ba?
fact_en: Lightning strikes the surface of the Earth approximately one hundred times every single second of every single day! Wow, that's a lot!

title: Runoff patungo sa Ilog Cagayan
fact_tl: Ang malalakas na ulan ng tag-ulan ay nagdudulot ng mabilis na surface runoff, na nagdadala ng nalusaw na lupa mula sa Sierra Madre papunta sa Ilog Cagayan!
fact_en: Heavy monsoon rains cause rapid surface runoff, carrying eroded soil from the Sierra Madre mountains straight into the Cagayan River!

title: Corona Type 1 ng Pilipinas
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may Corona Type 1 na klima! Ibig sabihin, may malinaw na basang at tuyong panahon tayo mula Nobyembre hanggang Abril.
fact_en: The Philippines has a Corona Type 1 climate! This means we have clear wet and dry seasons from November to April.

title: Laguna de Bay na Basin
fact_tl:
Ano ang papel ng Laguna de Bay sa water cycle?

Kinokolekta nito ang surface runoff mula sa mga kalapit na lalawigan, na gumaganap bilang isang napakalaking natural na basin!
fact_en:
What is the very important role of Laguna de Bay in the natural water cycle?

It collects surface runoff from surrounding provinces, acting just like a massive natural basin in the water cycle!

title: Rain Shadow ng Sierra Madre
fact_tl:
Bakit mas tuyo ang Central Luzon?

Ang Sierra Madre mountains ay humaharang sa Pacific moisture! Lumilikha ito ng mas tuyong rain shadow climate sa mga kapatagan ng Central Luzon.
fact_en:
Why is Central Luzon drier?

The Sierra Madre mountains block Pacific moisture! This creates a drier rain shadow climate across the Central Luzon plains.

title: Chilean Quake 1960
fact_tl: Ang 1960 Great Chilean earthquake ay sobrang lakas na nagpagalaw at nagpa-vibrate sa buong mundo!
fact_en: The 1960 Great Chilean earthquake was so powerful that it actually caused the entire Earth to vibrate!

title: Slab Pull at Ridge Push
fact_tl:
Ano ang tumutulak at humihila sa tectonic plates bukod sa convection?

Dalawang puwersa! 'Slab pull' — hinihila ng bigat ng lumulubog na plate pababa. 'Ridge push' — itinutulak ng nakataas na ridge ang plate palayo!
fact_en:
What pushes and pulls tectonic plates besides convection?

Two forces! 'Slab pull' — a sinking plate's weight drags it down. 'Ridge push' — a raised ridge pushes the plate away!

title: East African Rift
fact_tl: Kapag nagsisimulang maghiwalay ang continental plate, nabubuo ang malalim na rift valley — tulad ng East African Rift! Sa paglipas ng panahon, napupuno ito ng tubig at nagiging bagong dagat.
fact_en: When a continental plate starts to split, a deep rift valley forms — like the East African Rift! Over time, water fills it and creates a brand-new ocean.

title: Valley Fault System
fact_tl:
Ano ang bumubuo sa Valley Fault System sa Pilipinas?

Binubuo ito ng East Valley at West Valley faults, na maaaring magdulot ng malalakas na lindol!
fact_en:
What makes up the Valley Fault System in the Philippines?

It consists of the East Valley and West Valley faults, which can generate strong earthquakes!

title: Undersea Quake Tsunami
fact_tl:
Paano nabubuo ang mga tsunami mula sa undersea earthquake?

Ang undersea earthquake ay biglang nagdi-displace ng napakalaking volume ng ocean water, na nag-generate ng long-wavelength waves na nag-a-amplify sa height malapit sa coast!
fact_en:
How do tsunamis form from an undersea earthquake?

An undersea earthquake abruptly displaces a massive volume of ocean water, generating long-wavelength waves that amplify in height near the coast!

title: Valley Fault at Building Code
fact_tl: Ang Valley Fault System ay humahaba sa Luzon! Kaya kailangang magpatupad ng mahigpit na building code ang mga lungsod tulad ng Marikina para makaligtas sa malalakas na lindol.
fact_en: The Valley Fault System stretches across Luzon! This means cities like Marikina must enforce strict building codes to survive strong earthquakes.

title: Signal 2 na 61-120 km/h
fact_tl: Kapag nag-raise ng Typhoon Signal Number 2 ang PAGASA, inaasahan ang hangin na 61 hanggang 120 kilometro kada oras sa loob ng 24 na oras!
fact_en: When PAGASA raises Typhoon Signal Number 2, winds of 61 to 120 kilometers per hour are expected within 24 hours!

title: Sampung Atomic Bomb kada Segundo
fact_tl: Ang isang ganap na hurricane ay nakakabuga ng napakalakas na enerhiya! Katumbas ito ng sampung atomic bomb na sumasabog bawat segundo.
fact_en: A single mature hurricane releases massive energy! It is equivalent to ten atomic bombs exploding every single second.

title: Hati ng Geologic Time Scale
fact_tl: Inaayos ng geologic time scale ang kasaysayan ng Earth sa mga bahagi: eons, eras, periods, at epochs — mula sa pinakamahaba hanggang sa pinakamaikli!
fact_en: The geologic time scale organizes Earth's history into chunks: eons, eras, periods, and epochs — from the longest stretches down to the shortest!

title: Sirius, Dog Star
fact_tl: Ang Sirius, kilala rin bilang Dog Star, ay ang pinakamaliwanag na bituin na makikita sa gabi mula sa Earth!
fact_en: Sirius, also known as the Dog Star, is the absolute brightest star you can see in the night sky from Earth!

title: Sunscreen bago mag-Recess
fact_tl: Naglalabas ang araw ng ultraviolet radiation na nagdudulot ng sunburn! Mag-apply ng sunscreen na may SPF 30 bago mag-recess para protektahan ang balat mo mula sa pinsala sa selula.
fact_en: The sun emits ultraviolet radiation that causes sunburn! Apply sunscreen with SPF 30 before recess to protect your skin from cellular damage.

title: Drop, Cover, Hold
fact_tl: Kapag may lindol at nasa loob ka, bumagsak sa sahig, magtago sa ilalim ng matibay na mesa, at hawakan ito ng mahigpit!
fact_en: If an earthquake strikes while you're indoors, drop to the floor, take cover under a sturdy desk, and hold on tight!

title: Great Red Spot ng Jupiter
fact_tl: Ang Great Red Spot ng Jupiter ay isang napakalaking bagyo na mas malapad pa sa Earth at tumatakbo na nang 350 taon!
fact_en: Jupiter’s Great Red Spot is a massive storm wider than Earth that has been raging non-stop for 350 years!

title: Isang Pulgadang Topsoil
fact_tl: Kailangan ng kalikasan ng halos 500 taon para natural na mabuo ang isang pulgada ng masustansyang topsoil!
fact_en: It takes nature approximately 500 years to naturally form just one single inch of nutrient-rich topsoil!

title: 1,300 Earth kay Jupiter
fact_tl: Napakalaki ng Jupiter! Sa totoo lang, higit sa 1,300 Earths ang kayang mapuno sa loob ng kanyang spherical volume.
fact_en: Jupiter is super massive! In fact, more than 1,300 Earths could easily fit inside its giant spherical volume.

title: 716 Beses kada Segundo
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis umikot ang mga pulsar?

Ang mga pulsar ay mabilis na umiikot na neutron stars na naglalabas ng radio waves! Umikot sila hanggang 716 beses kada segundo.
fact_en:
How fast do pulsars spin?

Pulsars are rapidly spinning neutron stars that beam radio waves! They can rotate up to 716 times every single second.

title: Valley Fault sa Metro Manila
fact_tl: Ang Valley Fault System ay humahabaan sa Metro Manila, kaya kailangan ang mahigpit na building codes para hindi masira ang mga bahay kapag may lindol.
fact_en: The Valley Fault System stretches across Metro Manila, requiring strict building codes to prevent earthquake damage.

title: Signal Number 2 ng PAGASA
fact_tl: Kapag naglabas ng Signal Number 2 ang PAGASA, umabot na ang hangin sa 61-100 kilometro kada oras. Manatili sa loob para iwas debris!
fact_en: When PAGASA raises Signal Number 2, winds hit 61 to 100 kilometers per hour, so stay indoors to avoid flying debris!

title: Stress na Nagiging Seismic Waves
fact_tl: Ang mga tectonic plate na magkadikit ay nag-iipon ng stress hanggang mabasag ang bato, na naglalabas ng enerhiya bilang seismic na alon ng lindol!
fact_en: Tectonic plates sticking together build up stress until the rock fractures, releasing energy as powerful seismic earthquake waves!

title: Polaris kapag Naligaw
fact_tl: Naligaw sa gabi? Hanapin ang North Star na si Polaris! Ituro niya ang tunay na hilaga para makabalik ka nang ligtas.
fact_en: Lost at night? Look up for the North Star, Polaris! It points to true north to help you navigate back safely.

title: Proteksyon mula sa Quartz Dust
fact_tl:
Bakit kailangang magsuot ng protective masks ang mga minero kapag nagputol ng quartz rocks?

Ang paglanghap ng pinong alikabok mula sa pagputol ng quartz ay maaaring makasira ng baga, kaya kailangang magsuot ng protective masks ang mga minero!
fact_en:
Why must miners wear protective masks when cutting quartz rocks?

Inhaling fine dust from cutting quartz rocks can damage your lungs, so miners must wear protective masks!

title: Klima ng Davao del Sur
fact_tl:
Bakit palaging mainit at tropical ang climate ng Davao del Sur?

Dahil nasa equator, ang Davao del Sur ay nakakatanggap ng direct sunlight buong taon, kaya palaging mainit at tropical ang climate!
fact_en:
Why does Davao del Sur have a consistently warm tropical climate?

Located near the equator, Davao del Sur receives direct sunlight year-round, resulting in a consistently warm tropical climate!

title: Limang Mass Extinction
fact_tl: Natukoy ng mga siyentipiko mula sa fossil record ang limang malaking mass extinction sa kasaysayan ng Earth. Bawat isa ay naglaho ng napakaraming species sa buong mundo!
fact_en: Scientists found five major mass extinctions in Earth's history from the fossil record. Each one wiped out a huge number of species worldwide!

title: Si Charles Lyell
fact_tl: Hanggang ika-19 na siglo, akala ng karamihan ay ilang libong taon lang ang Earth. Ngunit ipinakita ni Charles Lyell mula sa rock layers at fossils na ito ay napakatanda na pala!
fact_en: Until the 19th century, most people thought Earth was only a few thousand years old. But Charles Lyell showed from rock layers and fossils that it is extremely ancient!

title: Banaue Rice Terraces
fact_tl: Itinayo ng mga Ifugao ang Banaue Rice Terraces para mangolekta ng ulan, gamit ang precipitation stage ng water cycle para diligan ang kanilang palay!
fact_en: The Ifugao people built the Banaue Rice Terraces to capture rainwater, using the precipitation stage of the water cycle to irrigate their crops!

title: Vitamin D mula sa Araw
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag nasisikatan ang balat ng ultraviolet rays?

Gumagawa ang balat ng vitamin D! Pero sobra-sobrang sikat ay nasisira ang selula at nagdudulot ng sunburn.
fact_en:
What happens when our skin meets the sun's ultraviolet rays?

The skin produces vitamin D! But excessive exposure damages skin cells and causes sunburn.

title: Main Sequence Stage
fact_tl: Sa yugto ng main sequence, ang isang bituin tulad ng Ating Araw ay gumagawa ng enerhiya sa pamamagitan ng pagsasanib ng mga hydrogen atom tungo sa helium sa kanyang core.
fact_en: During the main sequence stage, a star like our Sun generates energy by fusing hydrogen atoms into helium in its core.

title: Peat Bogs na Carbon Champion
fact_tl: Sumasakop lang ng tatlong porsyento ng lupa ang peat bogs, pero sila ang carbon superstars! Nag-iimbak ito ng dalawang beses na dami ng carbon kumpara sa lahat ng kagubatan sa mundo.
fact_en: Peat bogs cover just three percent of Earth's land, but they are carbon superstars! They store twice as much carbon as all global forests combined.

title: Kidlat kay Empire State
fact_tl: Gusto ng kidlat ang mga matataas na gusali! Madalas itong tumama nang maraming beses sa parehong gusali tulad ng Empire State Building sa isang bagyo.
fact_en: Lightning loves tall structures! It frequently strikes the same tall buildings, like the Empire State Building, multiple times in one storm.

title: Type 2 Climate sa Tacloban
fact_tl:
Ano ang panahon sa Tacloban City buong taon?

May Type 2 climate ito! Ibig sabihin, madalas ang malakas na ulan buong taon at walang malinaw na dry season.
fact_en:
What is the weather like in Tacloban City all year round?

It has a Type 2 climate! This means it gets heavy rainfall throughout the year without any distinct dry season.

title: Soil pH Meter
fact_tl:
Paano sinusubok ng mga magsasaka ang lupa?

Gumagamit sila ng soil pH meter! Ito ay kagamitang hawak-hawakan na sumusukat kung gaano ka-asidik o ka-alkaline ang lupa.
fact_en:
How do farmers test their dirt?

They use a soil pH meter! It's a handy tool that measures the acidity or alkalinity of dirt for farming.

title: West Valley Fault sa Marikina
fact_tl:
Bakit mataas ang panganib ng malalakas na lindol sa Lungsod ng Marikina?

Dumadaan ang West Valley Fault sa Lungsod ng Marikina, kaya mataas ang panganib ng malalakas na lindol kapag gumagalaw ang mga tectonic plate!
fact_en:
Why is Marikina City at a high risk for strong earthquakes?

The West Valley Fault runs through Marikina City, making it highly at risk during tectonic plate movements!

title: Earth Pigments ni Juan Luna
fact_tl:
Paano nakagawa si Juan Luna ng mga makukulay na kulay sa kanyang obra maestra, ang Spoliarium?

Gumamit siya ng earth pigments, mga natural na mineral tulad ng iron oxide, para makuha ang makukulay na kulay sa kanyang obra!
fact_en:
How did Juan Luna create the rich colors in his masterpiece, the Spoliarium?

He used earth pigments—natural minerals like iron oxide—to paint the rich colors in his masterpiece!

title: Warty Pig sa El Nino
fact_tl: Sa dry El Niño climate phase, ang Philippine warty pig ay naglalakbay ng mas malayo para makahanap ng tubig, kaya nagbabago ang usual foraging patterns nito!
fact_en: During the dry El Niño climate phase, the Philippine warty pig travels longer distances to find water, altering its usual foraging patterns!

title: Magma Ascent bago Sabog
fact_tl: Ang magma ascent ay ang pre-eruption stage kung saan umaakyat ang molten rock sa volcanic conduit, tumataas ang pressure hanggang sumabog sa ibabaw!
fact_en: Magma ascent is the pre-eruption stage where molten rock rises through the volcanic conduit, increasing pressure until it breaks through the surface!

title: Mohs Hardness Scale
fact_tl:
Paano sinubukan ng Mohs hardness scale ang mga bato?

Gumagamit ito ng sampung reference minerals, mula soft talc hanggang hard diamond, para i-scratch-test ang ibang bato at makita kung gaano katibay!
fact_en:
How does the Mohs hardness scale test rocks?

It uses ten reference minerals, from soft talc to hard diamond, to scratch-test other rocks and see how hard they are!

title: North Star nina Lapu-Lapu
fact_tl:
Paano nag-navigate sa dagat sa gabi ang mga mandirigma tulad ni Lapu-Lapu?

Bago ang modern tools, ginamit nila ang North Star para malaman ang direksyon sa ilalim ng night sky sa Visayan seas!
fact_en:
How did warriors like Lapu-Lapu navigate the seas at night?

Before modern tools, they used the North Star to determine their direction under the night sky in the Visayan seas!

title: Soil pH bago Magtanim
fact_tl: I-test ang soil pH gamit ang simpleng kit bago magtanim, dahil kapag sobrang acidity, hindi makakakuha ng necessary nutrients ang mga gulay!
fact_en: Test soil pH with a simple kit before planting crops, because extreme acidity prevents vegetables from absorbing necessary nutrients!

title: Explosive Eruption Stage
fact_tl: Sa explosive eruption stage ng isang volcano, ang high-pressure magma ay nagbabato ng ash at rock fragments pataas sa atmosphere!
fact_en: During the explosive eruption stage of a volcano, high-pressure magma blasts ash and rock fragments high into the atmosphere!

title: Dinagyang Tuwing Enero
fact_tl: Ang Dinagyang Festival sa Iloilo ginaganap tuwing Enero, kapag ang malamig na northeast monsoon ay nagdadala ng magandang panahon sa Visayas!
fact_en: The Dinagyang festival in Iloilo happens every January, when the cool northeast monsoon brings nice weather to the Visayas region!

title: Pahiyas Tuwing Mayo
fact_tl: Ang Lucban Pahiyas Festival ay ginaganap tuwing Mayo para ipagdiwang ang anihan bago dumating ang habagat na nagdadala ng malakas na ulan!
fact_en: The Lucban Pahiyas Festival happens in May to celebrate the harvest just before the southwest monsoon brings heavy rains!

title: Parker Solar Probe
fact_tl: Ang Parker Solar Probe ay isang espesyal na spacecraft na dinisenyo para lumipad sa panlabas na atmospera ng Araw at pag-aralan ang solar winds!
fact_en: The Parker Solar Probe is a special spacecraft designed to fly through the Sun's outer atmosphere to study solar winds!

title: Great Artesian Basin
fact_tl: Ang Great Artesian Basin sa Australia ay isa sa pinakamalawak at pinakamalalim na underground freshwater aquifer sa mundo!
fact_en: The Great Artesian Basin in Australia is one of the largest and deepest underground freshwater aquifers in the world!

title: Water Vapor mula sa Dagat
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa tubig kapag nag-evaporate mula sa Pacific Ocean papunta sa atmospera?

Nagiging isang walang nakikitang gas na tinatawag na water vapor!
fact_en:
What happens to water when it evaporates from the Pacific Ocean into the atmosphere?

It exists as an invisible gas called water vapor!

title: Enerhiya ng Lindol Magnitude 9
fact_tl: Ang isang magnitude 9.0 na lindol ay naglalabas ng halos 32 beses na mas maraming enerhiya kaysa sa magnitude 8.0!
fact_en: A magnitude 9.0 earthquake releases about 32 times more energy than a magnitude 8.0 earthquake!

title: Signal 1 na 30-60 km/h
fact_tl: Ang Typhoon signal number one ay nangangahulugang inaasahan ang hangin na 30 hanggang 60 kilometers per hour sa loob ng 36 hours!
fact_en: Typhoon signal number one means winds of 30 to 60 kilometers per hour are expected within 36 hours!

title: UV Ray at Skin Cancer
fact_tl: Ang mga ultraviolet rays mula sa araw ay nasisira ang living skin cells, nagdudulot ng masakit na sunburn at nagpapataas ng risk sa skin cancer!
fact_en: Ultraviolet rays from the sun damage living skin cells, causing painful sunburns and increasing the long-term risk of skin cancer!

title: Soil Sieve Screen
fact_tl:
Paano kaya nagsi-sort ng lupa ang mga siyentipiko?

Gumagamit sila ng soil sieve! Ito ay isang mesh screen na naghihiwalay ng mga butil ng lupa ayon sa laki.
fact_en:
Ever wonder how scientists sort dirt?

They use a soil sieve! It’s a mesh screen that separates soil particles by size.

title: Sunscreen Laban sa UV Ray
fact_tl: Naglalabas ang araw ng ultraviolet rays na nakakasira sa epidermis ng balat. Kaya naglalagay tayo ng sunscreen para protektahan ang panlabas na layer sa sunburn!
fact_en: The sun emits ultraviolet rays that damage your skin's epidermis. That's why applying sunscreen protects this outer layer from sunburns!

title: Magnetikong Tala ng Lumang Bato
fact_tl:
Paano naaalala ng mga lumang bato ang magnetikong nakaraan ng Daigdig?

Kapag lumalamig at tumitigas ang lava, nakukuha nito ang direksyon ng magnetikong larangan! Nababasa ito ng mga siyentipiko sa mga lumang bato.
fact_en:
How do old rocks remember Earth's magnetic past?

When lava cools and hardens, it locks in the magnetic field's direction at that time! Scientists read this in old rocks.

title: 12 km Deepest Drill
fact_tl:
Gaano kalalim ang nabarena ng tao sa Daigdig?

Ang pinakamalalim na butas ay umabot lang ng 12 kilometro — nipis na kalmot lang sa crust! Hindi pa natin nararating ang mantle.
fact_en:
How deep have humans drilled into Earth?

Our deepest drill reached only 12 kilometers — just a tiny scratch on the crust! We've never reached the mantle yet.

title: Nebula Disk na Parang Pinggan
fact_tl: Habang gumuguho ang solar nebula, bumilis ang pag-ikot nito at lumapad ito tulad ng pinggan! Kaya umiikot ang mga planeta ngayon sa parehong patag na ibabaw at direksyon.
fact_en: As the solar nebula collapsed, it spun faster and flattened into a disk! That's why planets today orbit in the same flat plane and direction.

title: Signal 1 39-61 km/h
fact_tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal Number One?

Nagbibigay ang PAGASA nito para sabihan ang mga Pilipino na aasahan ang napakalakas na hangin na 39 hanggang 61 kilometro kada oras!
fact_en:
What does Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal Number One mean?

PAGASA raises it to warn Filipinos that very strong winds of 39 to 61 kilometers per hour are expected!

title: Magat Dam sa El Nino
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa Magat Dam tuwing El Niño?

Sa panahon ng El Niño, matinding tagtuyot ang nag-papatuyo sa Magat Dam sa Isabela, kaya bumababa nang malaki ang tubig para sa patubig at hydroelectric power!
fact_en:
What happens to the Magat Dam during El Niño?

During El Niño events, severe droughts dry up the Magat Dam in Isabela, drastically reducing water for irrigation and hydroelectric power!

title: Galleon Trade Monsoon
fact_tl:
Paano nakalibot sa Pasipiko ang makasaysayang Manila-Acapulco Galleon Trade?

Umasa sila sa predictable seasonal reversal ng Amihan at Habagat monsoon winds para makalibot sa Pasipiko!
fact_en:
How did the historical Manila-Acapulco Galleon Trade sail across the Pacific?

They relied on the predictable seasonal reversal of the Amihan and Habagat monsoon winds to sail across the ocean!

title: 253 mph ni Cyclone Olivia
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na wind speed na naitala sa buong Earth ay 253 miles per hour noong Cyclone Olivia!
fact_en: The fastest wind speed ever recorded on Earth was a whopping 253 miles per hour during Cyclone Olivia!

title: Pinakalumang Mineral Grains
fact_tl:
Gaano kaluma ang pinakalumang mineral grains na natagpuan sa Western Australia?

May edad na humigit-kumulang 4.4 bilyong taon! Ito ang pinakalumang mineral grains na natagpuan sa Western Australia sa ating Earth.
fact_en:
How old are the oldest known mineral grains on Earth found in Western Australia?

They are about 4.4 billion years old! These are the oldest known mineral grains on our planet Earth.

title: Mud Crab sa Spring Tide
fact_tl: Ang mga mud crab sa Pilipinas na nakatira sa mga bakawan ay lumilipat sa mas mataas na lupa! Nangyayari ito kapag dumarating ang malalakas na spring tides na dulot ng buwan.
fact_en: Philippine mud crabs in mangrove forests migrate to higher ground! They do this during the strong spring tides caused by the moon.

title: Banaue Rice Terraces
fact_tl: Ang Banaue Rice Terraces ay gumagamit ng stone at mud walls para pigilan ang soil erosion at hold water para sa pagtatanim ng rice!
fact_en: The Banaue Rice Terraces use stone and mud walls to prevent soil erosion and hold water for growing rice!

title: Buwan Pagkatapos ng Full Moon
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa Buwan pagkatapos ng full moon?

Pumasok ito sa waning gibbous phase ng lunar cycle! Sa yugtong ito, nagsisimulang humupa ang liwanag na nakikita sa Buwan.
fact_en:
What happens to the Moon right after a full moon?

It enters the waning gibbous phase of the lunar cycle! During this stage, the illuminated portion of the Moon begins to decrease.

title: Meteoroid, Meteor, Meteorite
fact_tl: Ang meteoroid ay maliit na bato sa kalawakan. Kapag sumunog ito sa himpapawid, ito ay meteor (bulalakaw)! At kung may matira na bumagsak sa lupa, ito ay meteorite!
fact_en: A meteoroid is a small rock in space. When it burns up as a streak of light, it's a meteor (shooting star)! If it lands on the ground, it's a meteorite!

title: 20 Bagyo kada Taon
fact_tl: Tinatawag ng mga Pilipino ang tropical cyclones na 'bagyo,' at nakararanas ang bansa ng mga 20 bawat taon dahil sa Pacific location nito!
fact_en: Filipinos call tropical cyclones 'bagyo,' and the country experiences about 20 annually due to its Pacific location!

title: UV Index 3 Pataas
fact_tl: Magsuot ng sunscreen kapag ang UV index ay 3 pataas para protektahan ang balat mula sa pinsala ng ultraviolet rays!
fact_en: Always wear sunscreen when the UV index is 3 or higher to prevent skin damage from ultraviolet rays!

title: Hugas pagkatapos Mag-garden
fact_tl: Laging hugasan ang kamay ng sabon pagkatapos mag-garden! Ang lupa ay pwedeng magtago ng hookworm larvae na pumapasok sa balat at nakakasakit.
fact_en: Always wash your hands with soap after gardening! Soil can hide hookworm larvae that sneak into bare skin and make you sick.

title: Storm Surge sa Samar Leyte
fact_tl:
Ano ang mga storm surge?

Nangyayari ito kapag ang malakas na hangin ng bagyo ay tumutulak ng malalaking pader ng seawater, binabaha ang mga bayan sa Samar at Leyte!
fact_en:
What are storm surges?

They happen when strong typhoon winds push massive walls of seawater inland, flooding coastal towns in Samar and Leyte higher than normal tides!

title: Mohs Hardness Kit ng Geologist
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang mga geologist ng Mohs hardness kit na may mga mineral tulad ng talc at diamond para subukan kung gaano kadaling makuskos ang ibang bato!
fact_en: Geologists use a Mohs hardness kit with minerals like talc and diamond to test how easily other rocks get scratched!

title: Liwanag Hanggang Neptune
fact_tl: Tumatawid ang liwanag ng araw ng mga 4.1 oras para marating ang Neptune, pero walong minuto lang sa Earth!
fact_en: Sunlight takes about 4.1 hours to reach Neptune, but just eight minutes to reach Earth!

title: Pagiging Red Giant ng Bituin
fact_tl: Kapag naubusan na ng hydrogen fuel sa core ang isang medium-sized na bituin, lumalawak at lumalamig ito para maging isang red giant!
fact_en: When a medium-sized star runs out of hydrogen fuel in its core, it expands and cools down to become a red giant!

title: Signal Number 3 ng Bagyo
fact_tl: Ang Signal Number 3 ng PAGASA ay nagbabala ng severe typhoon winds na kayang gumupit ng malalaking puno, kaya manatili sa matibay na gusali!
fact_en: PAGASA's Signal Number 3 warns of severe typhoon winds that can uproot large trees, so stay inside sturdy buildings!

title: Kidlat Bago Kulog
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ay naglalakbay nang mga 874,000 beses na mas mabilis kaysa tunog sa hangin, kaya lagi mong nakikita ang kidlat bago ang kulog!
fact_en: Light travels about 874,000 times faster than sound in air, which is why you always see lightning before hearing thunder!

title: El Nino sa Eastern Pacific
fact_tl: Ang El Niño ay isang tiyak na pattern ng klima kung saan hindi normal na umiinit ang ibabaw na tubig sa silangang bahagi ng Pacific Ocean!
fact_en: El Niño is a specific climate pattern characterized by the unusual warming of surface waters in the eastern Pacific Ocean!

title: 100 Toneladang Meteor
fact_tl: Araw-araw, mga 100 tonelada ng space dust at maliliit na bato ang pumapasok sa Earth's atmosphere at nasusunog bilang mga meteor!
fact_en: Every single day, about 100 tons of space dust and tiny rocks fall through Earth's atmosphere and burn up as bright meteors!

title: 20 km na Neutron Star
fact_tl:
Gaano kaliit ang isang neutron star?

Ang mga neutron star ay sobrang dense—kasing-bigat ng buong Sun, pero nasa loob lang ng bilog na 20 kilometro ang lapad, kasing laki ng isang lungsod!
fact_en:
How tiny can a neutron star be?

Neutron stars are incredibly dense—they pack the entire mass of our Sun into a sphere only 20 kilometers wide, about the size of a city!

title: Milky Way 100,000 ly
fact_tl: Napakalaki ng Milky Way galaxy natin — mga 100,000 light-years ang lapad! Kahit ang liwanag, ang pinakamabilis na bagay, kailangan pa ng libu-libong taon para tumawid.
fact_en: Our Milky Way galaxy is huge — about 100,000 light-years across! Even light, the fastest thing ever, takes thousands of years to cross it.

title: Iba't Ibang Teleskopyo
fact_tl:
Bakit iba-iba ang teleskopyo ng mga astronomo?

Gumagamit sila ng visible, radio, at X-ray telescopes para mangalap ng electromagnetic waves, kasama ang liwanag na di-nakikita ng mata!
fact_en:
Why do astronomers use different kinds of telescopes?

They use visible, radio, and X-ray telescopes to collect electromagnetic waves, including light our eyes cannot see!

title: Hindi Parehong Pattern
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, may mga bulkan na madalas sumabog habang ang iba ay tahimik ng ilang dekada. Hindi pareho ang pattern sa bawat bundok!
fact_en: In the Philippines, some volcanoes erupt often while others stay quiet for decades. The pattern is not the same for every mountain!

title: Hibok-Hibok noong 1951
fact_tl: Sumabog ang Hibok-Hibok sa Camiguin noong 1951! Ito ay isang paalala na kahit tahimik ang isang isla, maaari pa rin itong gumising.
fact_en: Hibok-Hibok on Camiguin erupted in 1951! This is a reminder that a quiet island volcano can still wake up.

title: Sabihin Start Kapag Handa
fact_tl: Sabihin ang 'simula' lang kapag handa na lahat! Para walang trial na may lihim na dagdag na paghalo na wala sa iba.
fact_en: Say 'start' only when everything is ready! This ensures one trial does not secretly include extra mixing time that the others did not get.

title: Tatlong Punto bago Graph
fact_tl:
Bakit maghintay ng tatlong maingat na pagsubok bago gumuhit ng simpleng grap?

Dahil dalawang punto lang ay maaaring mag-linya lang na swerte! Tatlong pagsubok ang naggagawa sa iyong grap na mas mapagkakatiwalaan.
fact_en:
Why wait for three careful trials before drawing a simple graph?

Because two points can make a line that is only luck! Three trials make your graph much more trustworthy.

title: Parehong Init sa Bawat Trial
fact_tl: Kung ang test mo ay gumagamit ng heat, gamitin ang parehong stove setting o sunny windowsill! Kung hindi, ang heat mismo ang magiging extra variable.
fact_en: If your test uses heat, use the exact same stove setting or sunny windowsill! Otherwise, the heat itself becomes an extra variable.

title: Isang Eksaktong Pangungusap
fact_tl: Sumulat ng isang eksaktong pangungusap kung paano mo ginawa ang test, para magawa ito ulit ng ibang grupo at masuri ang pattern!
fact_en: Write one exact sentence about how you did the test, so another group can repeat it and check your pattern!

title: Parehong Safe Gear
fact_tl: Magsuot ng parehas na safe gear sa bawat trial at huwag laktawan ang kahit isang safety step para mapabilis, dahil ang fair test ay laging safe test!
fact_en: Wear the same safe gear in every trial and never skip a safety step to go faster, because a fair test is always a safe test!

title: Isang Hakbang Isa-isa
fact_tl:
Bakit isang hakbang lang ang gagawin at tse-check?

Ang pagtalon sa susunod ay nakakapagpawala ng plano niyong paghahambing! Gawin ang isang hakbang, i-check, at mag-focus.
fact_en:
Why do one step at a time and check it off?

Skipping ahead makes groups lose their planned comparison! Do one written step, check it off, and stay focused.

title: Materyales sa Tray Bago Simula
fact_tl: Ilapag lahat ng materyales sa tray bago magsimula! Kaya, kahit kulang ng kutsara, hindi mahihinto ang eksperimento.
fact_en: Gather all your materials on a tray first! This way, a missing spoon won't pause your test halfway through.

title: Pagsulat Habang Nagsasagawa
fact_tl: Isulat ang mga numero habang ginagawa ang hakbang, hindi pagkatapos mag-ayos! Nakakalito ang memorya kapag malinis na ang mesa.
fact_en: Write down your numbers while doing the steps, not after packing up! Memory gets tricky once the table is clean.

title: Eksaktong Dami 100 ml
fact_tl: Ilagay ang eksaktong dami sa listahan! Isulat ang "100 milliliters ng tubig" para hindi mag-iba ang "kaunting tubig" bawat pagsubok.
fact_en: Put exact amounts on your materials list! Write "100 milliliters of water" so "some water" isn't different each time.

title: Finding, Hindi Grade
fact_tl: Ang finding ay kung ano ang ipinakita ng test, hindi grade! Kahit maingat na test, maaari pa ring ipakita na mali ang unang idea mo.
fact_en: The finding is just what the test showed, not a grade! A careful test can still show your first idea was wrong.

title: Pagsasanay gamit ang Empty Cups
fact_tl: Kung bago ang group, mag-practice muna ng timing step gamit ang empty cups! Pagkatapos, gawin ang real investigation gamit ang listed materials.
fact_en: If your group is new, practice the timing step once with empty cups! Then, do the real investigation with your listed materials.

title: Mayon na 50 Beses mula 1616
fact_tl: Pumutok na ang Mayon nang mga limampung beses mula 1616! Ang mahabang talaan na ito ay nakatutulong para makita natin kung gaano ito kadalas gumising.
fact_en: Mayon has erupted about fifty times since 1616! This long record helps us see how often it tends to wake up.

title: Paglapit, Mas Mataas na Tunog
fact_tl: Kapag papalapit ang isang tunog na bagay, nagbubukol ang sound waves nito, kaya mas mataas ang pitch na maririnig mo!
fact_en: When a sounding object moves toward you, its sound waves bunch up, making you hear a higher pitch!

title: Paglayo, Mas Mababa
fact_tl: Kung lalayo ka sa kumakalingkong na bell, mas kaunting sound waves ang makikita mo bawat segundo, kaya mas mababa ang tunog!
fact_en: If you walk away from a ringing bell, you meet fewer sound waves each second, so the bell sounds a little lower!

title: Mabilis na Horn, Malaking Taas
fact_tl: Mas mabilis na gumagalaw ang horn papalapit, mas nagbubukol ang sound waves, kaya mas malaki ang pagtaas ng pitch kaysa sa mabagal na horn!
fact_en: The faster a horn moves toward you, the more the sound waves bunch up, causing a greater rise in pitch than a slow horn!

title: Doppler ay Pitch, Hindi Lakas
fact_tl: Ang gumagalaw na horn ay lumalakas paglapit, pero ang Doppler change ay tungkol lang sa pitch, kung gaano kataas o kababa ng tunog!
fact_en: A moving horn gets louder as it comes near, but the Doppler change is only about pitch, which is how high or low it sounds!

title: Walang Galaw, Walang Slide
fact_tl: Kung parehong hindi gumagalaw ang sound source at ang nakikinig, hindi mag-i-slide ang pitch pataas o pababa mula sa motion!
fact_en: If both the sound source and the listener stay completely still, the pitch does not slide up or down from motion!

title: Kaklaseng Hum Papalapit
fact_tl: Ang kaklase mong naglalakad papunta sa'yo habang hum ay medyo mas mataas ang tunog kaysa kapag naglalakad palayo sa'yo!
fact_en: A classmate walking toward you while humming sounds slightly higher than the exact same hum when that classmate walks away from you!

title: Doppler, Hindi Echo
fact_tl: Hindi echo ang pagbabago ng pitch! Ang echo ay bounce, pero ang Doppler ay pagbabago sa pagkakapangkat ng waves.
fact_en: That pitch change isn't an echo! An echo is a bounce, but Doppler is a change in how sound waves are spaced.

title: Kaunti Crest Mababa
fact_tl: Mas mababang pitch, mas kaunting wave crest ang dumarating bawat segundo! Kapag lumalayo ang source, nagpapaluwag ito ng mga crest.
fact_en: Lower pitch means fewer wave crests arrive each second! When a source races away, it leaves those crests more spread out.

title: Kailangan Pa rin ng Hangin
fact_tl: Kahit gumagalaw, kailangan pa rin ng hangin! Dumarating pa rin ang tunog sa isang medium — binabago lang ng Doppler ang pagitan ng mga alon.
fact_en: Moving doesn't remove the need for air! Sound still travels through a medium — Doppler only changes the spacing of those waves.

title: Parehong Tunog, Ibang Pack
fact_tl: Pareho pa rin ang tunog ng makina o busina! Ang nagbabago ay kung paano naka-pack ang mga alon kapag gumagalaw ang pinagmulan.
fact_en: The engine or horn keeps making the same sound! What changes for you is how those waves are packed when the source is moving.

title: Parehong Tumatakbo Papalapit
fact_tl: Kung ang isang sasakyan na may busina ay tumatakbo papunta sa iyo habang tumatakbo ka rin, mas malaki ang pagtaas ng tono kaysa kung isa lang ang gumagalaw!
fact_en: If a horned vehicle races toward you while you run toward it, the pitch rise is larger than if only one of you is moving!

title: Parehong Tumatakbo Palayo
fact_tl: Kung ang pinagmulan ay tumatakbo palayo habang tumatakbo ka rin palayo, mas kaunti ang alon na dumarating sa iyo bawat segundo, kaya mas bumababa ang tono!
fact_en: If the source races away while you also run away, even fewer waves reach you each second, so the pitch can fall even more!

title: Longitudinal Wave Pa rin
fact_tl: Kahit gumagalaw ang pinagmulan, ang tunog sa hangin ay mananatiling longitudinal wave! Binabago lang ng Doppler ang espasyo ng alon, hindi ang side-to-side na galaw.
fact_en: Even if the source moves, sound in air is still a longitudinal wave! The Doppler effect just changes the wave spacing, not the side-to-side motion.

title: Tahimik, Hindi Mababa
fact_tl: Ang malayong busina ay mas tahimik, pero ang tahimik ay hindi low pitch! Ang Doppler ay high-to-low na pagbabago mula sa galaw, hindi layo.
fact_en: A far horn is quieter, but quiet is not low pitch! Doppler is the high-to-low pitch change from motion, not just distance.

title: Ulan, Hindi Doppler
fact_tl:
Ang malakas na ulan ba ay Doppler effect?

Hindi! Ang paglakas ng ulan ay hindi Doppler pitch slide. Ang Doppler ay high-to-low pitch change dahil sa galaw ng source o listener.
fact_en:
Is loud rain the Doppler effect?

No! Rain getting louder isn't a Doppler pitch slide. Doppler is a high-to-low pitch change caused by the motion of the source or listener.

title: Transverse Wave sa Jump Rope
fact_tl:
