Ano ang nangyayari sa basurang hindi nakokolekta?

Maaari itong magdulot ng polusyon sa lupa, tubig, at hangin, na nakakasama sa lahat ng may buhay.
fact_en:
What happens to garbage that is not collected?

It can cause land, water, and air pollution, which harms all living things.

title: Reuse: Gamitin Muli
fact_tl: Ang Reuse ay ang paggamit muli ng mga materyales para sa parehong layunin, tulad ng pagsusuot ng luma ngunit magagamit pang sapatos.
fact_en: Reuse means using materials again for the same purpose, such as wearing old but usable shoes.

title: Layuning Zero Waste
fact_tl: Ang pinakalayunin ng 5Rs waste management ay zero waste, ibig sabihin ang planetang Earth ay malaya sa anumang uri ng basura.
fact_en: The ultimate goal of the 5Rs waste management is zero waste, meaning planet Earth is free from any kind of garbage.

title: Pitong Metrong Small Intestine
fact_tl:
Paano nagkakasya ang 7 metrong tubo sa katawan ko?

Ang small intestine ay mga 2.5 cm ang lapad at 7 m ang haba, pero nakapulupot at nakatiklop ito nang maraming beses kaya nagkakasya sa tiyan habang sinisipsip ang karamihan ng nutrients!
fact_en:
How can a 7-meter tube fit inside my body?

The small intestine is about 2.5 cm wide and 7 m long, but it is coiled and folded many times so it fits inside your belly while absorbing most nutrients!

title: Tuwalyang Mabilis Matuyo
fact_tl: Magtabi ng tuwalya na mahusay sumipsip ng tubig at mabilis matuyo para magamit muli pagkatapos mabasa sa ulan.
fact_en: Keep a towel that can absorb water well and dry quickly so you can use it again after getting wet in the rain.

title: Voltage ng LED TV Adaptor
fact_tl: Ang LED TV power adaptor na may 2-milliampere na output at resistance na 900 ohms ay may voltage output na 1.8 volts.
fact_en: An LED TV power adaptor with a 2-milliampere output and resistance of 900 ohms has a voltage output of 1.8 volts.

title: Amoy ng Nail Polish Remover
fact_tl:
Bakit napakalakas ng amoy ng nail polish remover?

Naglalaman ito ng acetone, isang organic compound na napakabilis mag-evaporate at ginagamit bilang cleaner at solvent.
fact_en:
Why does nail polish remover smell so strong?

It contains acetone, an organic compound that evaporates very quickly and is used as a cleaner and solvent.

title: Organics Kahit Saan
fact_tl:
Bakit napakahalaga ng mga organic compounds sa pang-araw-araw na buhay?

Ginagamit ang mga ito kahit saan: bilang fuel sa pagluluto at mga sasakyan, bilang cleaners, disinfectants, pampalasa ng pagkain, at maging sa plastics at gamot.
fact_en:
Why are organic compounds so important in daily life?

They are used everywhere: as fuels for cooking and vehicles, as cleaners, disinfectants, food flavors, and even in plastics and medicines.

title: Tulak o Hila
fact_tl: Ang magnetic force ay ang pagtulak o paghila na ginagawa ng magnet sa ilang mga bagay.
fact_en: Magnetic force is the push or pull that a magnet exerts on certain objects.

title: Mga Codon at Anticodon
fact_tl:
Paano nalalaman ng tRNA kung aling amino acid ang dadalhin?

Ang bawat tRNA ay may anticodon na nagpapares sa katugmang mRNA codon, para matiyak na tamang amino acid ang idinadagdag!
fact_en:
How does tRNA know which amino acid to bring?

Each tRNA has an anticodon that pairs with a matching mRNA codon, making sure the right amino acid is added!

title: Polypeptide hanggang Protina
fact_tl: Ang polypeptide chain na ginawa habang nagaganap ang translation ay pinoproseso pa bago ito maging functional protein na kayang gawin ang trabaho nito.
fact_en: The polypeptide chain produced during translation is processed further before it becomes a functional protein that can do its job.

title: Likas o Gawa ng Tao
fact_tl:
Ang lawa ba ay likas o gawa ng tao na pinagkukunan ng tubig?

Likas na pinagkukunan ng tubig dahil ito ay nabubuo nang mag-isa sa kalikasan, hindi tulad ng water pipe na itinayo ng mga tao.
fact_en:
Is a lake a natural or man-made source of water?

A natural source of water because it forms on its own in nature, unlike a water pipe that people build.

title: Mas Malalim, Mas Mainit
fact_tl: Parehong tumataas ang temperature at pressure habang papalapit ka sa gitna ng Earth.
fact_en: Temperature and pressure both increase as you go deeper toward Earth's center.

title: Natural na Bagay o Hindi
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi natural ang isang upuan?

Ang upuan ay gawa ng tao dahil ginawa ito ng mga tao, kadalasan gamit ang mga tool. Ang mesa, chalk, plastik na bote, at kotse ay gawa rin ng tao!
fact_en:
Why is a chair not a natural thing?

A chair is human-made because people built it, often using tools. Tables, chalk, plastic bottles, and cars are also made by people!

title: Continental Drift Theory
fact_tl: Sinasabi ng continental drift theory na ang mga kontinente ng Earth ay dating magkakadikit sa isang malaking lupain at dahan-dahang nagkahiwalay sa loob ng milyun-milyong taon.
fact_en: The continental drift theory states that Earth's continents were once joined together in a single landmass and have slowly moved apart over millions of years.

title: Liwanag Nagiging Init
fact_tl: Ang ilang materyales ay nag-a-absorb ng liwanag at ginagawa itong init, tulad ng maitim na damit, itim na sapatos, at uling na umiinit sa ilalim ng araw.
fact_en: Some materials absorb light and change it to heat, like dark clothes, black shoes, and coal that feel warm under the sun.

title: Bagong Oceanic Lithosphere
fact_tl: Ang divergent boundaries ay maaaring lumikha ng bagong oceanic lithosphere, ang matigas na panlabas na layer ng Earth sa ilalim ng karagatan, kapag umaakyat at lumalamig ang molten rock.
fact_en: Divergent boundaries can create new oceanic lithosphere, the rigid outer layer of Earth beneath the ocean, when molten rock rises and cools.

title: Bawas Oras, Bawas Bayad
fact_tl:
Bakit bumababa ang bill ko sa kuryente kapag hindi ko masyadong ginagamit ang plantsa?

Dahil ang pagbawas sa oras ng paggamit ng mga high-power na appliance ay nagpapababa ng kabuuang konsumo ng electrical energy, kaya bumababa rin ang bayad!
fact_en:
Why does my electric bill go down when I use the flat iron less?

Because reducing the usage time of high-power appliances lowers the total electrical energy consumption, which lowers the cost!

title: Diesel Power Plants
fact_tl: Ang mga diesel power plant ay nagsusunog ng diesel fuel upang patakbuhin ang mga generator na gumagawa ng kuryente, at ang fuel na ito ay non-renewable.
fact_en: Diesel power plants burn diesel fuel to run generators that produce electricity, and this fuel source is non-renewable.

title: Kilusang Earth Hour
fact_tl: Ang Earth Hour ay isang pandaigdigang kilusan na inorganisa ng World Wildlife Fund upang hikayatin ang mga tao na patayin ang mga ilaw sa loob ng isang oras upang makatipid ng enerhiya.
fact_en: Earth Hour is a worldwide movement organized by the World Wildlife Fund to encourage people to turn off lights for one hour to save energy.

title: Protinang Cytochrome C
fact_tl: Ang cytochrome c ay isang protina na matatagpuan sa loob ng mitochondria, ang powerhouse ng cell, at ikinukumpara ng mga siyentipiko ang pagkakasunod-sunod ng amino acid nito para makita kung gaano kalapit ang pagkakamag-anak ng iba't ibang hayop.
fact_en: Cytochrome c is a protein found inside mitochondria, the cell's powerhouse, and scientists compare its amino acid sequence to see how closely related different animals are.

title: Distance Kapag Nakahinto
fact_tl: Kapag ang isang bagay ay nakahinto at hindi gumagalaw, ang distance nito ay zero dahil wala itong nilakbay na anumang haba ng daan.
fact_en: When an object is at rest and not moving, its distance is zero because it has not traveled any length of path.

title: Hindi Suportadong Hypothesis
fact_tl: Kung ang hypothesis ay hindi suportado ng mga resulta, hindi magpapanggap ang researcher na tama ito; sa halip, iniuulat nila ang totoong nangyari at maaaring bumuo ng bagong hypothesis.
fact_en: If a hypothesis is not supported by the results, a researcher does not pretend it was right; instead, they report what actually happened and may form a new hypothesis.

title: Transmission Electron Microscope
fact_tl: Ang transmission electron microscope ay nagpapadaan ng electron beam sa isang ultra-thin na sample para ipakita ang pinong detalye sa loob ng specimen.
fact_en: A transmission electron microscope passes an electron beam through an ultra-thin sample to show fine details inside the specimen.

title: Scanning Electron Microscope
fact_tl: Ang scanning electron microscope ay nagpapatalbog ng electron beam sa surface ng isang sample para makabuo ng three-dimensional na imahe ng labas nito.
fact_en: A scanning electron microscope bounces an electron beam off the surface of a sample to create a three-dimensional image of its outside.

title: Unang Simple Microscope
fact_tl:
Ano ang tawag sa mga unang simple microscope?

Tinawag silang flea glasses dahil ginagamit ito ng mga tao para pag-aralan ang maliliit na insekto tulad ng mga pulgas!
fact_en:
What were the first simple microscopes called?

They were called flea glasses because people used them to study small insects like fleas!

title: Abbe Sine Condition
fact_tl: Si Ernst Abbe ay sumulat ng mathematical formula na tinatawag na Abbe Sine Condition noong 1872, na tumulong sa mga microscope na makamit ang pinakamataas na posibleng resolution.
fact_en: Ernst Abbe wrote a mathematical formula called the Abbe Sine Condition in 1872, which helped microscopes achieve the maximum possible resolution.

title: Joseph Jackson Lister
fact_tl: Si Joseph Jackson Lister ay gumawa ng prototype ng compound microscope sa 1830 na gumamit ng ilang mahihinang lens nang magkakasama para mabawasan ang paglabo at magbigay ng magandang magnification.
fact_en: Joseph Jackson Lister built a prototype compound microscope in 1830 that used several weak lenses together to reduce blurring and give good magnification.

title: Pagtanggap o Pagtanggi
fact_tl: Sa conclusion, ang hypothesis ay maaaring tanggapin o hindi tanggapin batay sa ebidensyang nakalap mula sa experiment.
fact_en: During the conclusion, a hypothesis is either accepted or rejected based on the evidence gathered from the experiment.

title: Asteroid 2012 DA14
fact_tl: Ang Asteroid 2012 DA14 ay gumawa ng napakalapit na paglapit sa Earth noong Pebrero 16, 2012, at sumabog sa Lake Cherbakul sa Russia.
fact_en: Asteroid 2012 DA14 made a very close approach to Earth on February 16, 2012, and exploded over Lake Cherbakul in Russia.

title: Troposphere: Pinakamababang Layer
fact_tl: Ang troposphere ang pinakamababang layer ng atmosphere, at hawak nito ang halos 75% ng lahat ng gas sa atmosphere dahil hinihila ng gravity ang mga ito palapit sa Earth.
fact_en: The troposphere is the lowest layer of the atmosphere, and it holds about 75% of all atmospheric gases because gravity pulls them close to Earth.

title: Buwanang Pagkahinog ng Egg Cells
fact_tl: Ang egg cells ay nahihinog minsan kada buwan sa ovaries, at ito ang female sex cells na kailangan para sa reproduction.
fact_en: Egg cells mature once every month in the ovaries, and these are the female sex cells needed for reproduction.

title: Coarse Adjustment Knob
fact_tl: Ang coarse adjustment knob ay ang malaking knob na mabilis na nagpapagalaw sa body tube pataas at pababa para makita ang specimen sa ilalim ng low power.
fact_en: The coarse adjustment knob is the large knob that moves the body tube up and down quickly to bring the specimen into view under low power.

title: Percent by Mass
fact_tl:
Bakit ginagamit natin ang percent by mass?

Sinasabi nito kung ilang gramo ng solute ang nasa bawat 100 gramo ng buong solution, parang recipe para sa mga scientist!
fact_en:
Why do we use percent by mass?

It tells us exactly how many grams of solute are in every 100 grams of the whole solution, like a recipe for scientists!

title: Halimbawa ng Percent by Mass
fact_tl: Kung magtunaw ka ng 20 gramo ng baking soda sa 600 gramo ng tubig, ang percent by mass ay mga 3.23%, dahil maliit na bahagi lamang ng buong solution ang solute.
fact_en: If you dissolve 20 grams of baking soda in 600 grams of water, the percent by mass is about 3.23%, because the solute is a small part of the whole solution.

title: Halimbawa ng Percent by Volume
fact_tl: Kung ang isang solution ay may 50 milliliters ng isopropyl alcohol sa 100 milliliters ng tubig, ang percent by volume ay mga 33.33%, dahil ang kabuuang volume ay 150 milliliters.
fact_en: If a solution has 50 milliliters of isopropyl alcohol in 100 milliliters of water, the percent by volume is about 33.33%, because the total volume is 150 milliliters.

title: Mula sa Maliit Hanggang Malaki
fact_tl: Maaari mong paghambingin ang mga bagay at ayusin ang mga ito mula sa pinakamaliit hanggang sa pinakamalaki, tulad ng paghahanay ng mga dahon ayon sa laki.
fact_en: You can compare objects and arrange them in order from the smallest to the largest, like lining up leaves by size.

title: Lumang Ecosystem, Mayamang Lupa
fact_tl: Ang mga lumang ecosystem tulad ng tropical rainforest ay may mas maraming biodiversity dahil pinayaman ng mga decomposer ang lupa sa loob ng milyun-milyong taon.
fact_en: Older ecosystems like tropical rainforests have more biodiversity because decomposers have enriched the soil for millions of years.

title: Coral Reef Hotspots
fact_tl: Ang mga coral reef na matatagpuan sa may equator ay itinuturing na hotspots at kung minsan ay tinatawag na "tropical rainforests ng karagatan" dahil nakakatanggap sila ng masaganang sikat ng araw.
fact_en: Coral reefs found along the equator are considered hotspots and are sometimes called the "tropical rainforests of the ocean" because they get abundant sunlight.

title: Output Force Katumbas ng Bigat
fact_tl: Sa inclined plane, ang output force ay ang puwersang kailangan para itaas ang bagay nang diretso, at katumbas ito ng bigat ng bagay.
fact_en: On an inclined plane, the output force is the force needed to lift the object straight up, and it equals the weight of the object.

title: Pagkwenta ng Average Atomic Mass
fact_tl: Ang average atomic mass ng isang elemento ay kinukwenta mula sa mga mass at relative abundances, o kung gaano kadalas ang bawat isotope sa kalikasan.
fact_en: The average atomic mass of an element is calculated from the masses and relative abundances, or how common each isotope is in nature.

title: Iba Pang Serbisyo ng PAGASA
fact_tl: Nagbibigay din ang PAGASA ng babala sa baha, payo sa panahon para sa mga magsasaka, at impormasyon pa tungkol sa mga bituin at planeta.
fact_en: PAGASA also gives flood warnings, farm weather advice, and even information about the stars and planets.

title: Storm Signal 1
fact_tl: Sa ilalim ng Storm Signal 1, ang hangin ay maaaring umabot sa 63 kilometers per hour, sapat na para tumagilid ang mga halaman at magdulot ng power outage sa ilang lugar.
fact_en: Under Storm Signal 1, winds can reach 63 kilometers per hour, enough to tilt plants and cause power outages in some areas.

title: Storm Signal 2
fact_tl: Ang Storm Signal 2 ay may dalang hangin hanggang 120 kilometers per hour, na maaaring magdulot ng maliit hanggang katamtamang pinsala kahit sa mga bahay na matibay ang pagkagawa.
fact_en: Storm Signal 2 brings winds up to 120 kilometers per hour, which can cause minor to moderate damage even to well-constructed houses.

title: Enhanced Greenhouse Effect
fact_tl: Ang pagdami ng greenhouse gases mula sa mga gawain ng tao ay nagdudulot ng enhanced greenhouse effect, na mas nagkukulong ng init kaysa natural na proseso.
fact_en: Increased greenhouse gas concentrations from human activities cause an enhanced greenhouse effect, trapping more heat than the natural process.

title: Global Warming at Climate Change
fact_tl: Ang enhanced greenhouse effect ay nagdudulot ng global warming at climate change, na nagbabago sa mga pattern ng panahon sa buong mundo.
fact_en: The enhanced greenhouse effect leads to global warming and climate change, altering weather patterns around the world.

title: Philippine Clean Air Act
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Clean Air Act ng 1999 ay nagtatakda ng air quality standards at mga limitasyon para sa mga pollutant tulad ng particulate matter, sulfur dioxide, at nitrogen dioxide.
fact_en: The Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999 sets air quality standards and limits for pollutants like particulate matter, sulfur dioxide, and nitrogen dioxide.

title: Iba't Ibang Itsura
fact_tl: Ang iba't ibang halaman ay maaaring may mga ugat, tangkay, at dahon na magkakaiba ang itsura, pero pareho pa rin ang kanilang mga pangunahing bahagi.
fact_en: Different plants can have roots, stems, and leaves that look different from each other, but they all have the same basic parts.

title: Juan Salcedo, Jr.
fact_tl: Si Juan Salcedo, Jr. ay isang Pambansang Scientist ng Pilipinas na nagtrabaho sa nutrition at public health, tumutulong sa mga komunidad na manatiling malusog sa pamamagitan ng mas mabuting pagkain.
fact_en: Juan Salcedo, Jr. was a Filipino National Scientist who worked in nutrition and public health, helping communities stay healthy through better food.

title: Oil Immersion Objective
fact_tl: Ang oil immersion objectives, na may markang 97x o 100x, ay ginagamit para makita ang bacteria, napakaliit na protists, at fungi.
fact_en: Oil immersion objectives, marked 97x or 100x, are used to view bacteria, very small protists, and fungi.

title: Ang Mirror o Light Source
fact_tl: Ang mirror o light source ang gumagawa ng liwanag na dumadaan sa diaphragm para mailawan ang specimen.
fact_en: The mirror or light source produces light that passes through the diaphragm to illuminate the specimen.

title: Low at High Power Objectives
fact_tl:
Ano ang low power at high power objectives?

Ang low power objective ay may markang 10x o 12x, habang ang high power objective ay may markang 40x, 43x, o 60x.
fact_en:
What are the low power and high power objectives?

The low power objective is marked 10x or 12x, while the high power objective is marked 40x, 43x, or 60x.

title: Walang Hanggang Imahe
fact_tl: Ang dalawang plane mirror na magkaharap nang parallel ay kayang mag-reflect ng imahe pabalik-balik nang walang katapusan, kaya nagbubunga ito ng infinite number of images na hindi na mabilang.
fact_en: Two plane mirrors facing each other in parallel can reflect an image back and forth forever, producing an infinite number of images that cannot be counted.

title: Liwanag mula sa Concave Mirror
fact_tl: Ang mga concave mirror, na mga converging mirror na nagpo-focus ng liwanag sa isang punto, ay ginagamit sa headlamps, flashlights, at spotlights para tipunin ang liwanag mula sa maliit na bombilya at maglabas ng mas maliwanag na beam.
fact_en: Concave mirrors, which are converging mirrors that focus light to a point, are used in headlamps, flashlights, and spotlights to gather light from a small bulb and send out a brighter beam.

title: Cloud Cover o Kaulapan
fact_tl: Ang cloud cover, na tinatawag ding cloudiness, ay kung gaano karami sa langit ang natatakpan ng mga ulap, at maaari itong mula sa clear hanggang partly cloudy hanggang sa completely overcast.
fact_en: Cloud cover, also called cloudiness, is how much of the sky is covered by clouds, and it can range from clear to partly cloudy to completely overcast.

title: Paraan o Procedures
fact_tl: Ang method o procedures ay ang mga numbered at sunod-sunod na panuto na nagsasabi sa ibang tao kung paano eksaktong uulitin ang iyong investigation.
fact_en: The method or procedures are the numbered, step-by-step instructions that tell another person exactly how to repeat your investigation.

title: Iba't Ibang Uri ng Buto
fact_tl: Ang mga buto ay may iba't ibang laki, hugis, kulay, at tekstura, mula sa maliliit na bilog na buto ng mustasa hanggang sa malalaking mabalahibong buto ng mangga.
fact_en: Seeds come in many sizes, shapes, colors, and textures, from tiny round mustard seeds to big hairy mango seeds.

title: Mataas na Araw, Mas Mainit
fact_tl: Kapag mataas ang araw sa langit, matarik ang anggulo ng sinag nito sa lupa, kaya concentrated ang solar energy sa mas maliit na lugar at mas umiinit.
fact_en: When the Sun is high in the sky, its rays strike the ground at a steep angle, concentrating solar energy on a smaller area and causing more heating.

title: Mainit sa Equator Buong Taon
fact_tl:
Bakit mainit malapit sa equator buong taon?

Laging tumatanggap ang equator ng sikat ng araw sa matataas na anggulo, kaya concentrated ang solar energy at halos hindi nagbabago ang temperatura.
fact_en:
Why is it warm near the equator all year?

The equator always receives sunlight at high angles, so the solar energy stays concentrated and the temperature stays fairly constant.

title: Mas Mahabang Araw sa Hemisphere
fact_tl: Ang hemisphere na nakatagilid patungo sa Araw ay may mas mahabang araw dahil mas maraming oras itong nananatili sa liwanag ng Araw kada araw.
fact_en: The hemisphere that is tilted toward the Sun has longer daytime because it stays in the Sun's light for more hours each day.

title: Sirang Tirang Pagkain
fact_tl: Ang mga tirang pagkain tulad ng balat ng saging at hiwa ng tinapay ay nagbabago ng kulay at amoy, at ang tinapay ay maaaring tubuan ng berdeng molds.
fact_en: Food leftovers like banana peels and bread slices change in color and smell, and bread can grow green molds.

title: VLBI Radio Telescopes
fact_tl: Ang Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) ay gumagamit ng maraming radio telescopes na magkakalayo para kumilos bilang isang higanteng telescope, na tumpak na sinusukat ang mga posisyon ng mga punto sa surface ng Earth.
fact_en: Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) uses multiple radio telescopes spread far apart to act like one giant telescope, precisely measuring the positions of points on Earth's surface.

title: GRACE Gravity Mission
fact_tl: Ang GRACE mission ay gumagamit ng dalawang satellites na magkasamang umiikot para sukatin ang maliliit na pagbabago sa gravity field ng Earth, na nagpapakita kung paano gumagalaw ang mass sa loob at surface ng Earth.
fact_en: The GRACE mission uses two satellites orbiting together to measure tiny variations in Earth's gravity field, which reveal how mass moves inside Earth and on its surface.

title: Tidal Gauge Networks
fact_tl: Ang tidal gauge networks ay mga instrumento sa mga baybayin na sumusukat sa pagbabago ng sea level, na tumutulong sa mga scientist na subaybayan ang vertical land motion tulad ng tectonic uplift o subsidence.
fact_en: Tidal gauge networks are instruments along coastlines that measure sea level changes, helping scientists track vertical land motion like tectonic uplift or subsidence.

title: Low Frequency Waves
fact_tl: Ang low-frequency electromagnetic waves ay kinabibilangan ng radio waves, microwaves, infrared waves, at visible light, at karaniwang hindi gaanong mapanganib kaysa high-frequency waves.
fact_en: Low-frequency electromagnetic waves include radio waves, microwaves, infrared waves, and visible light, and they are generally less dangerous than high-frequency waves.

title: High Frequency Waves
fact_tl: Ang high-frequency electromagnetic waves ay kinabibilangan ng ultraviolet rays, X-rays, at gamma rays, at nagdadala sila ng mas maraming energy kaysa low-frequency waves.
fact_en: High-frequency electromagnetic waves include ultraviolet rays, X-rays, and gamma rays, and they carry more energy than low-frequency waves.

title: Pagprotekta sa Forest Food Chain
fact_tl: Ang pagputol ng napakaraming puno at pangangaso ng mga ligaw na hayop ay maaaring makasira sa mga forest food chain, kaya ang pagprotekta sa mga kagubatan ay nakakatulong na mapanatiling malusog ang buong ecosystem.
fact_en: Cutting down too many trees and hunting wild animals can break forest food chains, so protecting forests helps keep the whole ecosystem healthy.

title: Mas Maraming Buhay sa Rainforest
fact_tl: Ang mainit at maulang tropical rainforest ay may mas maraming uri ng nabubuhay na bagay kaysa sa tuyong disyerto dahil sagana doon ang tubig at sikat ng araw.
fact_en: A warm, rainy tropical rainforest has more kinds of living things than a dry desert because water and sunlight are plentiful there.

title: Pagdami Kapag Masikip
fact_tl: Kapag naging masikip ang isang populasyon, ang density-dependent limiting factors tulad ng sakit at kompetisyon sa pagkain ay lumalakas at nagpapabagal sa pagdami nito.
fact_en: When a population gets crowded, density-dependent limiting factors like disease and competition for food become stronger and slow its growth.

title: Tulak o Hila
fact_tl: Ang force ay isang tulak o hila sa isang bagay na nagmumula sa interaksyon ng bagay na iyon sa kanyang kapaligiran.
fact_en: A force is a push or pull on an object that results from the interaction of that object with its environment.

title: Mt. Apo Power Plant
fact_tl: Ang Mt. Apo – EDC Geothermal Power Plant sa Kidapawan, North Cotabato ay isa sa mga pangunahing geothermal plant sa Pilipinas.
fact_en: The Mt. Apo – EDC Geothermal Power Plant in Kidapawan, North Cotabato is one of the major geothermal plants in the Philippines.

title: Dry Steam Plant
fact_tl: Ang dry steam geothermal plant ay gumagamit ng steam nang direkta mula sa mga balon sa ilalim ng lupa upang paikutin ang turbine.
fact_en: A dry steam geothermal plant uses steam directly from underground wells to spin the turbine.

title: Tatlong Paraan ng Heat Transfer
fact_tl: Ang init ay lumilipat sa pamamagitan ng conduction sa direktang kontak, sa convection sa paggalaw ng fluids, at sa radiation sa pamamagitan ng electromagnetic waves.
fact_en: Heat transfers by conduction through direct contact, by convection through moving fluids, and by radiation through electromagnetic waves.

title: Hiwalay na Daanan Bawat Isa
fact_tl: Ang parallel circuit ay nagbibigay sa bawat device ng sarili nitong path o branch, kaya ang current ay maaaring dumaloy sa maraming loop nang sabay-sabay.
fact_en: A parallel circuit gives each device its own separate path or branch, so the current can flow through many loops at the same time.

title: Pinasimpleng Scientific Models
fact_tl: Ang isang scientific model ay isang pinasimpleng bersyon ng isang komplikadong bagay, na tumutulong sa mga scientist na mahulaan at matutunan ang tungkol sa tunay na bagay.
fact_en: A scientific model is a simplified version of something complicated, helping scientists predict and learn about the real thing.

title: Model sa Iba't ibang Science
fact_tl: Ang mga model ay ginagamit sa maraming larangan ng science, kabilang ang biology, climate science, at economics, para malutas ang mga problema at makahanap ng mga bagong ideya.
fact_en: Models are used in many areas of science, including biology, climate science, and economics, to solve problems and find new ideas.

title: Pakinabang o Panganib
fact_tl: Ang mga materyales sa kapaligiran ay kadalasang kapaki-pakinabang, ngunit maaari silang maging mapanganib depende sa paraan ng paggamit o paghawak ng mga tao sa mga ito.
fact_en: Materials in the environment are mostly useful, but they may become harmful depending on the way people use or handle them.

title: Specific Heat Capacity
fact_tl: Ang specific heat capacity ay ang dami ng heat na kailangan para baguhin ang temperatura ng isang bagay ng isang degree, at bawat bagay ay may sariling halaga nito.
fact_en: Specific heat capacity is the amount of heat needed to change the temperature of a substance by one degree, and every substance has its own value.

title: Pulang Danger Signal
fact_tl:
Bakit pula ang ginagamit sa mga danger signal at stop signs?

Ang pula ang may pinakamahabang wavelength, kaya mas nakikita ito mula sa malayo at kahit may fog o ulan kaysa sa ibang mga kulay!
fact_en:
Why is red used in danger signals and stop signs?

Red has the longest wavelength, so it can be seen from far away and through fog or rain better than other colors!

title: Tanging Lugar ng Gas Exchange
fact_tl: Ang baga lang ang lugar sa katawan kung saan ang mga gas sa dugo ay napapalitan ng mga gas mula sa atmosphere.
fact_en: The lungs are the only place in the body where gases in the blood are exchanged with gases from the atmosphere.

title: Isang Minutong Biyahe
fact_tl: Ang iyong dugo ay umiikot mula sa puso, sa buong katawan, at pabalik sa puso halos bawat 60 segundo.
fact_en: Your blood circulates from your heart, throughout your body, and back to your heart about every 60 seconds.

title: Prinsipyong Walang Katiyakan
fact_tl: Sinasabi ng Heisenberg's uncertainty principle na hindi natin maaaring malaman ang eksaktong posisyon at eksaktong momentum ng isang electron nang sabay.
fact_en: Heisenberg's uncertainty principle says we cannot know both the exact position and the exact momentum of an electron at the same time.

title: Pinakamalayong Rocky Planet
fact_tl: Sa mga terrestrial planets, ang Mars ang pinakamalayo sa Araw sa layong mga 227 million kilometers.
fact_en: Among the terrestrial planets, Mars is the farthest from the Sun at about 227 million kilometers away.

title: Kinetic Molecular Theory
fact_tl: Ipinaliliwanag ng Kinetic Molecular Theory na ang mga molecule ng gas ay nagbibigay ng pressure sa dingding ng lalagyan dahil sa patuloy na pagbangga ng mga ito.
fact_en: Kinetic Molecular Theory explains that gas molecules exert pressure on the walls of their container by constantly colliding with them.

title: Halamang Walang Fertilizer
fact_tl:
Bakit may isang halaman na hindi nilalagyan ng fertilizer sa eksperimento?

Ang control group ay hindi tumatanggap ng treatment habang ang experimental group ay tumatanggap nito, para maikumpara natin kung ano ang mangyayari kapag mayroon at wala nito!
fact_en:
Why does one plant get no fertilizer in an experiment?

A control group does not receive the treatment while an experimental group does, so we can compare what happens with and without it!

title: Magandang Science Questions
fact_tl: Ang magandang scientific question ay isang masasagot sa pamamagitan ng eksperimento, tulad ng pagtatanong kung paano nakakaapekto ang asin sa kumukulong temperatura ng tubig.
fact_en: A good scientific question is one that can be solved through experimentation, like asking how salt affects the boiling temperature of water.

title: Transform Plate Boundary
fact_tl: Dalawang tectonic plates na dumudulas sa tabi ng isa't isa ay bumubuo ng transform plate boundary, kung saan ang paggiling na galaw ay maaaring magdulot ng malalakas na earthquakes.
fact_en: Two tectonic plates sliding past each other form a transform plate boundary, where the grinding motion can cause strong earthquakes.

title: Aerosol Dusting Spray
fact_tl: Ang aerosol dusting spray ay flammable, ibig sabihin madali itong magliyab, at nakakairita ito sa mata at baga.
fact_en: Aerosol dusting spray is flammable, meaning it can catch fire easily, and it irritates the eyes and lungs.

title: Aerosol Air Freshener
fact_tl: Ang aerosol air freshener ay naglalaman ng highly flammable propellants, ang mga gas na nagtutulak sa spray palabas, at maaaring magdulot ng banayad hanggang katamtamang iritasyon sa baga.
fact_en: Aerosol air freshener contains highly flammable propellants, the gases that push the spray out, and can cause mild to moderate lung irritation.

title: Laman ng Gamit nang Motor Oil
fact_tl:
Ano ang nakatago sa gamit nang motor oil?

Naglalaman ito ng mapanganib na heavy metals tulad ng lead, zinc, at cadmium, na mga delikadong sangkap na maaaring makasama sa kalusugan at kapaligiran.
fact_en:
What is hiding in used motor oil?

It contains hazardous heavy metals like lead, zinc, and cadmium, which are dangerous substances that can harm health and the environment.

title: Community ng Iba't Ibang Species
fact_tl: Ang community ay binubuo ng lahat ng population ng iba't ibang species na nakatira at nakikipag-ugnayan sa isang lugar, tulad ng mga kalabaw, damo, at insekto sa isang bukid.
fact_en: A community includes all populations of different species living and interacting in an area, like carabaos, grasses, and insects in one field.

title: Go, Grow, Glow Foods
fact_tl: Ang pagkain ng balanseng diyeta na may go, grow, at glow foods ay nakakatulong para maiwasan ang mga sakit sa respiratory at circulatory systems.
fact_en: Eating a balanced diet with go, grow, and glow foods helps prevent diseases of the respiratory and circulatory systems.

title: Hangin ng Severe Tropical Storm
fact_tl: Ang Severe Tropical Storm ay may bilis ng hangin mula 89 hanggang 117 kilometers per hour.
fact_en: A Severe Tropical Storm has wind speeds between 89 and 117 kilometers per hour.

title: Adiabatic Temperature Change
fact_tl: Ang adiabatic temperature change ay ang paglamig o pag-init ng hangin dahil sa paglawak o pag-urong ng air molecules, hindi dahil sa pagkakaroon o pagkawala ng init.
fact_en: Adiabatic temperature change is the cooling or heating of air caused by expansion or contraction of air molecules, not by gaining or losing heat.

title: Plum Pudding Model ni Thomson
fact_tl: Ang modelo ni Thomson ay naglalarawan ng mga electrons na nakabaon sa isang sphere na may positive charge, parang plums sa isang pudding, na may pantay na negative at positive charge kaya neutral ang atom.
fact_en: Thomson's model describes electrons embedded in a sphere of positive charge like plums in a pudding, with equal negative and positive charge making the atom neutral.

title: Uniform Distribution Pattern
fact_tl: Ang uniform distribution pattern ay nangyayari kapag ang mga organismo ay pantay-pantay ang pagitan, kadalasan dahil nag-aagawan sila sa parehong resources tulad ng tubig o espasyo.
fact_en: A uniform distribution pattern happens when organisms are spaced evenly apart, often because they compete for the same resources like water or space.

title: Random Distribution Pattern
fact_tl: Ang random distribution ay nangyayari kapag ang mga organismo ay nakakalat nang walang malinaw na pattern, tulad ng mga buto ng dandelion na tinatangay ng hangin.
fact_en: Random distribution occurs when organisms are scattered without a clear pattern, like dandelion seeds blown by the wind.

title: Tatlong Digestive Enzymes
fact_tl: Ang amylase ang humihiwalay ng carbohydrates, ang protease ang humihiwalay ng protina, at ang lipase ang humihiwalay ng taba sa mas simpleng anyo.
fact_en: Amylase breaks down carbohydrates, protease breaks down proteins, and lipase breaks down fats into simpler forms.

title: Energy Levels sa Bohr Model
fact_tl: Sa Bohr model, ang mga electron ay umiikot sa nucleus sa mga nakatakdang energy level, at sumisipsip sila ng energy para tumalon pataas o naglalabas ng energy bilang liwanag kapag tumatalon pababa.
fact_en: In the Bohr model, electrons move around the nucleus in fixed energy levels, and they absorb energy to jump up or release energy as light when they jump down.

title: Principal Quantum Number
fact_tl: Ang principal quantum number, na isinusulat bilang n, ay nagsasabi sa iyo ng main energy level ng isang electron, at maaari itong lagyan ng mga titik tulad ng K, L, M, at N.
fact_en: The principal quantum number, written as n, tells you the main energy level of an electron, and it can be labeled with letters like K, L, M, and N.

title: Angular Momentum Quantum Number
fact_tl: Ang angular momentum quantum number, na isinusulat bilang l, ay naglalarawan ng hugis ng isang orbital, tulad ng spherical na s orbital o dumbbell-shaped na p orbital.
fact_en: The angular momentum quantum number, written as l, describes the shape of an orbital, such as the spherical s orbital or the dumbbell-shaped p orbital.

title: Pauli Exclusion Principle
fact_tl: Ayon sa Pauli exclusion principle, walang dalawang electron sa isang atom ang maaaring magkaroon ng parehong set ng apat na quantum numbers, kaya bawat orbital ay may hawak na hindi hihigit sa dalawang electron.
fact_en: The Pauli exclusion principle states that no two electrons in an atom can have the same set of four quantum numbers, so each orbital holds at most two electrons.

title: Main Energy Levels at Sublevels
fact_tl: Ang unang main energy level ay may s sublevel lamang, ang pangalawa ay may s at p, ang pangatlo ay may s, p, at d, at ang pang-apat ay may s, p, d, at f.
fact_en: The first main energy level has only an s sublevel, the second has s and p, the third has s, p, and d, and the fourth has s, p, d, and f.

title: Magnetic Quantum Number
fact_tl: Ang magnetic quantum number, na isinusulat bilang ml, ay naglalarawan kung paano kumikilos ang isang orbital sa magnetic field, na may mga value tulad ng +1, 0, at -1 para sa p orbitals.
fact_en: The magnetic quantum number, written as ml, describes how an orbital behaves in a magnetic field, with values like +1, 0, and -1 for p orbitals.

title: Spin Quantum Number
fact_tl: Ang spin quantum number, na isinusulat bilang ms, ay naglalarawan kung paano umiikot ang isang electron sa sarili nitong axis, na ang clockwise spin ay -1/2 at counterclockwise spin ay +1/2.
fact_en: The spin quantum number, written as ms, describes how an electron spins on its own axis, with clockwise spin as -1/2 and counterclockwise spin as +1/2.

title: Quantum Mechanical Model
fact_tl: Inilalarawan ng quantum mechanical model ng atom ang mga electron bilang waves na gumagalaw sa mga orbital, hindi bilang maliliit na planeta na umiikot sa nucleus sa nakatakdang landas.
fact_en: The quantum mechanical model of the atom describes electrons as waves moving in orbitals, not as tiny planets circling the nucleus in fixed paths.

title: Pangkalahatang Quantum Numbers
fact_tl: Apat na quantum numbers ang naglalarawan sa bawat electron: principal (n) para sa energy level, angular momentum (l) para sa hugis ng orbital, magnetic (ml) para sa orientation, at spin (ms) para sa pag-ikot.
fact_en: Four quantum numbers describe each electron: principal (n) for energy level, angular momentum (l) for orbital shape, magnetic (ml) for orientation, and spin (ms) for rotation.

title: Bituin na Nakikita Buong Taon
fact_tl: Ang ilang constellation, tulad ng Big Dipper at Cassiopeia, ay nakikita sa buong taon dahil umiikot sila malapit sa North Star nang hindi lumulubog sa horizon.
fact_en: Some constellations, like the Big Dipper and Cassiopeia, are visible all year-round because they circle close to the North Star without dipping below the horizon.

title: Ursa Major na Great Bear
fact_tl: Ang Ursa Major, na nangangahulugang 'Great Bear,' ay isa sa pinakamalalaking constellation sa langit at pinakamagandang makita tuwing tagsibol o spring.
fact_en: Ursa Major, which means 'Great Bear,' is one of the largest constellations in the sky and is best seen during the spring season.

title: Magandang Reference Point
fact_tl: Ang mga bagay na fixed o hindi gumagalaw kumpara sa Earth, tulad ng puno, gusali, o poste, ay magandang gamitin bilang reference point sa paglalarawan ng galaw.
fact_en: Objects that are fixed relative to Earth, such as a tree, a building, or a post, make good reference points for describing motion.

title: Kinetic Molecular Theory
fact_tl: Ipinapaliwanag ng kinetic molecular theory ang malalaki at nakikitang katangian ng mga gas - tulad ng pressure at temperature - sa pamamagitan ng paglalarawan sa ginagawa ng maliliit at hindi nakikitang mga particle.
fact_en: The kinetic molecular theory explains the big, visible properties of gases - like pressure and temperature - by describing what the tiny, invisible particles are doing.

title: Dropper o Pipette
fact_tl: Ang dropper, na tinatawag ding pipette, ay isang tool na ginagamit upang maglipat ng maliliit na dami ng likido nang patak-patak.
fact_en: A dropper, also called a pipette, is a tool used to transfer small amounts of liquid drop by drop.

title: Hindi Direktang Benepisyo
fact_tl: May mga species na tumutulong sa atin kahit hindi natin direktang ginagamit, tulad ng mga halaman na pumipigil sa pagguho ng lupa, sumisipsip ng pollutants, at naglilinis ng tubig.
fact_en: Some species help us without being used directly, like plants that prevent soil erosion, absorb pollutants, and keep water clean.

title: Pambansang Programang Greening
fact_tl: Ang National Greening Program ay tumutulong na mabawasan ang deforestation sa pamamagitan ng pagbibigay sa mga magsasaka ng mga economically important na halaman tulad ng cacao, falcate, at mga punong namumunga.
fact_en: The National Greening Program helps reduce deforestation by giving local farmers economically important plants like cacao, falcate, and fruit trees.

title: Iba't Ibang Pananim
fact_tl: Ang pagtatanim ng iba't ibang uri ng pananim sa halip na iisang uri lamang ay nakakatulong sa pangangalaga ng kapaligiran at nagpapanatili ng katatagan ng ecosystem.
fact_en: Growing a variety of crops rather than just one crop helps conserve the environment and keeps the ecosystem more stable.

title: Potentially Active Volcano
fact_tl: Ang mga potentially active volcano ay walang record ng pagputok pero mukhang bata pa at sariwa ang kanilang hugis.
fact_en: Potentially active volcanoes have no records of volcanic activity but look young and fresh in their shape.

title: Noble Gas sa Electron Config
fact_tl:
Bakit nagsisimula sa simbolo ng noble gas na nasa bracket ang ilang electron configuration?

Iyan ay shorthand configuration! Nagsisimula ito sa simbolo ng naunang noble gas para kumatawan sa buong electron configuration nito, tapos idinadagdag na lang ang mga karagdagang electron para sa bagong elemento.
fact_en:
Why do some electron configurations start with a noble gas symbol in brackets?

That is a shorthand configuration! It starts with the symbol of the previous noble gas to represent its full electron configuration, then adds only the extra electrons for the new element.

title: Prinsipyong Pauli Exclusion
fact_tl: Sinasabi ng Pauli exclusion principle na dalawang electron lamang ang maaaring magkasya sa isang orbital, at dapat magkasalungat ang kanilang spins.
fact_en: The Pauli exclusion principle says that only two electrons can fit into a single orbital, and they must have opposite spins.

title: Principal Quantum Number
fact_tl: Ang principal quantum number, n, ay nagsasabi ng main energy level o shell kung saan matatagpuan ang isang electron, at mas mataas na n ay nangangahulugang mas malayo ang electron sa nucleus.
fact_en: The principal quantum number, n, tells the main energy level or shell where an electron is found, with higher n meaning the electron is farther from the nucleus.

title: Maximum na Electron bawat Level
fact_tl: Ang bawat main energy level ay may maximum na bilang ng electron na kayang hawakan: ang n=1 ay 2, n=2 ay 8, n=3 ay 18, at n=4 ay 32 electrons.
fact_en: Each main energy level can hold a maximum number of electrons: n=1 holds 2, n=2 holds 8, n=3 holds 18, and n=4 holds 32 electrons.

title: Percent by Mass
fact_tl: Ang percent by mass ay nagsasabi kung ilang gramo ng solute ang nasa bawat 100 gramo ng solution, tulad ng 5 gramo ng asukal sa 95 gramo ng tubig.
fact_en: Percent by mass tells you how many grams of solute are in every 100 grams of solution, like 5 grams of sugar in 95 grams of water.

title: Balanseng Atwood Machine
fact_tl: Sa isang Atwood machine, kapag magkapareho ang dalawang nakabiting mass, ang gravitational forces ay balanced, kaya ang net force ay zero at hindi gumagalaw ang mga mass.
fact_en: In an Atwood machine, when two hanging masses are equal, the gravitational forces are balanced, so the net force is zero and the masses do not move.

title: Hindi Balanseng Atwood Machine
fact_tl: Sa isang Atwood machine, kapag mas malaki ang isang nakabiting mass, ang net force ay unbalanced, kaya ang mas malaking mass ay bumibilis pababa at ang mas maliit na mass ay bumibilis paitaas.
fact_en: In an Atwood machine, when one hanging mass is larger, the net force is unbalanced, so the larger mass accelerates downward and the smaller mass accelerates upward.

title: Hindi Nagbabagong Puwersa
fact_tl: Kapag ang inilapat na puwersa ay hindi binabago, ang pagtaas ng mass ng isang bagay ay nagpapababa ng acceleration nito.
fact_en: When the applied force is kept constant, increasing the mass of an object makes its acceleration decrease.

title: Ready, Careful, Clean
fact_tl: Ang kaligtasan sa laboratoryo ay sumusunod sa tatlong simpleng yugto: maging READY bago ang eksperimento, maging CAREFUL habang ginagawa ito, at mag-CLEAN pagkatapos nito.
fact_en: Laboratory safety follows three simple phases: be READY before an experiment, be CAREFUL during it, and CLEAN up after it.

title: Karaniwang Lab Apparatus
fact_tl: Kabilang sa mga karaniwang laboratory apparatus ang beaker para sa paglalagay ng likido, graduated cylinder para sa pagsukat ng volume, test tubes para sa maliliit na sample, at Erlenmeyer flask para sa paghahalo.
fact_en: Common laboratory apparatus include the beaker for holding liquids, the graduated cylinder for measuring volume, test tubes for small samples, and the Erlenmeyer flask for mixing.

title: Paggamit ng Test Tube Clamp
fact_tl: Kapag nag-iinit ng test tube, laging hawakan ito gamit ang clamp sa patayong posisyon, palayo sa iyong sarili at sa lahat ng nasa laboratoryo.
fact_en: When heating a test tube, always hold it with a clamp in an upright position, away from yourself and everyone else in the laboratory.

title: Pag-init gamit ang Wire Gauze
fact_tl: Kapag nag-iinit ng mga likido sa beaker o flask gamit ang burner, ilagay ang lalagyan sa wire gauze upang pantay na maipamahagi ang init at mabawasan ang panganib ng pagbasag.
fact_en: When heating liquids in a beaker or flask with a burner, place the container on a wire gauze to spread the heat evenly and reduce the risk of shattering.

title: Dalawang Bagay, Isang Space
fact_tl:
Maaari bang magkasama ang dalawang bagay sa iisang space nang sabay?

Hindi! Kailangang umalis muna ng isang bagay bago makapasok ang isa pa, dahil laging may sinasakop na space ang matter.
fact_en:
Can two objects occupy the same space at the same time?

No! One object must move away before another object can take its place, because matter always occupies space.

title: Init o Lamig
fact_tl: Ang temperature ay ang antas ng init o lamig ng hangin sa paligid natin, at nagbabago ito depende sa oras ng araw at sa panahon.
fact_en: Temperature is the degree of hotness or coldness of the air around us, and it changes with the time of day and the weather.

title: Mabilis o Mabagal na Hangin
fact_tl: Ang wind speed ay kung gaano kabilis o kabagal ang pag-ihip ng hangin, at maaari itong mahina minsan at napakabilis sa ibang pagkakataon.
fact_en: Wind speed is how fast or slow the wind is blowing, and it can be gentle at times and very fast at other times.

title: Mutation mula sa Radon Gas
fact_tl: Ang radon gas ay isang radioactive noble gas na maaaring magdulot ng genetic mutations at magpataas ng panganib ng cancer.
fact_en: Radon gas is a radioactive noble gas that can cause genetic mutations and increase the risk of cancer.

title: Paghula gamit ang Punnett Square
fact_tl: Ang Punnett square ay isang simpleng grid na hinuhulaan ang posibilidad na mamana ng isang bata ang isang katangian, tulad ng tsansa na maging color blind o magkaroon ng hemophilia.
fact_en: A Punnett square is a simple grid that predicts the probability of a child inheriting a trait, like the chance of being color blind or having hemophilia.

title: Mas Tuyong Leeward Side
fact_tl: Ang leeward side ng bundok ay nakakatanggap ng mas kaunting ulan dahil naibuhos na ng hangin ang karamihan ng moisture nito bilang ulan sa windward side.
fact_en: The leeward side of a mountain receives less precipitation because the air has already lost most of its moisture as rain on the windward side.

title: Rehiyong Rain Shadow
fact_tl: Ang rain shadow ay isang tuyong lugar na nabubuo sa leeward side ng bundok dahil ang hangin doon ay lumulubog, umiinit, at natutuyo.
fact_en: A rain shadow is a dry region that forms on the leeward side of a mountain because the air there is sinking, warming, and drying out.

title: Standard SI Units
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang mga scientist sa buong mundo ng standard SI units para pareho ang ibig sabihin ng sukat ng mass, length, volume, time, at temperature kahit saan.
fact_en: Scientists around the world use standard SI units so that measurements of mass, length, volume, time, and temperature mean the same thing everywhere.

title: Isang Itlog Bawat Cycle
fact_tl: Pinipigilan ng estrogen ang paggawa ng FSH para isang itlog lamang ang mahinog sa bawat cycle.
fact_en: Estrogen stops FSH from being produced so that only one egg matures in a cycle.

title: Puwersang Hindi Dumidikit
fact_tl: Ang gravity ay isang non-contact force, ibig sabihin kaya nitong hilahin ang mga bagay kahit hindi sila magkadikit.
fact_en: Gravity is a non-contact force, which means it can pull objects even when they are not touching each other.

title: Organism: Isang Indibidwal
fact_tl: Ang organism ay isang indibidwal na hayop, halaman, o single-celled na may buhay, tulad ng isang aso, isang puno ng mangga, o isang amoeba.
fact_en: An organism is an individual animal, plant, or single-celled life form, like one dog, one mango tree, or one amoeba.

title: Biosphere: Pinakamalaking Level
fact_tl: Ang biosphere ang pinakamalaking level ng biological organization, at ito ang kabuuan ng lahat ng ecosystems sa Earth kung saan may buhay.
fact_en: The biosphere is the largest level of biological organization, and it is the sum of all ecosystems on Earth where life exists.

title: Bakit Free-Body Diagram
fact_tl:
Bakit gumuguhit ang mga scientist ng free-body diagram sa halip na tingnan lang ang isang larawan?

Dahil ang free-body diagram ay nagpapakita lamang ng mga force, kaya mas madaling makita kung aling mga force ang balanse o hindi balanse!
fact_en:
Why do scientists draw free-body diagrams instead of just looking at a picture?

Because a free-body diagram shows only the forces, making it easier to see which forces are balanced or unbalanced!

title: Higanteng Bituing Canis Major
fact_tl: Ang Canis Major ay isa sa pinakamalaking kilalang bituin, na may diameter na 1,975,000,000 kilometers, mahigit 100 beses ang laki kaysa sa ating Araw.
fact_en: Canis Major is one of the largest known stars, with a diameter of 1,975,000,000 kilometers, more than 100 times the size of our Sun.

title: Condensed Structural Formula
fact_tl: Ang condensed structural formula ay isinusulat ang magkakadikit na atoms bilang isang grupo, tulad ng CH3CH3 para sa ethane, para makita kung paano sila nakakabit.
fact_en: A condensed structural formula writes connected atoms as a group, like CH3CH3 for ethane, so you can see how the atoms are linked.

title: San Lorenzo Wind Farm
fact_tl: Ang San Lorenzo Wind Farm sa Guimaras ay isang 54 MW facility, ibig sabihin kaya nitong gumawa ng 54 megawatts ng electrical power kapag maganda ang kondisyon ng hangin.
fact_en: The San Lorenzo Wind Farm in Guimaras is a 54 MW facility, meaning it can produce 54 megawatts of electrical power when the wind conditions are good.

title: Tatlong Paraan ng Heat Transfer
fact_tl: Ang heat ay naglilipat sa pamamagitan ng conduction kapag nagdikit ang mga bagay, sa convection kapag gumagalaw ang fluids, at sa radiation sa pamamagitan ng empty space.
fact_en: Heat transfers by conduction when objects touch, by convection when fluids move, and by radiation through empty space.

title: Isang Magulang Lamang
fact_tl: Ang asexual reproduction ay gumagamit lamang ng isang parent plant, kaya ang bagong halaman ay genetically identical sa nag-iisang magulang nito.
fact_en: Asexual reproduction involves only one parent plant, so the new plant is genetically identical to its single parent.

title: Mahinang Hangin Bago ang Bagyo
fact_tl: Bago ang bagyo, mahinang umiihip ang hangin at maaaring magkaroon ng mga paminsan-minsang pag-ulan habang nagsisimulang magbago ang panahon.
fact_en: Before a typhoon, the wind blows gently and scattered rain showers may occur as the weather starts to change.

title: DNA sa Iba't ibang Cells
fact_tl: Ang DNA ay pangunahing nasa nucleus ng eukaryotic cells, habang sa prokaryotic cells ito ay nasa region na tinatawag na nucleoid.
fact_en: DNA is mainly found in the nucleus of eukaryotic cells, while in prokaryotic cells it is found in a region called the nucleoid.

title: Heredity Bago si Mendel
fact_tl: Bago pa si Mendel, ang mga sinaunang thinker tulad nina Pythagoras at Aristotle ay nagtaka kung paano naipapasa ang traits mula sa magulang papunta sa anak, at mali ang sinabi ni Pythagoras na lalaki lamang ang nagdidikta ng katangian ng anak.
fact_en: Long before Mendel, ancient thinkers like Pythagoras and Aristotle wondered how traits pass from parents to offspring, with Pythagoras wrongly claiming only males determined offspring characteristics.

title: Limang Ecological Relationships
fact_tl: May limang ecological relationships sa isang ecosystem: competition, predation, commensalism, mutualism, at parasitism.
fact_en: There are five ecological relationships in an ecosystem: competition, predation, commensalism, mutualism, and parasitism.

title: Mula Lianga hanggang Bayugan
fact_tl: Ang aktwal na kalsada mula Lianga papuntang Bayugan City ay kumakatawan sa distance, habang ang ideal na tuwid na linya sa pagitan nila ay kumakatawan sa displacement.
fact_en: The actual road from Lianga to Bayugan City represents distance, while an ideal straight line between them represents displacement.

title: Tinanggihang Continental Drift
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi agad naniwala ang mga scientist sa Continental Drift Theory ni Wegener?

Hindi niya maipaliwanag ang puwersang sapat na lakas para igalaw ang buong kontinente, kaya tinanggihan ang kanyang ideya sa loob ng maraming taon!
fact_en:
Why didn't scientists believe Wegener's Continental Drift Theory at first?

He couldn't explain the force strong enough to move entire continents, so his idea was rejected for many years!

title: Katugmang Appalachian Mountain
fact_tl: Ang Appalachian Mountains sa silangang North America ay may mga rock formation na katugma ng mga bundok sa Greenland at western Europe, na nagmumungkahing dating bahagi sila ng iisang bulubundukin.
fact_en: The Appalachian Mountains in eastern North America have rock formations that match mountains in Greenland and western Europe, suggesting they were once part of the same range.

title: Iba Pang Magkatugmang Kontinente
fact_tl: Ang mga gilid ng India, Antarctica, at Australia ay magkakatugma rin, na nagdaragdag ng mga piraso sa continental jigsaw puzzle.
fact_en: The edges of India, Antarctica, and Australia also match one another, adding more pieces to the continental jigsaw puzzle.

title: Bola Bago Masaluhin
fact_tl:
Kung ihahagis mo ang bola pataas sa 30 m/s, gaano ito kabilis bago mo ito saluhin?

Kumikilos ito ng 30 m/s muli, ngunit pababa na ngayon, kaya ang velocity nito ay negative 30 m/s!
fact_en:
If you throw a ball upward at 30 m/s, how fast is it moving just before you catch it?

It is moving at 30 m/s again, but now downward, so its velocity is negative 30 m/s!

title: Mas Malayong Relasyon
fact_tl: Kapag mas marami ang pagkakaiba ng amino acids, mas malayo ang evolutionary relationship at mas maaga silang naghiwalay mula sa common ancestor.
fact_en: Greater amino acid differences indicate a more distant evolutionary relationship and an earlier divergence from a common ancestor.

title: Fruit Fly o Mais
fact_tl:
Mas malapit ba ang mouse sa fruit fly o sa mais?

Sa fruit fly! Ang pagkakaiba ng PCNA protein ay 15 amino acids para sa fruit fly, pero 21 para sa mais.
fact_en:
Is a mouse more closely related to a fruit fly or to corn?

To a fruit fly! The PCNA protein difference is 15 amino acids for fruit fly, but 21 for corn.

title: Mahabang Fault Lines
fact_tl: Ang transform boundaries ay may mahahabang faults na umaabot ng daan-daang kilometro, at madalas nitong inililipat ang mga bahagi ng mid-ocean ridges.
fact_en: Transform boundaries are characterized by long faults that can stretch for hundreds of kilometers, and they often offset sections of mid-ocean ridges.

title: First Aid Pagkatapos ng Lindol
fact_tl: Pagkatapos ng lindol, kung may nasaktan, mag-apply ng first aid at pagkatapos ay dalhin sila sa pinakamalapit na ospital o klinika para sa karagdagang paggamot.
fact_en: After an earthquake, if someone is injured, apply first aid and then bring them to the nearest hospital or clinic for further treatment.

title: Philippine Mobile Belt
fact_tl: Karamihan sa mga isla sa kapuluan ng Pilipinas ay bahagi ng Philippine Mobile Belt, isang sona ng aktibong paggalaw ng tectonic plates sa pagitan ng dalawang nagbabanggaang plates.
fact_en: Most of the islands in the Philippine archipelago are part of the Philippine Mobile Belt, a zone of active tectonic movement between two converging plates.

title: Iisang Phase Lamang
fact_tl: Ang homogeneous mixture ay may iisang phase lamang, ibig sabihin pareho ang itsura nito sa kabuuan maging liquid man, gas, o solid, tulad ng tubig na may asin o hangin.
fact_en: A homogeneous mixture has only one phase, meaning it looks the same throughout whether it is a liquid, gas, or solid, like salt water or air.

title: Banana Con Yelo
fact_tl: Ang banana con yelo ay isang heterogeneous mixture dahil mayroon itong solid na sangkap tulad ng saging at yelo, liquid na sangkap tulad ng syrup, at hindi pareho ang itsura sa kabuuan.
fact_en: Banana con yelo is a heterogeneous mixture because it has solid components like banana and ice, liquid components like syrup, and no uniform appearance throughout.

title: Hindi Nababagong Reaction Rate
fact_tl:
Maaari ba nating baguhin ang rate ng bawat chemical reaction?

Hindi! Ang rate ng nuclear o radioactive decay ay hindi nababago, at ginagamit ng PET scans ang steady rate na ito para makita ang sakit.
fact_en:
Can we change the rate of every chemical reaction?

No! The rate of nuclear or radioactive decay is unchangeable, and PET scans use this steady rate to detect disease.

title: Low Pressure Center
fact_tl: Nagsisimula ang typhoon sa low pressure center, isang lugar kung saan mas mainit at mas magaan ang hangin, kaya ang hangin sa paligid ay sumusugod papasok para punan ang espasyo.
fact_en: A typhoon begins with a low pressure center, a place where air is warmer and lighter, so surrounding air rushes inward to fill the space.

title: Mababang Wind Shear
fact_tl: Para lumaki ang typhoon, dapat mababa ang wind shear, ang pagbabago ng bilis o direksyon ng hangin sa taas, para hindi mapunit ang bagyo.
fact_en: For a typhoon to grow, wind shear, which is the change in wind speed or direction with height, must be low so the storm is not torn apart.

title: Angela Typhoon 1867
fact_tl: Ang Angela Typhoon noong 1867 ang pinakamatandang typhoon na naitala sa kasaysayan ng Pilipinas, na kumitil ng humigit-kumulang 1,800 buhay at kinilala bilang ikalimang pinakanakamamatay.
fact_en: The Angela Typhoon of 1867 is the oldest typhoon recorded in Philippine history, taking around 1,800 lives and earning its place as the fifth deadliest.

title: Tropical Storm Uring
fact_tl: Ang Tropical Storm Uring noong 1991 ay hindi ganap na typhoon, ngunit pumatay pa rin ito ng 5,000 hanggang 8,000 katao at nagdulot ng matinding torrential rainfall sa Visayas.
fact_en: Tropical Storm Uring in 1991 was not a full typhoon, but it still killed 5,000 to 8,000 people and caused severe torrential rainfall in Visayas.

title: Moles papuntang Gramo
fact_tl: Para i-convert ang moles sa gramo, i-multiply ang bilang ng moles sa molar mass ng substance.
fact_en: To convert moles to grams, multiply the number of moles by the substance's molar mass.

title: Mainit o Malamig
fact_tl:
Paano natin nalalaman kung masyadong mainit ang ating pampaligo?

Ang nerve endings sa ating balat ay nakakaramdam ng temperature! Mabilis nilang sinasabi sa utak kung ang isang bagay ay mainit o malamig, para manatili tayong ligtas.
fact_en:
How do we know if our bath water is too hot?

Nerve endings in our skin sense temperature! They quickly tell the brain if something is hot or cold, so we can stay safe.

title: Iba't Ibang Laki ng Buto
fact_tl: Ang mga buto ay may iba't ibang laki, mula sa napakapinong buto tulad ng alikabok ng orchid hanggang sa malalaking buto tulad ng niyog.
fact_en: Seeds vary in size, from very fine seeds like orchid dust to large seeds like coconuts.

title: Pistil o Carpel
fact_tl: Ang pistil, na tinatawag ding carpel, ay ang female reproductive organ ng bulaklak, na binubuo ng stigma, style, at ovary.
fact_en: The pistil, also called the carpel, is the female reproductive organ of a flower, made of the stigma, style, and ovary.

title: Wet Mount Slides
fact_tl: Ang wet mount slides ay ginagamit para sa mga buhay na sample, malinaw na likido, at aquatic samples, kung saan isang patak ng likido ang humahawak sa specimen sa slide.
fact_en: Wet mount slides are used for living samples, transparent liquids, and aquatic samples, where a drop of liquid holds the specimen on the slide.

title: Dry Mount Slides
fact_tl: Ang dry mount slides ay nangangailangan ng napakanipis at patag na specimen, at kadalasang nilalagyan ng coverslip sa itaas para manatiling patag at protektado ang sample.
fact_en: Dry mount slides require very thin, flat specimens, and a coverslip is often placed on top to keep the sample flat and protected.

title: Coarse Adjustment Knob
fact_tl: Ang coarse adjustment knob ay ang malaking knob na mabilis na nagpapagalaw sa stage o lens pataas at pababa, at ito ang unang ginagamit para mailapit sa focus ang sample.
fact_en: The coarse adjustment knob is the large knob that moves the stage or lens up and down quickly, and it is used first to bring the sample into rough focus.

title: Fine Adjustment Knob
fact_tl: Ang fine adjustment knob ay ang mas maliit na knob na gumagalaw sa lens nang maliliit na hakbang, na nagbibigay ng matalas at malinaw na imahe kapag halos naka-focus na ang sample.
fact_en: The fine adjustment knob is the smaller knob that moves the lens in tiny steps, giving you a sharp, clear image once the sample is roughly focused.

title: Fine Focus sa High Power
fact_tl: Kapag nasa high power ka na, gamitin lamang ang fine adjustment knob para makakuha ng mas matalas na imahe, dahil maaaring mabasag ng coarse knob ang slide.
fact_en: Once you are on high power, use only the fine adjustment knob to get a sharper image, because the coarse knob could break the slide.

title: Karaniwang Objective Powers
fact_tl: Ang pinakakaraniwang objective lens magnifications para sa mga karaniwang laboratory microscopes ay 4x, 10x, at 40x, bagamat mayroon ding mas mahina at mas malakas.
fact_en: The most common objective lens magnifications for typical laboratory microscopes are 4x, 10x, and 40x, although weaker and stronger ones exist.

title: Iba't Ibang Kakayahang Sumipsip
fact_tl: May mga materyales na mas maraming naa-absorb na tubig kaysa iba, kaya ang face towel ay mas maraming kayang hawakan na tubig kaysa manipis na t-shirt.
fact_en: Some materials absorb water more than others, so a face towel can hold more water than a thin t-shirt.

title: Iba't Ibang Paraan ng Paglubog
fact_tl: May mga bagay na mabilis lumubog, may mabagal, at may iba na nananatiling nakalubog sa gitna ng tubig.
fact_en: Some things sink very fast, some sink slowly, and some stay submerged partway down in the water.

title: Iba't Ibang Laki ng Plate
fact_tl: Magkakaiba ang laki ng mga lithospheric plate, kaya may mas malalaking plate at mas maliliit na plate na bumabalot sa ibabaw ng Earth.
fact_en: Lithospheric plates vary in size, so Earth has both larger plates and smaller plates covering its surface.

title: Iba't ibang Galaw ng Hayop
fact_tl: Ang pagkakaroon ng iba't ibang body parts ay nagpapagalaw sa mga hayop sa iba't ibang paraan, tulad ng paglakad, paglundag, paggapang, paglangoy, at paglipad.
fact_en: Having different body parts makes animals move in different ways, like walking, jumping, crawling, swimming, and flying.

title: Bakit Ito Mahalaga
fact_tl: Kung wala ang digestive system, hindi mo makukuha ang mga nutrients na kailangan mo para lumaki nang maayos at manatiling malusog.
fact_en: Without the digestive system, you could not get the nutrients you need to grow properly and stay healthy.

title: Dumaraming Greenhouse Gas
fact_tl: Kapag nagsusunog ng gasolina at pumuputol ng mga puno ang mga tao, mas maraming greenhouse gas ang pumapasok sa hangin, kaya mas maraming init ang nakukulong at mas umiinit ang planeta kaysa normal.
fact_en: When people burn fuels and cut down forests, more greenhouse gases enter the air, trapping extra heat and making the planet warmer than normal.

title: Iba Pang Gamit sa Panahon
fact_tl: Ang mga weather balloon, weather buoy, rain gauge, at wind vane ay ilan sa mga gamit sa pagsukat at pagtataya ng panahon at klima.
fact_en: Weather balloons, weather buoys, rain gauges, and wind vanes are some of the tools used to measure and forecast weather and climate.

title: Secondary Seismic Waves
fact_tl: Ang secondary waves, o S-waves, ay mas mabagal kaysa primary waves at hindi makadaan sa liquid.
fact_en: Secondary waves, or S-waves, are slower than primary waves and cannot travel through liquid.

title: Nakapipinsalang Surface Waves
fact_tl: Ang surface waves ay naglalakbay mula sa focus ng lindol pataas hanggang sa epicenter at sila ang nagdudulot ng pinakamaraming pinsala sa panahon ng lindol.
fact_en: Surface waves travel from the earthquake's focus up to the epicenter and cause most of the damage during an earthquake.

title: Sistematikong Scientific Method
fact_tl: Ang scientific method ay isang sistematikong paraan ng pagte-test ng mga ideya at pag-uulat ng resulta, at mahalagang bahagi nito na ang experiment ay dapat kayang ulitin ng kahit sino.
fact_en: The scientific method is a systematic way of testing ideas and reporting results, and a key part is that experiments must be replicable by anyone.

title: Hindi Sumusoportang Hypothesis
fact_tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kung hindi sinusuportahan ng data ang hypothesis?

Kailangan pang gumawa ng mas maraming observation, bumuo ng bagong hypothesis, at gamitin muli ang scientific method.
fact_en:
What happens if the data do not support the hypothesis?

Then more observations must be made, a new hypothesis is formed, and the scientific method is used all over again.

title: High Power Objective
fact_tl:
Ano ang advantage ng high power objective?

Lubos nitong pinalalaki ang imahe para makita mo ang mga detalye ng structure, pero lumiliit ang field of view.
fact_en:
What is an advantage of the high power objective?

It greatly magnifies the image so you can see details of the structure, but the field of view becomes smaller.

title: Active Laban sa Inactive Fault
fact_tl:
Paano mo malalaman kung active o inactive ang isang fault?

Ang active fault ay gumalaw sa mga nakaraang dekada at maaaring magdulot ng earthquake, habang ang inactive fault ay walang tala ng paggalaw sa loob ng maraming siglo.
fact_en:
How can you tell an active fault from an inactive one?

An active fault has moved in recent decades and can cause future earthquakes, while an inactive fault has no movement records for centuries.

title: Mula Dahon Patungong Bulaklak
fact_tl: Kasama ng haba ng araw, naaapektuhan ng temperatura ang pagbabago mula sa vegetative growth, kapag gumagawa ng dahon ang halaman, patungo sa reproductive growth, kapag gumagawa ito ng bulaklak.
fact_en: Together with day length, temperature affects the change from vegetative growth, when a plant makes leaves, to reproductive growth, when it makes flowers.

title: Coronary Heart Disease at Bara
fact_tl: Ang coronary heart disease ay kondisyon kung saan ang mga coronary arteries na nagdadala ng oxygenated blood sa puso ay nababara o kumikipot dahil sa naipon na matatabang sangkap.
fact_en: Coronary heart disease is a condition where the coronary arteries that supply oxygenated blood to the heart become blocked or narrow due to buildup of fatty substances.

title: Healthy Lifestyle Laban sa Sakit
fact_tl: Ang pinakamahusay na paraan upang maiwasan ang mga sakit sa respiratory at circulatory systems ay ang magkaroon ng healthy lifestyle, kasama ang balanced diet, regular na ehersisyo, sapat na pahinga, at wastong kalinisan.
fact_en: The best way to prevent diseases of the respiratory and circulatory systems is to have a healthy lifestyle, including balanced diet, regular exercise, adequate rest, and proper hygiene.

title: Negative Lifestyle Nagpapahina ng Resistensya
fact_tl:
Bakit mas madalas magkasakit ang ibang tao kaysa sa iba?

Pinapahina ng negative lifestyle ang immune system, ang depensa ng katawan laban sa sakit, at maaaring magdulot ng iba't ibang sakit sa respiratory at circulatory systems.
fact_en:
Why do some people get sick more often than others?

Negative lifestyle weakens the immune system, the body's defense against disease, and can cause various respiratory and circulatory diseases.
